requirements.title: Show each persona only its menus and screens
requirements.screens: Sidebar menu (groups Home, Client & Policy, Operations, Finance, Claims & Insurance, Reports, Setup & Administration)
acceptance: A Cashiering user sees Operations and Finance > Cashiering and no Client & Policy screen.
A user with two roles sees the screens of both roles.
Opening a screen by URL without its permission shows the no-access message.

requirements.title: Open a role home page with the figures of the user's roles
requirements.screens: Role Home (/); Role Home Set-up (Setup & Administration)
acceptance: A Marketing AO lands on a home page with his pipeline and PR follow-up widgets; a Cashiering user on the cashiering counts.
A user with the Marketing AO and Collection roles sees both sets once.
A widget never counts a record that its list would not show the user.

requirements.title: Open the details behind a dashboard figure
requirements.screens: Role Home; the work list or report of the widget
acceptance: The count on a widget equals the number of rows of the list it opens at the same moment.

requirements.title: Notify users of status changes, approvals and pending work
requirements.screens: Notification bell; My Work; Notification preferences (profile)
acceptance: Submitting a request for approval notifies the approvers in the bell within one minute.
A user who switched off e-mail for an event still sees it in the bell.

requirements.title: Keep a complete audit trail of actions and transactions
requirements.screens: Audit Trail (Setup & Administration); History tabs of the records
acceptance: Every action of a test run appears in the audit trail with the right user and time.
An audit entry cannot be edited through any screen or direct request.

requirements.title: Log every change to master data with old and new values
acceptance: Changing an insurer's accreditation date shows one line with the old and new date, the user and the approval reference.
Changing a password shows "changed" and no value.

requirements.title: Generate standard reports and export or print them in several formats
acceptance: A report exported to Excel and PDF shows the same rows and totals as on screen.
A user without the report's permission does not see it in the catalogue.

requirements.title: Save tailored report parameters and filters as variants
acceptance: A shared variant appears for another user of the same report and runs with the saved parameters.

requirements.title: Customise a report's fields, grouping, summaries and chart
acceptance: A layout with two columns, a grouping by insurer and a bar chart is shown on screen and in the PDF export with the same subtotals.
A BIR book offers no Layout panel.

requirements.title: Schedule reports and distribute them
acceptance: A weekly subscription runs on the chosen day and time and the file arrives with the variant's filters.
A subscription of a user whose report permission was removed stops and notifies him.

requirements.title: Generate business documents from maintained templates
requirements.screens: Templates (Broking Setup); document downloads on each record
acceptance: A placement slip generated after a template change uses the new version; an earlier slip keeps the old one.

requirements.title: Maintain lists of values with effectivity and approval
acceptance: A deactivated value is no longer offered on new records and stays visible on old ones.

requirements.title: Maintain insurer records in one place
requirements.screens: Insurer page (Catalog > Insurers), tabs Profile, Branches and LGT, Contacts, Products and Packages, Commission Rates, Payment Terms and Remittance, Risk Participation, Accounts
acceptance: A changed commission rate applies to bookings from its effective date and not before.
The insurer page shows the products and packages the insurer is on.

requirements.title: Define the MIS fields used for reports, dashboards and filters
requirements.screens: MIS Fields (Broking Setup); report runner filters and Layout panel
acceptance: Activating "Business origin" for accounts makes it available as a filter and grouping on the account reports.

requirements.title: Maintain products through Product Maintenance
acceptance: The acceptance criteria of FRS BRD-3 apply.

requirements.title: Sign in, reset passwords and manage user access by request
requirements.screens: Login; Reset password; User Access requests
acceptance: The acceptance criteria of FRS BRD-11 apply.

requirements.title: Protect documents that leave BDOI
requirements.screens: Send e-mail dialogs of the records
acceptance: A slip received by the insurer opens only with the password from the second e-mail.

requirements.title: Move work and data to the next process by configured workflow
requirements.screens: My Work; workflow panels of the records
acceptance: Submitting an account for placement puts it in the Processing queue and records the transition.

requirements.title: Deliver the day's service invoices to each insurer in one batch
acceptance: All service invoices of a day appear once in the batch of their insurer and on the delivery report.

requirements.title: Receive migrated clients and legacy client batches during coexistence
acceptance: A test migration file loads with every row either loaded or listed as a fall-out with its reason.

requirements.title: Process in bulk and individually with concurrent users
acceptance: A file with valid and invalid rows loads the valid rows and lists every invalid row with its reason.

requirements.title: Show the Invoice Master List across workflows
requirements.screens: Operations > Invoice Ledger, view "Invoice Master List"
acceptance: Every column named in BR-175 is available in the view and the export.

requirements.title: Select currency on accounts and report in several currencies
requirements.screens: Account; reports with a currency parameter
acceptance: A USD account books in USD with the peso equivalent at the booking rate.

requirements.title: Apply the BDO brand, design system and user journeys on every screen
acceptance: The alignment review finds no screen outside the BDO colour and layout rules.
Each business sign-off pack carries the 07, 08 and 09 UX documents for the BDOI UX Design team.

requirements.title: Issue the SOA and the insurer's service invoice at booking
acceptance: After CRQ12, booking an account produces the service invoice and the SOA with the same invoice number.

requirements.title: Run every product line on one New Business workflow
acceptance: A Liability product (for example CGL01) goes through quotation, account, placement, issuance and booking with the same stages as a Motor product.
A product that is not active cannot be selected on a quotation or account.
A product offered only to CBG cannot be used on a CORBANK account.

requirements.title: Capture the product-specific fields of each line
requirements.screens: New Account (Risk Items step); New Quotation; Products (Field Rules tab)
acceptance: A Motor account without an engine number cannot be submitted, and the message names the engine number.
A Motor item with a conduction sticker and no plate number meets the plate rule.
A rule added by the Business Administrator for one product applies to the next submission without a release.

requirements.title: Apply validation rules by product type
requirements.screens: New Account; Edit Account; New Quotation
acceptance: A product without the multi-year feature refuses a 3-year term with MULTI_YEAR_NOT_ALLOWED.
The check panel of a draft account lists all missing fields and documents at once.

requirements.title: Use standard intake and shared document templates
requirements.screens: Document Templates; New Quotation; New Proposal Request
acceptance: A quotation shows the intake template version it was captured with.
A Fire and a Motor quotation letter are produced from the same template with their own item details.
After a new template version, an earlier document still shows the version it was generated with.

requirements.title: Route risks to TSU by rule
requirements.screens: Products (TSU Rules tab); New Quotation (routing result); New Proposal Request; Account page (TSU Clearance)
acceptance: A Motor quotation with 6 vehicles shows "TSU required (FLEET_5)".
An account that requires TSU cannot be validated before TSU records the clearance.
A change to the TSI threshold applies to the next evaluation without a release.

requirements.title: Track the status of every record through defined stages
requirements.screens: Workflow panel and History tab of every client, quotation, PRF and account page; My Work; NB Dashboard
acceptance: An account's History tab shows every stage from Draft to Booked with user and time.
An attempt to book an account in stage Placed is refused with WORKFLOW_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED.
An account without movement for 5 days is flagged stalled in the Account Status Report.

requirements.title: Work queues, Processing trigger and workload assignment
acceptance: An account submitted by Marketing appears in the Processing team queue with its submission date and unit.
A Processing TL re-assigns an item to another processor, who sees it under Assigned to me.
A Marketing user cannot claim a Processing item.

requirements.title: Void in-process records and distinguish reversal from cancellation
requirements.screens: Workflow panel (Void) of quotations, PRFs and accounts
acceptance: A draft account voided with reason Duplicate record disappears from the Accounts list and appears with Include voided.
A booked account has no Void action; it is cancelled through a cancellation (FR-NB-116).
The Account Status Report shows VOIDED and CANCELLED as different outcomes.

requirements.title: Protect every document that leaves BIBS
requirements.screens: Send via Email dialog of quotations, PRFs, slips, Insurance Advice and e-policy dispatch; Outbound Messages
acceptance: A quotation e-mailed to a client arrives as an encrypted PDF, and the password arrives in a second e-mail.
A batch of 10 e-policies is sent with each file protected and each password e-mail logged.
A user without view rights on an account cannot open its documents.

requirements.title: Enforce validation and approval before a document is sent
requirements.screens: Quotation page; PRF page (Quotation Slip, Proposal Slip tabs)
acceptance: A draft quotation cannot be sent, even by a direct request.
The maker of a quotation cannot approve it.
A quotation slip is e-mailed to insurers only after a second TSU officer approves it.

requirements.title: Notify users and pass data to BDOI systems
acceptance: The Processing team receives a notification when an account is submitted.
A user who turns on e-mail for returns receives an e-mail when an account is returned to them.

requirements.title: Keep a complete audit trail
requirements.screens: History tab of every record; Audit Trail
acceptance: A changed client e-mail shows the old and new value, user and time on the client's History tab.
No screen or direct request allows audit rows to be changed or deleted.

requirements.title: Upload, name and link documents
requirements.screens: Documents tab of clients, quotations, PRFs and accounts; KYC & Documents tab
acceptance: Five files uploaded in one step are stored with their type and linked to the account.
An .exe file is refused with ATTACHMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.
A Motor account without an IDF cannot be submitted (MISSING_DOCUMENTS).
A file linked to three accounts appears on the Documents tab of each.

requirements.title: View and download client and account documents
requirements.screens: Documents tab (client, account); KYC & Documents tab
acceptance: A user downloads the ID and KYC form of a client as one ZIP.
The account page shows the e-policy uploaded by Processing.

requirements.title: Upload records in bulk with a standard template
requirements.screens: Bulk Uploads; Bulk Upload wizard of each upload type
acceptance: A file with 100 rows, 3 of them invalid, commits 97 rows and the error report lists the 3 with reasons.
A file with a missing column is refused with BULK_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH and no row is processed.
The template downloaded from the wizard is accepted unchanged.

requirements.title: Authoritative source per data element
acceptance: The policy number field of an account is read-only on the account screens.

requirements.title: Search clients and view their details
acceptance: A search by mobile number and segment returns only the clients matching both.
The client page shows the client's accounts on the Linked Records tab.

requirements.title: Create a client (individual or corporate)
acceptance: An AO creates a prospect with only the type and name; it gets a PR code and the incomplete flag.
A TIN entered as 123456789 is refused with CLIENT_TIN_FORMAT.
A client with the same TIN as an existing client is refused and the message names the existing code.

requirements.title: Update client details
acceptance: A changed address is visible at once and the History tab shows the old address.
An inactive client has no Edit action.

requirements.title: Prevent duplicate clients
acceptance: A second client with the same last name, first name and birth date is refused and the attempt is in the audit trail.
A client with the same mobile as another is saved with a warning.

requirements.title: Onboard the client - KYC, verification and confirmation
requirements.screens: Client page (workflow panel, KYC & Documents tab)
acceptance: A prospect without a valid ID cannot be submitted for KYC; the message names the missing document.
The AO who submitted the KYC cannot verify it.
After confirmation, the client shows both PR and CL codes and the status Confirmed client.
An account cannot be created from a quotation of an unconfirmed client (CLIENT_NOT_CONFIRMED).

requirements.title: Create and update clients in bulk
requirements.screens: Bulk Upload (Bulk client creation and update)
acceptance: An upload of 50 rows with 5 existing client codes updates those 5 and creates 45 prospects.
A row with an invalid mobile is refused and listed in the error report.

requirements.title: Maintain client and account tags and special instructions
requirements.screens: Client page (Tags & Instructions tab); instructions banner on client, quotation, PRF and account pages
acceptance: A billing instruction on a client appears as a banner on each of the client's accounts.
Removing a tag keeps the earlier tag in the change history.

requirements.title: Client 360 view and linkage checks
requirements.screens: Client page (Linked Records, Quotation, Confirmed Proposals, History tabs)
acceptance: A client with two accounts and one booked invoice shows all three on Linked Records.
A client whose KYC has expired shows the warning "KYC expired".

requirements.title: Monthly list of clients due for KYC review
acceptance: On the 1st of the month, the AO receives a notification with the count of non-bank clients due.
The list filtered on high risk shows only high-risk clients and exports to Excel with the same rows.

requirements.title: Receive quotation and proposal requests
requirements.screens: Quotation Requests; Capture Quotation Request dialog; Bulk Upload (Quotation requests)
acceptance: An e-mailed request captured with the e-mail attached gets a REQ number and appears under To Quote.
A request file loaded from the HLS extract creates one request per row with channel HLS.
The same HLS reference loaded twice is refused the second time.

requirements.title: Create an individual quotation with its premium
acceptance: A quotation for a prospect is saved and shows the incomplete-client flag.
A saved quotation has a QT number, an ARN and version 1.
A quotation with an item without sum insured cannot be submitted (QUOTATION_NOT_RATED).

requirements.title: Edit a quotation before approval and keep its versions
requirements.screens: Edit Quotation; Quotation page (Versions tab, Compare versions)
acceptance: Revising a sent quotation creates version 2; version 1 stays readable.
Compare versions shows the changed sum insured and the premium difference.

requirements.title: Approve or return a quotation
acceptance: The maker cannot approve the quotation.
An approved quotation cannot be edited except by Revise.
A returned quotation is in DRAFT with the reason visible.

requirements.title: Send quotations and their supporting documents to clients, singly or in a batch
requirements.screens: Quotation page (Send); Quotations (Send via Email batch action); Send via Email dialog
acceptance: Three approved quotations of two clients selected together produce two e-mails and two password e-mails.
A batch of an approved and a draft quotation sends the approved one and lists the draft one as not sent with its reason; a batch of draft quotations only is refused with QUOTATION_BATCH_INVALID.
A quotation sent with two ticked supporting documents arrives with the quotation and the two documents, protected; Send documents only sends the documents without changing the quotation's stage.
A quotation whose product requires a supporting document for sending is not sent until the document is on its Documents tab; the other quotations of the batch are sent.
The quotation shows the delivery status of its last sending (Sent, or Failed with the reason).

requirements.title: Record client acceptance and create the accounts
requirements.screens: Quotation page (Record Acceptance, Create Accounts); Bulk Quotation Acceptance
acceptance: A quotation with risk groups 1 and 2, of which the client accepts group 1, creates one account with the quotation's ARN.
Accepting without the acceptance e-mail is refused.
A bulk acceptance of 20 ARNs with createAccounts creates the accounts of the confirmed clients and lists the others as failed.

requirements.title: Create quotations in bulk
acceptance: An upload of 30 HLS requests for product PAR01 creates 30 quotations, each with its own ARN.
A row with a new name creates a prospect and a quotation for it.
An upload of 10 rows of which 2 have no sum insured creates 8 quotations, each a separate document with its own number, and returns the 2 rows with their reason.

requirements.title: One Account Reference Number from quotation to invoice
requirements.screens: ARN chip on every quotation, PRF, account, slip, advice and invoice page; Account by ARN
acceptance: The ARN of a quotation appears unchanged on its account, placement slip and booked invoice.
The Booked Accounts Register and the Placement Update Report can be filtered by that ARN.

requirements.title: Create and submit a Proposal Request Form
requirements.screens: Proposal Requests; New Proposal Request; Edit Proposal Request
acceptance: A new PRF gets the next PRF number of the year and an ARN; no two PRFs share a number.
A PRF without its mandatory documents cannot be submitted.
The PRF number cannot be edited on any screen.

requirements.title: Approve a PRF (Marketing)
requirements.screens: Proposal Requests (For Approval tab); Proposal Request page
acceptance: The AO who submitted the PRF cannot approve it.
An approved PRF appears in the TSU Workbench.

requirements.title: Receive, amend, return or delete PRFs (TSU)
acceptance: A PRF approved by Marketing appears in the TSU Workbench within the Received tile.
A PRF returned by TSU is back in the AO's drafts with the reason.
TSU can filter the queue by stage and search by PRF number.

requirements.title: Prepare, approve and send the Quotation Slip
requirements.screens: Proposal Request page (Quotation Slip tab, Routing and insurers)
acceptance: The preparer cannot approve their own slip.
An approved slip reaches each selected insurer as a protected PDF and the E-mails tab lists each send.
A failed send can be resent from the E-mails tab.

requirements.title: Key in insurer terms
acceptance: TSU records terms for two insurers and a decline for a third; the comparative table shows the two offers.
A change of premium on a saved response keeps the earlier premium in the history.

requirements.title: Compile the comparative table
acceptance: A PRF with three responses shows the cheapest insurer first and flags it as lowest premium.
After a premium change, the table shows the new premium without any manual step.
The Excel export contains the same rows as the screen.

requirements.title: Generate, approve and release the Proposal Slip
requirements.screens: Proposal Request page (Proposal Slip tab, Archived versions)
acceptance: A proposal slip cannot reach Marketing before a second TSU officer approves it.
After a return and a new submission, both versions are listed under Archived versions.

requirements.title: Send the proposal, record acceptance and create the accounts
requirements.screens: Proposal Request page; client page (Confirmed Proposals tab)
acceptance: An accepted PRF creates its account with the chosen insurer and the quoted rate.
The client page lists the accepted PRF under Confirmed Proposals.

requirements.title: Search accounts and view their details
requirements.screens: Accounts; Account page; Account by ARN
acceptance: A search by engine number finds the Motor account that insures the vehicle.
The quick filter Returned to me lists the AO's accounts in RETURNED_TO_MARKETING.

requirements.title: Create an account (individual)
acceptance: An account with two PN numbers and three insured items is saved and priced.
A draft left after typing is found under My drafts with the last autosaved values.
A Motor account whose plate number is on a live account is refused and the message names the existing ARN.

requirements.title: Compute the premium (Appendix A)
requirements.screens: Premium tab of quotations and accounts; Premium Calculator
acceptance: A Property item of TSI 1,000,000 at 0.25% gives net premium 2,500.00, DST 312.50, premium tax 300.00, FST 50.00 plus LGT.
A DST of 101.20 is rounded to 101.50.
A pro-rata period of 180 days gives 180/365 of the annual premium without the minimum premium.

requirements.title: Prevent duplicate accounts
requirements.screens: New Account; Edit Account; bulk account uploads
acceptance: A second Motor account with the same chassis number is refused and names the first ARN.
A CTPL account for a vehicle insured under MTR08 is accepted.
A Fire account for the same client, address and insured items as a live account is refused.

requirements.title: Update, submit and validate an account
requirements.screens: Edit Account; Account page (workflow panel, check panel)
acceptance: A submitted account can no longer be edited by Marketing.
An account of a prospect cannot be validated.
Processing corrects the plate number of a submitted account and validates it; the history shows the change.

requirements.title: Create and update accounts in bulk
acceptance: An upload of 200 CBG Fire accounts creates the valid rows as drafts and lists duplicates with the existing ARN.
With the parameter submit, the created accounts are in SUBMITTED.
An update row with an ARN in PLACED is refused with ACCOUNT_NOT_EDITABLE.

requirements.title: Account-level contact details
acceptance: An account created for a client with e-mail a@x.ph shows that e-mail as account contact.
An e-policy is dispatched to the account contact e-mail when it differs from the client's.

requirements.title: Handle accounts returned to Marketing
requirements.screens: Accounts (Returned to me); My Work; Account page
acceptance: A returned account shows the reason on its page and in Returned to me.
After resubmission the account is back in the Processing queue.

requirements.title: Maintain the Free First Year register
requirements.screens: FFY Register; Account page (Tags card); Bulk Upload (Free First Year tagging)
acceptance: An account tagged FFY from 1-Mar-2026 shows the end 28-Feb-2027 in the register.
A cancelled FFY tag keeps its dates and shows the cancellation reason.
An upload row whose engine number matches two accounts is refused and names both ARNs.

requirements.title: Identify and tag direct-payment accounts
requirements.screens: New Account (Payment); Direct Payment; Account page (Tags card)
acceptance: A direct-payment account goes from validation to Ready for placement without a payment.
The booked invoice of a direct-payment account has no client premium receivable.
The arrangement cannot change after the payment gate.

requirements.title: Generate the placement slip when the prerequisites are met
requirements.screens: Placement Workbench (For Placement); Generate Placement Slips dialog; Placement Slips; Account Placement
acceptance: An account awaiting payment cannot be put on a slip; the dialog names PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED.
Five accounts of two insurer branches produce two slips.
Regenerating a slip after a return creates version 2 and marks version 1 superseded.

requirements.title: Send the placement slip to the insurer
requirements.screens: Placement Slips (Send, Send Slips); Placement Workbench (Send Slips)
acceptance: A sent slip moves its accounts to Placed with the slip reference and date.
A failed e-mail is shown as failed and can be resent.

requirements.title: Request a 30-day hold cover from the insurer
acceptance: A hold cover requested on 1-Jun expires on 1-Jul and the e-mail is in the account's E-mails tab.
A second request while one is open is refused.

requirements.title: Record the insurer's hold cover confirmation
requirements.screens: Account Placement (Hold Cover panel); Placement Workbench (Hold cover expiring tile); Placement Update Report
acceptance: A confirmed hold cover shows its reference and expiry on the account and in the Placement Update Report.
A hold cover expiring in 4 days raises one alert to Processing.

requirements.title: Handle placements returned by the insurer
requirements.screens: Placement Workbench (Returned by insurer tile); Account Placement (Insurer Returns); Record Insurer Return dialog
acceptance: A returned account appears in the Returned by insurer tile with the insurer's remarks.
After resubmission and a new slip, the account is Placed again and the return shows as resolved.

requirements.title: Cancel placement of one or several accounts
acceptance: Cancelling three accounts, one of which is already booked, cancels two and reports the third as refused.
A cancelled placement appears with status Placement cancelled in the Account Status Report.

requirements.title: Reactivate cancelled placements
acceptance: A reactivated account is in Ready for placement and can be put on a new slip.

requirements.title: Include the EOPT details of the client in the placement sent to the insurer
requirements.screens: Placement Workbench (For Placement, Send Slips); Generate Placement Slips dialog; Placement Slips; Client record
acceptance: A slip generated for a client with a TIN and a registered address shows the taxpayer name, TIN and registered address in the PDF and the Excel file.
When the client's TIN is corrected after the slip was generated and before it is sent, the slip sent to the insurer is a new version with the corrected TIN, and the earlier version is superseded.
A slip of a client without EOPT details is generated with the details shown as not available.

requirements.title: Generate the CLPC billing file (CBG Fire)
requirements.screens: CLPC Billing (CBG Fire Awaiting Payment, Billing Batches)
acceptance: A batch of 40 CBG Fire accounts downloads as .ods with the 40 rows and all columns.
An account already billed and unpaid is not offered for a second batch.

requirements.title: Match payment reports (CLPC and other segments)
requirements.screens: CLPC Billing (Payment Reports); Payment Report page; Upload Payment Report dialog
acceptance: A CLPC report with 38 paid and 2 unpaid lines releases the 38 accounts and leaves 2 awaiting payment.
A reference report line with an unknown ARN is listed as UNMATCHED and can be matched by hand.
The Matched and Unmatched Payments report shows each line with its result.

requirements.title: Apply the payment gate per segment
requirements.screens: Account Placement (Payment Gate panel); Placement Workbench (Awaiting payment)
acceptance: A CBG Motor account cannot pass the gate with a client confirmation.
A CGL account passes the gate on a recorded client confirmation.
A direct-payment account never waits at the gate.

requirements.title: Receive e-policies and store them with the account
requirements.screens: E-policy Upload (single, bulk); Issuance Workbench (Placed - awaiting policy)
acceptance: A bulk upload of 10 e-policies named by ARN matches all 10 to their accounts.
An e-policy for an account awaiting payment is refused.

requirements.title: Extract policy details and update the policy number
acceptance: A text e-policy fills the policy number in the review; after confirmation the account shows it and is Policy issued.
A 3-year account cannot be confirmed with one policy number.

requirements.title: Trigger processes from uploaded documents
acceptance: Uploading an EPOLICY document to a placed account opens an extraction review task.

requirements.title: Generate the Insurance Advice for mortgaged accounts
requirements.screens: Insurance Advice (Generate Insurance Advice); Issuance Workbench (IA to generate)
acceptance: A mortgaged account gets its advice automatically when its policy is confirmed.
An account without mortgagee is refused with IA_NOT_MORTGAGED.

requirements.title: Access, download, save and send Insurance Advices
acceptance: A user searches by policy number, views the advice details and downloads the advice PDF.
Three advices selected together are downloaded and saved to the chosen folder.
Three advices sent together arrive protected, each followed by its password e-mail.

requirements.title: Send e-policies to clients
requirements.screens: E-policy Dispatch (Ready to Dispatch, Send E-policies); Issuance Workbench (Ready to dispatch)
acceptance: A batch of 20 e-policies is sent, each protected, and the dispatch report lists 20 sent.
An e-policy still in review cannot be sent.

requirements.title: Report sent and failed e-policies
acceptance: A failed dispatch appears under Failed with its reason.
The counts per outcome match the lists.

requirements.title: Send the Insurance Advice automatically to the enrolled recipient
requirements.screens: Insurance Advice register (Sending column); Insurance Advice recipient set-up (Broking Setup)
acceptance: An advice generated for an account whose mortgagee is enrolled is sent automatically to the enrolled recipient, encrypted, with the password in a separate e-mail; the register shows Automatic and Sent.
An advice of a mortgagee that is not enrolled is not sent automatically and waits in the register.
An enrolled mortgagee without a recipient address leaves the advice Generated with the reason, and Processing is notified.

requirements.title: Book an account with its GL entry and service invoice
requirements.screens: Booking Workbench (Ready to Book); Pre-booking Confirmation; Booked Invoice
acceptance: Booking an issued account creates the invoice, the balanced journal and the service invoice, and the account shows Booked.
If the journal cannot be posted, the account stays Policy issued and no invoice exists.
Booking the same account twice returns the existing invoice.

requirements.title: Book individually or in batch, on schedule or by upload
requirements.screens: Booking Workbench (Ready to Book, Queued for Batch, Booked Today, Failed); Batch Runs; Upload Bookings
acceptance: Ten accounts queued and confirmed are booked by the evening run; one without cost center fails and the others are booked.
An entry removed from the queue is not booked.
An upload of 50 ARNs books the valid rows and lists the failures.

requirements.title: Book automatically on defined criteria and never twice
acceptance: With a rule for product CTP01, a CTP01 account is queued automatically when its policy is confirmed.
A second booking call for the same ARN does not create a second invoice.

requirements.title: Book directly when the policy is already issued
acceptance: An account without a policy copy cannot be directly booked.
A directly booked account has no placement slip and is booked with its invoice.

requirements.title: Book multi-year policies
requirements.screens: Booked Invoice (Invoices of the Account); Pre-booking Confirmation
acceptance: A 5-year account shows five invoices with five policy numbers, year 1 booked and years 2-5 scheduled.
Year 2 is booked by the batch run on its start date.

requirements.title: Post financial and non-financial endorsements
acceptance: A positive endorsement of +500,000 sum insured on a Fire account posts an EN invoice with additional premium on the remaining days.
A negative endorsement larger than the premium in force is refused.

requirements.title: Cancel booked accounts
acceptance: A flat cancellation reverses the whole premium and commission and the account shows Cancelled.
A partial cancellation returns the premium of the unexpired days.

requirements.title: Generate and send service invoices
requirements.screens: Service Invoices; Service Invoice page; Booking Setup (Service Invoice Types)
acceptance: Booking an account issues an INSURER_COMMISSION invoice and e-mails it to the insurer.
A failed dispatch notifies the owner and appears as FAILED with its reason in the register.
A successful dispatch notifies the owner with the recipients, and the register shows the status, the owner and the time of the sending.

requirements.title: Mark booked and fully paid transactions with an incentive eligibility indicator
requirements.screens: Booked Invoice; Booked Accounts Register; Incentive Criteria (BRD-3)
acceptance: A booked invoice that is unpaid or partly paid shows the indicator Pending (not fully paid) and no criterion code.
When the invoice becomes fully paid, an invoice on a product covered by an active criterion shows Incentive = Eligible and the criterion code; the decision and the rules applied are in the history.
A financial endorsement posted after full payment that changes a criterion attribute re-evaluates the indicator, and the history shows both decisions.
Cancelling the booking sets the indicator to Not eligible with the reason.
The indicator cannot be edited on the invoice.

requirements.title: Capture the cost center and business type of every booking
requirements.screens: Pre-booking Confirmation; Booking Workbench (Edit); Booked Invoice; Booked Accounts Register
acceptance: A booking without cost center is refused with COST_CENTER_REQUIRED.
The Booked Accounts Register shows the cost center and the NB / Renewal column of each invoice.

requirements.title: New Business dashboard
requirements.screens: NB Dashboard (landing page of the broking roles)
acceptance: An account submitted a minute ago is counted in Accounts by Stage when the dashboard is refreshed.
Clicking the Placed bar opens the Accounts list filtered on Placed.

requirements.title: Placement Update Report (individual and collective)
acceptance: The report for one ARN shows only that account.
The collective report for June groups the accounts by insurer.

requirements.title: Operational reports - stage outcomes, status, placement, billing, payments, production
acceptance: The Account Status Report with the exception filter Breach lists only accounts past their SLA.
The Placement Summary shows the failed e-mails of each insurer.
Production for a team shows bookings against the team's monthly target and the achievement percentage.

requirements.title: Role-based reports and saved report variants
acceptance: A Marketing AO does not see the CLPC Billing Report.
A shared variant "SLA breaches - all stages" runs for another TL with the same parameters.

requirements.title: Print reports
acceptance: A printed Account Status Report shows the report name, user, date and the filters applied.
The printout has the same number of rows as the screen.

requirements.title: Download reports in several formats
acceptance: The ODS and XLSX files of the same run contain the same rows.
A user without the report's permission cannot download it.

requirements.title: Late Renewal Requests Report
acceptance: The variant lists only renewals received after the expiry date, within the user's scope.

requirements.title: Log in with a role profile; inactivity and sign-out warnings
acceptance: A Processing user logs in and sees the Processing screens only.
After 15 minutes without activity the warning appears.
The System Administrator logs in from a BDO workstation with the System Administrator profile.

requirements.title: Open BIBS in several browser tabs
acceptance: A user opens an account in a second tab without a log-in prompt.
Signing out in one tab signs out the other tabs.

requirements.title: Maintain lists of values with effectivity and approval
acceptance: A new return reason is usable only after another user authorises it.
A value effective from next month is not offered today.

requirements.title: Approve pending requests in My Approvals
acceptance: A pending access request and a pending list value both appear in the approver's inbox.
Rejecting without a reason is refused.

requirements.title: Define profiles, assign functions and roles
requirements.screens: Roles & Permissions; Users; User Access Matrix
acceptance: The matrix shows that only the Adjustment role holds BOOKING_ADJUST.
The Excel export lists every role and permission shown on screen.

requirements.title: Submit profile creation and modification requests for approval
requirements.screens: Access Requests; New Access Request dialog; request detail
acceptance: A user created by request exists only after another user approves it.
The requester cannot approve his own request.

requirements.title: View and export the audit log report
acceptance: The Business Administrator exports one day's audit rows to Excel.

requirements.title: Apply the retention policy
acceptance: The review lists voided quotations older than 5 years.
No record is deleted by a review run.

requirements.title: Log in to BIBS
acceptance: A user with valid credentials and an Operations role logs in and sees the Operations menu sections of the role.
A user with wrong credentials is refused and no session is created.
The account locks after the configured number of failed attempts.

requirements.title: Restrict each action to authorised roles
acceptance: A Remittance Processor sees the Remittance screens and not the Cashiering Setup or the Disbursement queue.
A direct approval request by a user without the approval permission is refused and logged.
A Marketing Collection user sees Remittance Holds, Special Remittance and BIR 2307 tagging but cannot approve a hold.

requirements.title: Present the Operations home by role
requirements.screens: Operations Home; Cashiering, Remittance, Adjustment, Reconciliation and Commission workbenches
acceptance: A Cashier sees the Cashiering card with its tiles immediately after log-in and does not see the Remittance card.
Clicking "Batches for Approval" opens Remittance Batches filtered on the For Approval stage.
The home loads within 5 seconds (section 8).

requirements.title: Keep the invoice ledger of every booked invoice
acceptance: A booked invoice appears in Invoice Search with its components equal to the booking, status UNPAID and WITH_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE.
A payment applied to the invoice shows as an APPLIED movement with the AR number, date and amount per component.
A Remittance Processor opening Invoice 360 of a paid invoice sees the payment history (payment date, amount applied, AR number) and has no action to change a payment application.
A direct payment account booked in New Business shows the DP chip and payment status NOT_APPLICABLE.
Replaying an invoice already in the ledger changes nothing.

requirements.title: View an invoice in Invoice 360
acceptance: Searching ARN-2026-940001 lists its booking and endorsement invoices; opening one shows its receipts, remittance batch and insurer OR.
An invoice on hold shows the hold pill and the hold request in the Remittances tab with its dates.
A partial search on the assured name returns the matching invoices regardless of case.

requirements.title: Lock invoices while a team works on them
requirements.screens: Invoice 360 (lock pill); Remittance Batch; Adjustment request page
acceptance: An endorsement request on an invoice that is in a remittance batch is refused with INVOICE_LOCKED naming REMITTANCE.
A payment applied to an invoice locked by Adjustment is accepted.
Excluding the invoice from the batch releases the lock.

requirements.title: Split invoice amounts by insurer share (co-insurance)
acceptance: A 60/40 co-insured invoice shows both insurers on Invoice 360.
A premium decrease of 1,000.00 on it is split 600.00 / 400.00 on the request's insurer breakdown.

requirements.title: Continue batch jobs past failed records and report the run
requirements.screens: Bulk Upload wizard (run summary); Payment Uploads; Interfaces (runs, records); Report CSH-BATCH-RUN
acceptance: A payment file with 10 rows, one with an unknown invoice, commits 9 rows and reports 1 unapplied or failed row with its reason.
The run report CSH-BATCH-RUN lists successful, unsuccessful, applied, unapplied and failed records.
Reprocessing a corrected failed row applies it without reprocessing the others.

requirements.title: Generate, view and export Operations reports
acceptance: An Auditor views CSH-APPLIED-PREM on screen but cannot download it.
A Cashier downloads the same report as Excel.
The Report Archive lists the run with its parameters and creator.

requirements.title: Maintain AR and OR series per branch
acceptance: A branch AR takes the next number of the branch series; an OR takes the next Head Office OR number.
An OR from a branch series is refused with OR_HEAD_OFFICE_ONLY.
When the last number is used, the next receipt is refused with RECEIPT_SERIES_DEPLETED.
No two receipts carry the same number.

requirements.title: Receive a payment and issue an Acknowledgement Receipt
acceptance: An OTC payment on a booked invoice issues an AR with the next branch number and applies the payment; the invoice becomes PAID when fully covered.
A USD payment shows the BOOK rate and posts at that rate.
The AR prints with the number, payor, amount and invoice.

requirements.title: Issue an Official Receipt for BDOI income
acceptance: A service fee OR of 11,200.00 with 1,200.00 VAT posts the service fee income and output VAT.
A branch cashier cannot issue an OR.

requirements.title: Cancel an AR or OR
requirements.screens: Receipt page (Cancel); Receipts (Cancellations and Reinstatements tab)
acceptance: A cancelled AR puts the invoice it paid back to outstanding and reverses the AR posting.
The cashier who requested the cancellation cannot approve it.
A cancellation without a reason is refused.

requirements.title: Reinstate a cancelled receipt
requirements.priority: Must have (CSHID.013: not stated in the BRD)
acceptance: A partial reinstatement of 5,000.00 of a 10,000.00 AR applies 5,000.00 to the encoded invoice and posts OPS_RECEIPT_REINSTATE.
A reinstatement without the Unit Head of a premium reason is refused and names the missing field.
A bounced-check receipt is reinstated without the encoded fields.

requirements.title: Upload payment files for batch processing
requirements.screens: Payment Uploads (Bulk Upload wizard, run summary); Cashiering Setup (layouts)
acceptance: A Bills Payment file of 20 rows issues 20 ARs; rows with a booked invoice are applied and the others are unapplied.
Uploading the same file again is refused.
A change of the PAY_BILLS layout to FIXED_WIDTH is used by the next upload without a release.

requirements.title: Warehouse post-dated checks
acceptance: A PDC with maturity today is applied by the job, with its AR, and shows APPLIED.
A check warehoused twice is refused.
The PDC Warehousing report lists the warehoused checks with AR date, AR number, maturity, client, amount, bank, branch, check number and segment.

requirements.title: Match payments at acceptance and handle pre-booked payments
requirements.screens: Receive Payment (preview); Pre-booked Payments; Payment Uploads (run summary)
acceptance: A payment of 10,000.00 on a booked invoice of 10,000.00 is APPLIED in full.
For a 2% CWT client the same payment applies 9,800.00 and leaves 200.00 unapplied.
A payment by ARN before booking is PREBOOKED and is applied automatically when the invoice is booked.
A payment quoting a cancelled invoice becomes unapplied with origin CANCELLED_REFERENCE.

requirements.title: Apply payments by premium component hierarchy
acceptance: A partial payment of 1,500.00 on an invoice with DST 1,000.00, VAT 1,200.00 and basic 10,000.00 applies 1,000.00 to DST and 500.00 to VAT.
The receipt's Journal tab shows the OPS_PAYMENT_APPLY entry balanced.

requirements.title: Receive non-premium payments of insurers (AR Insurance)
requirements.screens: Receive Payment (AR class AR Insurance); Receipts
requirements.priority: Must have (not stated for this ID in the BRD)
acceptance: An insurer refund received as AR Insurance posts Dr bank / Cr AR Insurer and does not change any client invoice.

requirements.title: Issue commission ORs from commission payment details
acceptance: Three payment lines of one insurer and certificate are issued as one OR with three lines.
A remittance batch of five invoices, once approved, carries one commission OR number.

requirements.title: Manage unapplied payments and their dispositions
requirements.screens: Unapplied Payments (tabs Unapplied, Monitoring, For Approval, For Reversal, Done); Unapplied Payment page
acceptance: An excess of 500.00 applied to another booked invoice of the client clears 500.00 of that invoice in hierarchy order.
A refund needs TL approval and creates a Disbursement request; the item is Done when Disbursement pays it.
The cashier who submitted a refund cannot approve it.
The tabs show each item in the tab of its stage.

requirements.title: Clear minimal balances when the payment is processed
requirements.screens: Receive Payment (preview); Receipt page (Applications, Journal); Cashiering Setup (Minimal Balance); Reports CSH-MINBAL-PREMIUM, CSH-MINBAL-EXCESS
acceptance: A payment of 9,995.00 on an invoice of 10,000.00 clears the remaining 5.00 in the same posting; no unapplied item and no disposition are created.
A payment of 10,008.00 on an invoice of 10,000.00 moves the excess of 8.00 to AP overages; the Unapplied tab shows nothing for it.
A payment of 10,050.00 on an invoice of 10,000.00 creates an unapplied item of 50.00 (above the threshold).
A remaining balance of 5.00 that equals the DST charged is not reversed.
Running the safety-net sweep after these payments changes nothing.

requirements.title: Search receipts and keep the receipt audit trail
acceptance: A search by partial assured name and date range returns the matching ARs.
The History tab of a cancelled AR shows the creation, the cancellation request and approval with users and times.

The audit record of a receipt cancellation shows the user, the event type, the module Cashiering, the status before and after, the origin of the event, the date and time and Success; a cancellation refused for lack of permission is recorded with Failure.

requirements.title: Print ARs and ORs in batch
acceptance: A batch of 50 ARs of one branch is produced as one PDF within 10 seconds (section 8).
A failed receipt is listed and printed on retry.

requirements.title: Post the accounting entries of Cashiering
requirements.priority: Must have (CSHID.013: not stated in the BRD)
acceptance: Issuing, applying and cancelling an AR produce three balanced journals; the cancellation nets the first two to zero.
A USD AR posts pesos at the BOOK rate of the receipt date.

requirements.title: Generate the Cashiering reports
acceptance: CSH-APPLIED-PREM lists AR no., date, amount paid, invoice, payor, risk code, count and total for the chosen dates, in PDF and Excel.
CSH-CANCELLED-AR lists the cancelled ARs with their reason.

requirements.title: Extract remittances by schedule, insurer or invoice
acceptance: The scheduled run extracts a paid and cleared invoice of INS-MGIC into a batch RMB-INS-MGIC-2026-n with tag EXTRACTED and locks it.
An invoice on hold is tagged UNEXTRACTED_DUE with reason ON_HOLD.
A manual extraction of an invoice of another insurer is refused with REMIT_INVOICE_INSURER.
An invoice queued for the end of day is extracted by the evening run, once.
An invoice taken by a manual (ad hoc) extraction shows the source Manual on Invoice 360, and the next scheduled run does not extract it again.

requirements.title: Apply the remittance eligibility rules
requirements.screens: Extraction (run tags); DTIP Status; Report REM-PAIDAR-OVER-DTIP; Report REM-EXCLUDED
acceptance: An invoice paid by check two banking days ago is UNEXTRACTED_DUE with CHECK_HOLDING and is extracted on the third banking day.
An invoice with paid AR 10,500.00 and DTIP 10,000.00 is excluded and listed on REM-PAIDAR-OVER-DTIP with invoice, insurer, paid AR and DTIP.
A written-off invoice is never in a batch and shows WRITTEN_OFF on Invoice 360.
Submitting a negative adjustment on an invoice in a batch notifies the Remittance Team.
An invoice with a pending increase in TSI is not extracted and its tag reads Pending financial endorsement; once the endorsement is posted the next run extracts it.

requirements.title: Review a batch and exclude records (addendum)
requirements.screens: Remittance Batches (queues by stage); Remittance Batch (totals, lines, exclusions, preview)
acceptance: The processor cannot change the paid AR or commission of a line.
Excluding a line removes it from the totals and the preview and unlocks the invoice.
A restored line is back in the totals.
Only the remaining lines are posted on approval.
The list of extracted accounts shows for each account the insurer, policy number, invoice, remittance type and batch number of the remittance schedule.

requirements.title: Process a batch - assign, submit, hold and return
acceptance: A batch with one line placed on hold after extraction cannot be submitted; the message names the invoice and HOLD.
A returned batch releases its invoices; the next run extracts them again.
The TL re-assigns a batch; the new processor sees it in the queue.

requirements.title: Produce the remittance schedule and payment request
acceptance: The schedule of an approved batch lists each invoice with paid AR, realised commission, VAT, WTAX, DTIP and net due, and the totals equal the batch totals.
The payment request shows the payable amount, insurer and approver.
A batch in review produces a schedule marked Draft with the current lines; after submission the schedule is issued without the Draft mark.

requirements.title: Approve a batch, post the remittance and request payment
acceptance: The processor who submitted a batch cannot approve it.
Approval posts one balanced OPS_REMITTANCE journal per line and one payment request for the payable.
The batch shows the commission OR number issued by Cashiering.

requirements.title: Follow Disbursement and track remittance status
requirements.screens: Remittance Batch (workflow panel, history); Invoice 360 (Remittances); Disbursement Queue
acceptance: A DV assigned for the full payable makes the batch FULLY_REMITTED and unlocks its invoices.
A user who switched off OPS_DISBURSEMENT_STATUS e-mails still sees the in-app notice.

requirements.title: Upload the insurer OR schedule and report exceptions
requirements.screens: Insurer OR Upload (upload, history); Report REM-OR-EXCEPTION
requirements.priority: Must have (RMTID.016: not stated in the BRD)
acceptance: An upload with the OR of every line moves the batch to OR_RECEIVED.
An OR amount 100.00 below the paid AR is AMOUNT_MISMATCH and listed on REM-OR-EXCEPTION.
A row without OR number is refused with its line number.

requirements.title: Apply the early remittance incentive
acceptance: A CBG motor invoice remitted 20 days after the start of the window is in a With Incentives batch with a 2% incentive shown on its own line; its commission and net due are unchanged.
The same invoice remitted after 40 days has no incentive.
An invoice of a product the rule does not cover (for example CBG marine) has no incentive.

requirements.title: Search remittance accounts and payment details
acceptance: Searching "dela cruz" finds the invoices of assured "DELA CRUZ, JUAN".
Searching a batch number lists the invoices of the batch.

requirements.title: Process special remittance requests in Remittance
acceptance: Approving a special remittance creates a SPECIAL batch containing the invoice.
The requester receives a notice with the request number when the batch is pushed to Disbursement.

requirements.title: Generate the Remittance reports
acceptance: REM-TRACKER lists insurer, remit type, batch number, accounts extracted, net due, incentive and due date.
REM-DTIP-DETAIL lists the outstanding DTIP per invoice with the ageing columns of Annex III #6.

requirements.title: Raise an endorsement or cancellation request
requirements.screens: New Request (wizard); Change Request; Endorsement Request page
acceptance: A flat cancellation of a booked invoice is raised with a reason and submitted; the invoice shows PENDING_NEG_ADJ and the lock.
A request on an invoice in a remittance batch is refused with INVOICE_LOCKED.
A non-financial change of assured information is raised without amounts.
Choosing three invoices raises three requests.

requirements.title: Detect duplicate endorsement requests
acceptance: A second flat cancellation of the same invoice with the same reason is refused until a justification is given.

requirements.title: Attach supporting documents to endorsement requests
acceptance: A PDF endorsement copy uploaded to a request is listed and opens from the Documents tab.

requirements.title: Validate, approve or return endorsement requests
requirements.screens: Adjustment Workbench (tabs per stage); Endorsement Request page (workflow panel); Posting Batches
acceptance: The processor who validated a request cannot approve it.
An extension of cover with additional premium cannot skip the approval.
A request returned from the posting batch is not posted and the requester sees the reason.

A request raised by an Adjustment Processor and returned at validation appears in the work of the Marketing owner of the account, who corrects and resubmits it; the request page then shows one return and one resubmission.

requirements.title: Recompute premium, commission and refund per insurer (addendum)
requirements.screens: New Request (Recompute step); Endorsement Request page (Recompute)
acceptance: A decrease in TSI of a 60/40 co-insured invoice shows the premium and commission change per insurer.
A commission increase without premium change issues a service invoice at posting.
The recompute of a flat cancellation equals the amounts posted by booking.
A flat cancellation of a policy with a later endorsement shows Before as the premium in force of the policy year and After as zero for every component.
A TSI change submitted without an effective date is refused and nothing is recomputed or stored.

requirements.title: Handle a TSI increase above the package limit
requirements.screens: New Request; Endorsement Request page (Quotation No.)
acceptance: A TSI increase above the package limit cannot be validated before the quotation number is linked.
A TSI increase within the limit needs no quotation.

requirements.title: Post requests singly or in batches
requirements.screens: Posting Batches; Batch Request Upload; Endorsement Request page (Accounting)
acceptance: A batch of three requests posts all three; a fourth with a locked invoice fails without stopping the others.
The Validation List (FR-OP-062) shows the GL lines of the posted requests.

requirements.title: Set up excess payments, re-apply payments and AR Insurer
requirements.screens: Endorsement Request page; Adjustment Workbench (Payments to Re-apply); Unapplied Payments
acceptance: Cancelling a fully paid, not remitted invoice of 10,000.00 creates an unapplied item of 10,000.00.
Cancelling a remitted invoice sets up AR Insurer equal to the remitted DTIP and keeps PENDING_NEG_ADJ.

requirements.title: Control over-adjustment and capture justifications
requirements.screens: New Request (previous adjustments, justification); Invoice 360 (adjustment totals)
acceptance: A second premium increase that takes the adjustments above 100% of the original premium needs a justification.
A decrease that would make the premium negative is refused without justification.
A request that takes the cumulative adjustments to 92% of the original premium shows the warning and can be submitted without justification.
A request whose cumulative decrease exceeds the original DTIP needs a justification.

requirements.title: Write off minimal balances from a file
acceptance: A balance of 50.00 in the file is written off and Remittance then refuses the invoice as WRITTEN_OFF.
A balance of 150.00 is refused with ADJ_BALANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE.

requirements.title: Generate the endorsement slip and the validation slip
requirements.screens: Endorsement Request page (Endorsement Slip, Validation Slip)
acceptance: The endorsement slip of a flat cancellation shows the Annex V fields and a number ES-2026-n; regenerating it keeps the number.
An internal adjustment has no endorsement slip.

requirements.title: Search requests by policy, view the policy transaction history and ageing
requirements.screens: Adjustment Workbench; Endorsement Request page (Policy, Policy Transactions, History); Invoice Search and Invoice 360 (Adjustments, Policy Transactions); Account page (Policy Transactions)
acceptance: A request submitted 3 days ago shows ageing "3 days" in the workbench.
A request submitted on 01-Oct-2026 and posted on 06-Oct-2026 shows ageing "5 days" and keeps it after posting.
The History tab shows the before and after values of each change.
Searching an ARN lists its requests and opens Invoice 360.
Searching an insurer policy number lists the requests on that policy, with the policy number, ARN, invoice, insurer and product names and placement slip in the list.

The Policy Transactions of a flat-cancelled invoice show the original booking, then the cancellation (Financial – Change of Cover, Flat Cancellation) with the negative premium and tax change, a gross premium of zero after it, status Posted and its journals, whose lines balance.

requirements.title: Generate the Adjustment reports
acceptance: The Validation List of a day matches the journals of the requests posted that day.
The daily report is archived every business day at 18:00.

requirements.title: Schedule the automatic extraction of the production register
acceptance: A monthly schedule on day 5 extracts on 5 October; when 5 October is a holiday it extracts on the next working day.

requirements.title: Extract the production register manually and view it
requirements.screens: Production Extracts (New Extract); Reconciliation Cycle (Registers Sent); Report PRC-EXTRACT-LOG
acceptance: A manual extract of INS-MGIC for September lists only accounts booked in September.
The extract shows its file name, date, time and row count, and PRC-EXTRACT-LOG shows the same count.

requirements.title: Produce the register file in the agreed layout
acceptance: In the downloaded register every column except Remarks and Incentive is locked.
Two extracts of the same insurer and month get different file names.

requirements.title: Send the register to the insurer with a cover letter
acceptance: The insurer receives the register as a protected file and the password in a second e-mail.
The extract shows the sent date and time.

requirements.title: Upload the insurer production report
acceptance: Uploading the returned register matches it and lists the insurer-only lines separately.
Uploading the same file again is refused and counted as a new attempt.
A returned line that pairs on the policy number but carries an insurer variance is Matched with Discrepancy, not Matched.

requirements.title: Match booked and insurer lines within tolerance
requirements.screens: Reconciliation Cycle (Items by bucket, side-by-side comparison)
acceptance: A gross premium difference of 0.80 is MATCHED; a difference of 1.20 is MATCHED_WITH_DISCREPANCY listing gross premium.
On a USD account with a BOOK rate of 58.00, a difference of USD 0.01 (PHP 0.58) is MATCHED and a difference of USD 0.02 (PHP 1.16) is MATCHED_WITH_DISCREPANCY.
An account the insurer did not return is BDOI_ONLY.
Booking the invoice of a waiting insurer-only line matches it automatically.

requirements.title: Follow unbooked and pre-booked insurer production
acceptance: An insurer policy whose ARN is pre-booked shows UNMATCHED_PREBOOKED with the ARN.
After booking, the line leaves the open list and shows BOOKED.

requirements.title: Review items, record feedback and pair manually
requirements.screens: Reconciliation Cycle (Items, filters, review dialog, bulk disposition)
acceptance: Filtering by AO lists only that AO's items.
The disposition set in bulk on five items appears on each item and on PRC-DISPOSITION.
Saving an instruction on an item leaves the policy number, invoice and amounts of the item and of the invoice unchanged, and the instruction shows on that item only.

requirements.title: Check the early remittance incentive applied by insurers
acceptance: An account remitted 20 days after inception under a 30-day rule is ELIGIBLE at the rule's rate.
An account of an insurer without rule is NO_RULE.

requirements.title: Close a cycle and view its history
requirements.screens: Reconciliation Cycles; Reconciliation Cycle (workflow panel, History)
acceptance: Marking the last open item for closure closes the cycle.
The History tab lists the extract, send, upload and closure with users and times.

requirements.title: Generate the Production Reconciliation reports
acceptance: PRC-SUMMARY of a cycle equals the bucket counts and amounts of the cycle.
PRC-REGISTER with insurer feedback shows the insurer remarks per account.

requirements.title: Take in the DP entries from the system tagging
requirements.screens: DP Lists (DP entries, branch submissions); DP Accounts
acceptance: A direct payment invoice confirmed by Marketing Collection appears as a DP account without any upload.
The same invoice confirmed twice gives one DP account.
A fallback list named CEB_DP_20260930.xlsx is taken in and appears for branch CEB; a list named dp list.xlsx is refused with DP_LIST_NAME.

requirements.title: Review DP entries read-only, exclude by rule and confirm eligibility from the fully paid status
requirements.screens: DP Accounts (tabs by status, account detail)
acceptance: A DP account shows its production record, commission history, remittance status and commission status and offers no field to change.
An account with a negative amount is Invalid with the rule Negative amount, stays visible and is not billed.
An account whose invoice is not fully paid is not eligible and shows the payment status as the basis; when the payment status becomes Paid the account becomes Valid without a user action.
The same invoice entered twice is highlighted as a duplicate.

requirements.title: Bill the insurer for DP commission and produce the Statement of Account
requirements.screens: DP Accounts (Prepare Billing); DP Billings; DP Billing (Send)
acceptance: Valid accounts of two insurers produce two billings.
A sent billing shows its billing date and its follow-up date 10 working days later.
The Statement of Account of an insurer lists each billed invoice with commission, collected amount and balance, and its totals equal the billings of that insurer.

requirements.title: Record insurer answers and the status of each DP account
requirements.screens: Insurer Responses (answers upload); DP Billing (answers); DP Billings
acceptance: A rejection without a reason is refused.
An approved account stays Valid and a rejected account shows Invalid with the insurer's reason in its history.
A billing without answer after the follow-up date shows overdue and raises the alert.
Rejected accounts are in the COLLECTION_DP_RETURNED extract.

requirements.title: Collect DP commission and reverse the premium receivable
acceptance: Collecting an approved billing posts the collection, shows the commission OR and records DP_REVERSAL on each account.
An account not tagged direct payment is not reversed and the message names it.
A reinstated account can be reversed again.

requirements.title: Compute and post SLA-based incentives per invoice
requirements.screens: Incentive Schemes (tier editor); Incentive Runs (compute, lines, post, cancel)
acceptance: A programme paying a fixed 1,000.00 per motor policy of basic premium 50,000.00 or more, for branch CEB, pays 1,000.00 for a fully paid CEB policy of 60,000.00 paid within the credit term, and nothing for the same policy of another branch.
An invoice that meets the criteria but was paid after the credit term, or is not fully paid, gets no incentive.
A fully cancelled invoice is excluded from a run and listed with the rule Fully cancelled.
The run lists every computed incentive per invoice with its programme and rate or amount.

requirements.title: Submit BIR certificates to Comptrollership
requirements.screens: BIR Certificates; BIR Certificate (workflow panel, ORs, scanned copy)
acceptance: A certificate without an OR cannot be submitted.
Comptrollership rejects a certificate with a reason; the handler resubmits it and it is acknowledged.

requirements.title: Track estimated items and yearly production
acceptance: A flagged invoice appears as estimated on CMR-PRODUCTION-YEARLY and on the production register.
The yearly report includes every branch and insurer with production.

requirements.title: Classify and report commission receivables
acceptance: A DP account collected and a regular invoice remitted appear in separate groups with their net commission.
A direct bill invoice tagged Priority shows Direct Billed (Priority) on the report and on the Statement of Account of its insurer.
After a partial remittance the report shows the net commission realised and the remaining balance of the invoice.

requirements.title: Age commission receivables by invoice
acceptance: An invoice billed on 01-Aug-2026 and not collected shows an age of 68 days and the bucket 61-90 on 08-Oct-2026.
After a partial collection the remaining balance keeps the age counted from the billing date.
The ageing of a collected invoice stops on its collection date and the invoice leaves the outstanding list.

requirements.title: Send the remittance schedule to the insurer
acceptance: The schedule of an approved batch is sent once; a second send is refused.

requirements.title: Request, approve, extend, cancel and release remittance holds
acceptance: An approved hold excludes the invoice from the next extraction with reason ON_HOLD.
The requester cannot approve their own hold.
A hold whose date passed is released by the job and the invoice is extracted by the next run.
Hold numbers HLD-2026-n are unique and searchable.

requirements.title: Request a special remittance
acceptance: A request on an invoice paid by a check deposited yesterday is refused with the holding reason.
A valid request moves to For approval with the note "Validated - paid AR ... applied and cleared".

requirements.title: Tag, validate and post PR 2307 reversals and route the certificates to Disbursement
requirements.screens: BIR 2307 (Tag 2307; tags, reports and routing); Invoice 360 (PR 2307, history)
acceptance: A certificate tag receives a reference CWT-2026-n and shows the computed PR 2307 amount, the outstanding PR and the CRU status.
A certificate amount above the computed PR 2307 amount is refused; so is an amount above the outstanding PR.
Validating and posting two tags of one insurer generates one BIR 2307 transaction report, zeroes the PR of both invoices and routes the report directly to Disbursement.
A batch with tags of two insurers is refused.
A tag on an invoice with an outstanding commission receivable is posted and released, and is flagged For Commission Receivable.
A tag on an invoice whose payment was already remitted cannot be posted without the insurer's written confirmation; once posted, the amount is in Unapplied Payments.
A second tag on the same invoice is refused while the first is in process.

requirements.title: Generate the endorsement slip for Marketing
acceptance: A Marketing user prints the slip of a partial cancellation request; the slip number is the one Adjustment sees.

requirements.title: Work payment requests in the Disbursement queue
acceptance: Entering the DV number of a remittance request makes its invoices FULLY_REMITTED.
A paid request cannot be returned.

requirements.title: Receive and release BIR 2307 certificates to insurers
acceptance: A routed 2307 report of one insurer appears in the Disbursement queue with its certificates and attachments.
Releasing it to the insurer changes no journal and sets the report to RELEASED.
A request returned for a missing certificate goes back to Marketing Collection with the reason.

requirements.title: Integrate with other systems through ports
acceptance: A remittance approval creates a request in the Disbursement queue.
An extract for the shared drive is stored in the list of extracts and downloadable.

requirements.title: Fetch data through flow-in feeds with runs, logs and alerts
acceptance: Uploading a hold file with one invalid row records a run with one failed record and raises the alert Interface run failed.
Uploading the same hold file again accepts no new record.

requirements.title: Confirm payments to the New Business payment gate
requirements.screens: New Business placement (payment gate); Pre-booked Payments
acceptance: A payment by ARN before booking opens the payment gate with evidence CASHIERING PRE:<id>.

requirements.title: Log in to BIBS
acceptance: A user with valid credentials and a Product Maintenance role logs in and sees the Product Maintenance menu section.
A user with wrong credentials is refused and no session is created.
The account locks after three failed attempts (LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS).

requirements.title: Restrict each action to authorised roles
requirements.screens: All Product Maintenance screens; User Access Matrix
acceptance: A Marketing AO sees Product Maintenance Home, Package Requests and the catalogue screens, and does not see the Validation Queue or TSU Workbench.
A direct approval request by a user without the approval permission is refused and logged.
The User Access Matrix shows, for each role, which Product Maintenance areas it may view, create, amend and approve, and exports both views to Excel.

requirements.title: Change role permissions through an approved request
acceptance: A role change requested by the Business Administrator takes effect only after another user approves it.
The history of the role shows who requested, approved and applied each change.

requirements.title: Protect documents that leave BIBS
acceptance: A QS e-mailed to an insurer arrives as a protected PDF, and the password arrives in a separate e-mail.
A user without Product Maintenance permissions cannot open the request's documents.

requirements.title: Keep a complete audit trail and history
requirements.screens: Package Request page (History tab); Product page (History); Package Version page
acceptance: For a released package, the History tab lists every step from submission to release with user and time.
A changed insurer response shows its earlier values in the response history.
No screen or direct request allows audit rows to be edited or deleted.

requirements.title: Maintain the product hierarchy
acceptance: A packaged product without a cover type cannot be saved.
A risk code that does not follow its line's pattern is refused with PRODUCT_CODE_PATTERN.
A new coverage is usable in package versions only after another user authorises it.

requirements.title: Maintain the clause library
acceptance: A clause is selectable in insurer terms only after authorisation and within its effective dates.
An end-dated clause stays readable on the versions that used it.

requirements.title: Capture and validate product-specific fields
requirements.priority: BRPM.003: not stated in the BRD; BRPM.004: Must have
acceptance: A Motor product rule "plate number required" stops submission of a Motor account without a plate number and names the field.
A range rule refuses a value outside the range and accepts the limits.
MBS adds a field rule for a line that has none, and the rule applies to the next account of that line.

requirements.title: Use shared document templates with product-specific fields
requirements.screens: Package Request page (form.pdf, QS, comparative, package slip, advisory downloads)
acceptance: A QS for a Motor package shows the Motor coverages and deductibles; a QS for a Fire package shows the Fire coverages.
Each generated document shows the template version in its record.

requirements.title: Maintain insurer-specific package terms
requirements.screens: Package Version (Insurers, Insurer Terms sections); Product page (Versions)
acceptance: MBS maintains different deductibles for two insurers on the same coverage without IT.
A version whose insurer has no term for an included coverage cannot be submitted.
A quotation on the package with an insurer outside the panel is refused.

requirements.title: Create and submit a Package Request Form
requirements.screens: Package Requests; New Package Request; Edit Package Request
acceptance: A Marketing AO submits a complete NEW request; it receives a PKR number and moves to FOR_MKT_APPROVAL.
Submission with missing mandatory fields is refused and each missing item is named.
An AMEND request opens with the current version's terms pre-filled.
A client-specific request without a client cannot be saved.

requirements.title: Approve a package request (Marketing)
requirements.screens: Package Requests (tab For Approval); Package Request page
acceptance: The requester cannot approve their own request.
An approved request appears in the TSU Review tab.
A returned request is back in DRAFT with the reason visible on the request.

requirements.title: Review and recommend a package request (TSU TL)
acceptance: The request cannot reach the TSU Head without a recommendation.
The TSU Head sees the recommendation text on the request.

requirements.title: Approve a package request (TSU Head)
acceptance: The recommender cannot give the TSU Head approval.
After approval of a NEW request, round 1 exists with the target insurers.
A retirement request goes to ManCom sign-off without a negotiation round.

requirements.title: Receive, view and track package requests
requirements.screens: Package Requests; TSU Workbench; Package Request page
acceptance: A request submitted by Marketing appears in the TSU Review tab with its type, client, line and reason.
The TSU TL receives a notification when a request enters FOR_TSU_REVIEW.
A request assigned to an officer shows the officer as assignee.

requirements.title: Prepare, approve and send the quotation slip
acceptance: The preparer cannot approve their own QS.
An approved QS is e-mailed to each insurer of the round as a protected PDF, and the E-mails tab lists each send.
The officer can view the sent history and resend to one insurer.
After ManCom sign-off the QS cannot be edited or resent.

requirements.title: Record insurer responses and outcomes
requirements.screens: Package Request page (Negotiation tab, response dialog)
acceptance: TSU records "Approved with changes" with a rate and changed deductibles for one insurer and "Declined" for another.
A counter-proposal without a rate is refused.
The response history shows every earlier value with user and time.

requirements.title: Run further negotiation rounds
acceptance: A request negotiated in two rounds shows both rounds, their QS numbers and the responses of each.
Round 2 opens by default without the insurers that declined in round 1.
A request closed as not proceeded shows the reason and cannot be reopened.

requirements.title: Make the negotiated terms final
requirements.screens: Package Request page (Negotiation tab, Terms Final dialog)
acceptance: Terms Final is refused while one insurer of the round is Pending.
After Terms Final, the request shows the proposed terms and a current comparative master.

requirements.title: Compile one comparative master per package request
acceptance: A request with three responses has one current master listing the three insurers with their terms.
After a second compilation the first master is marked superseded and is still downloadable.
A Marketing user can open the master but has no Compile or Generate buttons.

requirements.title: Generate a client-tailored comparative view
requirements.screens: Package Request page (Comparative tab, Generate Client View dialog)
acceptance: A client view that excludes one insurer and the Remarks field shows neither, and its values equal the master's.
The view lists the master it was derived from.

requirements.title: Review negotiated terms (TSU Head and Marketing)
acceptance: A client-specific package cannot skip the Marketing review.
Marketing's change request returns the request to NEGOTIATION with the reason shown.

requirements.title: Prepare and submit the requirements pack
acceptance: Submission without a signed package slip is refused and names the missing slip.
A complete pack moves the request to FOR_MANCOM and notifies ManCom.

requirements.title: Sign off package requirements (ManCom)
acceptance: The requirements reach MBS only after the ManCom sign-off.
After sign-off, the QS of every round can no longer be edited or resent.
A request without an uploaded sheet carries a generated MANCOM_SIGNOFF document.

requirements.title: Set up the package (MBS)
requirements.screens: Package Request page (Set-up tab); Package Version
acceptance: MBS cannot set up a package before ManCom sign-off.
Set-up creates a draft version whose terms equal the signed-off proposed terms.
Incomplete requirements returned by MBS reach TSU with the reason.

requirements.title: Validate and release a package version
acceptance: The MBS user who set up the version cannot validate it.
A released version is used by new quotations from its effective date; before release it is not.
A returned version is editable again and the request is back with MBS.

requirements.title: Draft and send package advisories
acceptance: An advisory cannot be sent while the signed package slip is missing.
A sent advisory reaches the users of each selected group in BIBS and lists the supporting documents.
The advisory PDF is stored on the request.

requirements.title: Retire a package
requirements.screens: New Package Request (type RETIRE); Package Request page (Set-up tab)
acceptance: After retirement, a new quotation on the product is refused.
The retired product and its versions stay searchable for users with PRODUCT_ARCHIVE_VIEW.

requirements.title: Keep package terms as versions
acceptance: Changing the rate of a released package creates version n+1; version n stays in force until n+1 takes effect.
The Versions tab shows every version with status and effective dates.

requirements.title: Price new business on the latest approved rate scheme
requirements.screens: Quotation (rate scheme panel, Request Rate Exception); rate exception record; Premium Calculator; My Approvals
acceptance: A quotation with a period start before the new version's effective date is priced on the new version.
