Submission with a manual rate different from the scheme is refused without an approved exception and accepted with one.
The approver approves or rejects the exception on its record opened from My Approvals; the requester cannot decide it and a rejection needs its reason.
The quotation, account and invoice show the version number that priced them.

requirements.title: Archive expired packages
requirements.screens: Products (Expired and Retired filters); Product page
acceptance: A package past its end date without a renewal is tagged Expired and cannot be sold.
Its versions, documents and request history remain retrievable by authorised users.
A Marketing AO does not see expired packages.

requirements.title: Monitor package expiry and anniversary dates
requirements.screens: Package Expiry (tabs Expiring, Renewal in Progress, Expired); Product Maintenance Home
acceptance: A package ending in 45 days appears in the Expiring tab with 45 days left.
The alert is raised once at 60, 30 and 7 days, never twice for the same threshold.
With automatic drafting switched on, the first alert of a package also drafts its renewal request from the current version, and no second request is drafted while it is open.

requirements.title: Generate renewal requests
requirements.screens: Package Expiry (bulk Generate Renewal Request); Package Request page
acceptance: A generated renewal request has the terms of the current version and the next term's dates.
A package with an open renewal request cannot get a second one.

requirements.title: Product Maintenance home and dashboard
acceptance: A request past its stage SLA is counted in a red tile.
Clicking "Expiring in 30 days" opens the Package Expiry list filtered to 30 days.

requirements.title: Package reports
acceptance: The Package Status Update Report for one request number shows only that request.
The report exports to PDF and Excel with the same rows.
A user without PKG_REPORT_VIEW cannot run the reports.

requirements.title: Notify users and publish product master changes
acceptance: The TSU TL receives a notification when a request enters FOR_TSU_REVIEW.
A release writes a product master feed log entry with product, version and effective date.

requirements.title: Enforce validations, approvals and SLAs
acceptance: A request cannot be sent to MBS without the ManCom sign-off, even by a direct request.
A request past its stage SLA raises an SLA alert to the stage owners.

requirements.title: Maintain incentive criteria on the products matrix
acceptance: A criterion on an inactive product cannot be saved.
An amended active criterion stays active until its successor is authorised, with no gap.
The history shows every earlier version of the criterion.

requirements.title: Apply incentive criteria and review them when products end
acceptance: An invoice on a product covered by CPC2 carries CPC2 and the incentive flag.
Retiring the product raises INCENTIVE_PRODUCT_INACTIVE for CPC2.

requirements.title: Restrict each Collections action to authorised roles
requirements.screens: All Collections screens; User Access Matrix
acceptance: A Disbursement user sees the PR Worklist read only and cannot record a disposition.
A Marketing AO does not see Collections Setup or Assignments.
The User Access Matrix lists the CLX_* permissions under the area COLLECTIONS with their action classes.
A user is locked after three consecutive wrong passwords; the correct password is then refused with the same message as a wrong password, and Users shows the lock to the System Administrator.
A Collection Handler searches and opens a remittance and filters the Production Register, read only, without any action to change them.

requirements.title: Show who encoded and who updated each record
requirements.screens: Collection account (Dispositions & Efforts, History); Promises to Pay; Installment Plans; Escalations; Unapplied Payment
acceptance: A disposition recorded by clxhandler shows clxhandler and the time on the Dispositions & Efforts tab.
A promise changed by another user shows that user as the last updater.

requirements.title: Keep a field-level audit log of Collections changes
acceptance: Changing the category of an account from A to B writes one row with From A, To B, the user, the time and the source IP.
Changing CLX_MIN_BALANCE_THRESHOLD on Collections Setup writes a row with the old and new value.
No screen or direct request allows an audit row to be edited or deleted.

requirements.title: View and extract the Collections audit log
acceptance: A Section Head exports the audit log of a month to Excel with the columns Changed On, User ID, Source IP, Record, Reference, Field, From, To and Bulk Reference.
A Collection Handler cannot open the report.

requirements.title: Lock a collection account while a user edits it
acceptance: While clxhandler has an account open, mkttl cannot record a disposition on it and sees "clxhandler is editing".
After 15 minutes without release, mkttl can take the lock.

requirements.title: Generate the outstanding PR list at invoice level
acceptance: An invoice booked today with a premium of 25,000.00 appears on the Open Accounts tab after the nightly refresh, with its net outstanding of 25,000.00.
After a payment of 10,000.00 is applied, the account shows 15,000.00 outstanding.
A user with CLX_VIEW only can open the list and an account but has no work actions.

requirements.title: Apply the minimal balance threshold
acceptance: With the threshold at 10.00, an invoice with 10.01 outstanding is listed and one with 10.00 is not.
A listed account paid down to 8.00 moves to Completed Collections at the next refresh.

requirements.title: Maintain the threshold and the Collections parameters
acceptance: A Section Head changes the threshold to 100.00; after "Refresh now" accounts with 100.00 or less move to Completed Collections.
A Collection Handler does not see Collections Setup.
The change appears in the Collections Audit Log with From 10.00 and To 100.00.

requirements.title: Exclude cancelled negative balances and keep other credits apart
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (Excluded, Credit Balances tabs); Collections Home
acceptance: The negative return invoice of a cancelled policy does not appear on the Open Accounts tab.
An overpaid invoice with -500.00 appears on the Credit Balances tab.

requirements.title: Total the PR balance by account and by client
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (By Account, By Client); Client View
acceptance: A client with three open invoices of 5,000.00, 7,000.00 and 3,000.00 shows 15,000.00 in By Client and in the Client View.

requirements.title: Filter the worklist by market segment, Unit Head and other criteria
acceptance: Filtering on segment RETAIL and Unit Head clxuh returns only the accounts of that segment whose sales unit is headed by clxuh.
Changing the Unit Head of a sales unit changes the Unit Head of its accounts at the next refresh.

requirements.title: Show the net PR and its breakdown
acceptance: For an invoice of 50,000.00 with a negative endorsement of 5,000.00 and a payment of 20,000.00, the Summary shows 25,000.00 net outstanding and the three movements.
The component rows add up to the net outstanding.

requirements.title: Refresh the worklist every day from the invoice ledger
requirements.screens: PR Worklist; Collection account ("Refresh from Ledger"); Operations > Interfaces and job runs (sync view)
acceptance: An invoice booked during the day is on the worklist the next morning.
A payment applied at 10:00 reduces the account's outstanding before 10:05.
A failed run raises CLX_REFRESH_FAILED and is visible in the job run history.

requirements.title: Keep the history of accounts and dispositions
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (Completed Collections); Collection account (Timeline, Dispositions & Efforts, History)
acceptance: A fully paid account appears under Completed Collections with its three earlier dispositions.
Recording a new disposition leaves the previous one on the Dispositions & Efforts tab, marked superseded.

requirements.title: Assign new accounts by rule
acceptance: With a rule "segment RETAIL to clxhandler", a new Retail account is assigned to clxhandler at the next refresh.
A new account without a matching rule goes to its AO.

requirements.title: Reassign accounts permanently or temporarily
acceptance: A TL reassigns 40 accounts of one sales unit to mkthandler until the end of the month; after that date they return to their previous handler.
The history of an account shows the previous handler, the new handler, the kind, the dates, the reason and the TL.
A reassignment without a reason is refused.

requirements.title: Maintain the PR collector disposition list and its rules
requirements.screens: Lists of Values (CLX_PR_DISPOSITION); Collections Setup (Disposition Rules)
acceptance: A value added and approved on the LOV screen is offered in Record Disposition.
A value ended yesterday is not offered today and a direct call with it is refused.
A Collection Handler without an allowed role cannot choose "No / missing policy number" when the value is reserved.
Record Disposition does not offer "For check pick-up", and the Operations Action list of Disposition Rules has no check pick-up.

requirements.title: Record a PR collector disposition
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (Record Disposition); Collection account (Dispositions & Efforts)
acceptance: A handler records "Coordinate further" on one account; it becomes the current disposition with tagging owner Marketing.
A handler with CLX_BULK_UPDATE records the same disposition on 20 accounts; all share one bulk reference.
A handler without CLX_BULK_UPDATE who selects two accounts is refused with CLX_BULK_NOT_ALLOWED.

requirements.title: Hand dispositions over to Cashiering and Commission
requirements.screens: Collection account (Hand-offs to Operations); Commission > DP Lists; Collections Home (DP Returned by Insurer)
acceptance: No disposition offers a check pick-up, and no item reaches a Cashiering pick-up queue (removed from scope, CSHID.009).
A "DP PR for reversal" disposition appears on the Commission DP list.
A DP account returned by the insurer is open again in the handler's worklist with the disposition "DP returned by insurer".

requirements.title: Log collection efforts, remarks and the tagging category
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (Log Effort, Update Remarks and Category); Collection account (Dispositions & Efforts)
acceptance: A logged call appears on the Dispositions & Efforts tab and as the last effort on the worklist row.
An effort dated tomorrow is refused.

requirements.title: Update several accounts at once
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (bulk actions); Promises to Pay; Escalations; Bulk Uploads (Collections Bulk Update)
acceptance: A TL logs the same effort on 30 accounts in one action; the result lists 30 successes and each account shows the effort.
An upload with 10 promise rows and 1 row for a paid invoice saves 10 promises and reports 1 error.
An upload row with a disposition and an effort with remarks records both on the account.
Every account of a bulk action shows the bulk reference in its History.

requirements.title: Create installment plans for multi-year and installment accounts
requirements.screens: Installment Plans (New Installment Plan); Installment Plan; Installments Due
acceptance: A three-year account booked with annual policy-year invoices and a quarterly frequency gets a plan of 12 installments, four per coverage year.
A generated plan of 4 installments on an outstanding of 40,000.00 has four installments of 10,000.00.
A second live plan on the same invoice is refused with CLX_PLAN_EXISTS.
An unpaid installment past its due date is flagged overdue and listed on Installments Due.

requirements.title: Allocate payments to installments and show the payment history
requirements.screens: Collection account (Payments); Installment Plan (Installments); Installment Plans (Refresh Allocation)
acceptance: A payment of 15,000.00 on a plan with installments of 10,000.00 marks the first installment PAID and the second PARTIAL (5,000.00).
The Payments tab lists the payment with its AR number and date.

requirements.title: Record and evaluate promises to pay
requirements.screens: Promises to Pay (Record Promise, Withdraw Promise); Installment Plan (Promises)
acceptance: A promise of 10,000.00 by 15 October with 10,000.00 applied on 14 October is KEPT after the check of 15 October.
A promise with 4,000.00 applied in time is PARTIALLY_KEPT.
A promise with nothing applied is BROKEN, the AO is notified and the account is escalated to the team lead by the broken-promise rule.

requirements.title: View policy, account, invoice and co-insurance information
acceptance: A co-insured invoice shows each insurer, the lead flag and the share % adding up to 100.
An endorsed invoice shows the original and the endorsement invoice in Invoice Family.

requirements.title: View the complete transaction history of an account
acceptance: After a payment, a disposition and a reassignment, the Timeline shows the three entries in date order with their sources.
A non-financial endorsement of the policy (for example a change of address) adds no entry to the Timeline.

requirements.title: Maintain escalation rules
acceptance: A rule "aging from booking 45 days to the TL" is not applied until another user authorises it.
The maker cannot authorise their own rule.
Preview of the authorised rule lists the accounts over 45 days old.
A rule "aging from booking 120 days to the Section Head", once authorised, escalates an account 121 days from booking to the Section Head.

requirements.title: Escalate accounts automatically
acceptance: An account 46 days from booking is escalated to the TL by the 45-day rule, once in the month.
A broken promise raises an escalation to the team lead the same night.
An escalated account that is paid in full is closed automatically at the next run.

requirements.title: Escalate accounts manually
acceptance: Escalating five invoices of two accounts raises two escalations.
A user without CLX_ESCALATE does not see Escalate Accounts.
An account already escalated by a rule can still be escalated by hand.

requirements.title: Act on an escalation
acceptance: A TL acknowledges and resolves an escalation with a resolution; it closes as RESOLVED.
A TL cannot resolve without a resolution.
A returned escalation shows in the handler's Escalations and can be resubmitted.

requirements.title: Generate billing statements per billing cycle
requirements.screens: Billing Statements (Billing Run); Installment Plan (Statements of Account); Statement of Account
acceptance: For the three-year seed account with an annual plan, BIBS produces an SOA for each of its three billing cycles.
A second SOA for a billed cycle is refused until the first is cancelled.
The SOA shows the coverage period of the installment and any unpaid earlier installment as arrears.
A Collection Handler sees the statements of a plan and downloads the PDF, but has no Billing Run or Generate SOA action.

requirements.title: Send or cancel a billing statement
requirements.screens: Statement of Account (Send Statement of Account, Cancel Statement of Account, E-mails Sent)
acceptance: Sending an SOA sends two e-mails (document and password) and sets the statement to SENT.
A cancelled statement cannot be sent.
A Collection Handler sees the statement SENT with its e-mails but has no Send via Email or Cancel Statement action.

requirements.title: Keep billing as monitoring only
requirements.screens: Billing Statements; PR Worklist; Collection account
acceptance: Generating an SOA of 10,000.00 changes no ledger balance and adds no worklist account.
The SOA list shows invoice references, due dates and amounts per account.

requirements.title: View the list of unapplied payments as of today
acceptance: A payment received today and not matched appears on Awaiting Disposition with age 0.
A payment matched to an invoice shows the invoice's assured, AO and PR balance.
A payment fully applied by Cashiering is no longer listed.

requirements.title: Filter unapplied payments by market segment and disposition status
acceptance: Filtering on segment RETAIL and disposition "None yet" lists only Retail payments without a collector disposition.

requirements.title: Maintain the unapplied payment disposition list
requirements.screens: Lists of Values (CLX_UPP_DISPOSITION); Collections Setup (Disposition Rules)
acceptance: A deactivated unapplied disposition is not offered and is refused on save.
A new value with Cashiering action NONE records a disposition without a request.

requirements.title: Record a collector disposition on an unapplied payment
requirements.screens: Unapplied Payments (Record Disposition); Unapplied Payment (Collector Dispositions)
acceptance: A handler records "Coordinate further" on Juan Dela Cruz's payment; it shows on the Collector Dispositions tab and no request is sent.
A disposition on a payment already fully applied is refused.

requirements.title: Request Cashiering to apply, refund, reclass or transfer a payment
requirements.screens: Unapplied Payments (Request Application); Requests to Cashiering; Cashiering > Incoming Requests (Collector Requests)
acceptance: A request to apply Grace Villanueva's payment to an open invoice is accepted and executed by the cashier; the request shows APPLIED and the invoice's outstanding falls by the amount.
A rejected request shows REJECTED with the cashier's reason.
A refund request stays SENT until a cashier acts on it.

requirements.title: Validate the invoice of "for application to invoice"
acceptance: A "For application to invoice" disposition without an invoice number is refused with CLX_INVOICE_REQUIRED.
The invoice number I1234567 (7 digits) is refused with CLX_INVOICE_FORMAT.
A well-formed invoice number that is not booked is refused with CLX_INVOICE_UNKNOWN.

requirements.title: Keep the history of unapplied payments and dispositions
requirements.screens: Unapplied Payment (History, Collector Dispositions, Requests to Cashiering)
acceptance: After a payment is applied through a collector request, its history shows the disposition, the request, the acceptance and the application.

requirements.title: Produce the daily "For Application To Invoice" file
requirements.screens: Requests to Cashiering (File column); Report Centre (For Application To Invoice)
acceptance: A request made on Monday is in Tuesday's 05:00 file and not in Wednesday's.
The file has one pipe-delimited line per request with the user ID of the disposition.

requirements.title: Produce the "DP PR for reversal" files
requirements.screens: Collections Files (Monthly); Report Centre (DP PR for Reversal)
acceptance: On 1 October (a working day) the file of September's DP tags is available at 08:00.
When 1 October is a holiday, the file is generated on the next working day.

requirements.title: Produce the "PR 2307 for reversal" files
requirements.screens: Collections Files (Monthly); Report Centre (PR 2307 for Reversal)
acceptance: The October file lists every account tagged PR 2307 for reversal in September with its PR2307 amount.

requirements.title: Produce the weekly reversal files per unit and branch
acceptance: Accounts tagged between Saturday and Friday appear in that week's files, split by unit and branch, downloadable from Monday 08:00.

requirements.title: Produce the daily PR report
requirements.screens: Collections Files (Daily); Report Centre (Outstanding PR List, Full Production Report)
acceptance: Each morning Collections Files shows the previous evening's Outstanding PR List and Full Production Report.

requirements.title: Export lists on request without slowing the system
requirements.screens: PR Worklist (Export to Files); Collections Files (Exports); Report Centre (Collections reports)
acceptance: An export of 60,000 accounts is refused with CLX_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE; with a narrower filter it runs.
A user without CLX_EXPORT sees the files but cannot download them.

requirements.title: Show the Collections home
acceptance: A handler with 12 open accounts sees 12 on My Open Accounts; clicking it opens the worklist filtered to them.
A user without CLX_UNAPPLIED_WORK does not see the unapplied tiles.
A handler with one broken promise sees 1 on Broken Promises; clicking it opens Promises to Pay on the Broken tab.

requirements.title: Bill commission receivable only after the premium is confirmed paid
acceptance: A DP account not yet confirmed cannot be added to a billing.
After confirmation, the account is billed to its insurer.

requirements.title: Keep regular commission and incentives as separate receivables
requirements.screens: Commission > DP Accounts, Incentive Runs (to be extended)
acceptance: A regular commission line and an incentive line of the same invoice appear as two receivables with different accounts.

requirements.title: Bill incentive campaigns automatically
requirements.screens: Commission > Incentive Schemes (to be extended to campaigns)
acceptance: An invoice paid within the campaign window is billed; one with a pending negative adjustment is excluded.
A Collection Handler sees the eligible transactions of a campaign but cannot set up or change a campaign.

requirements.title: Handle commission refunds from negative adjustments apart
acceptance: A negative endorsement on a collected commission creates a refund, not a negative CR line.

requirements.title: Bill only the collectible commission on mixed payments
acceptance: For a premium of 100,000.00 with 40,000.00 paid directly and confirmed, the collectible commission is 40% of the commission.

requirements.title: Access Accounting and administration with a user profile
requirements.screens: Login; Home; menu groups Finance, Planning and Closing, Setup and Administration
acceptance: A GL Officer logs in from a BDO laptop and a BDO mobile device and sees Journals, Report Pack and Service Fee Runs.
A GL Officer does not see Chart Upload or GL Close & Cut-Off.

requirements.title: Warn before the idle time-out and before the forced log-out
acceptance: After 15 minutes of inactivity the warning appears.
The log-out warning appears 30 minutes before the session ends.

requirements.title: Enter the monthly revaluation rate
requirements.screens: Setup > Currencies & Rates (card Monthly revaluation rates)
acceptance: The Section Head enters USD 58.1234 for August; it appears as the CLOSING rate of 31 August and as the BOOK rate from 1 September.
A GL Officer cannot enter a revaluation rate.

requirements.title: Set up, view and edit the chart of accounts
acceptance: A new account under 1210 with a different class is refused.
A new account is not usable in a journal until another user authorises it.

requirements.title: Upload the chart of accounts
requirements.screens: General Ledger > Chart Upload (Upload Chart, Upload History)
acceptance: The sample file of 8 accounts under the groups 1900 and 2900 loads without errors and the accounts wait for authorisation.
A row whose parent is missing is reported with its reason and not created.

requirements.title: Generate account numbers and roll child accounts up to their parent
requirements.screens: General Ledger > Chart of Accounts (Numbering Schemes)
acceptance: With the scheme "." and width 2 under 1900, a new blank-coded child becomes 1900.01, the next 1900.02.
The balance of 1900.01 is included in 1900 on the trial balance.

requirements.title: Search accounts by name, short code or number
requirements.screens: Chart of Accounts (search); journal lines (account entry)
acceptance: Searching "PRPHP" returns the account whose short code is PRPHP.
A second account cannot take a short code already used.

requirements.title: Select, run, view and copy reports on demand
requirements.screens: Report Centre; Report; Accounting Reports > Report Pack
acceptance: A GL Officer runs the trial balance for August and exports it to XLSX and ODS.
The on-screen result can be copied and pasted into Excel.

requirements.title: Filter every column of a report
acceptance: Filtering the Account column of a trial balance on "1210" shows only the 1210 accounts; the export holds the same rows.

requirements.title: Download or print several reports at once
acceptance: Selecting the trial balance, the income statement and the statement of condition for August returns one ZIP with three files.
The merged PDF option returns one PDF with the three reports in order.

requirements.title: Set the print options of a report
acceptance: A wide report printed landscape, fit to width, shows all its columns on one page width.

requirements.title: Post every financial transaction to the GL and the sub-ledger
requirements.screens: Journals; Account Inquiry; Party Statement; Accounting Engine (event log)
acceptance: An approved remittance batch posts its journal and clears the insurer's open items.
An event without a rule is FAILED in the event log and can be re-processed after the rule is added.

requirements.title: Assign manual entries for posting and work the assigned list
requirements.screens: General Ledger > Journals (Assign, Assigned to me); Journal
acceptance: A journal submitted by glofficer cannot be assigned to glofficer.
After assignment to gltl, the journal appears in gltl's Assigned to me.

requirements.title: Prepare manual entries
requirements.screens: General Ledger > New Journal; Edit Journal
acceptance: An accrual entered with the short code of the account shows the account name and saves as a draft.
Submitting sends it to PENDING_APPROVAL after confirmation.

requirements.title: Reverse accruals automatically on their reversal date
acceptance: An accrual posted on 31 August with reverse-on 1 September is reversed by a system journal dated 1 September.

requirements.title: Validate entries and refuse errors
acceptance: A journal with debits of 1,000.00 and credits of 900.00 is refused as unbalanced.
A journal that would make a BLOCK cash account negative is refused; on a WARN account it shows a warning and can be confirmed.

requirements.title: Confirm the transaction details before sending them on
acceptance: Submitting a journal shows its debit and credit totals and line count before it is sent.

requirements.title: Post or return entries, one or several at a time, with remarks
requirements.screens: Journals (bulk posting); Journal (Post, Return to Maker); My Approvals
acceptance: Posting 10 selected journals of which one is unbalanced posts 9 and reports the refused one.
A returned journal shows the remarks and can be edited and resubmitted by its maker.

requirements.title: Edit accounting entries
acceptance: A returned journal is edited and resubmitted by its maker.
A posted journal has no Edit action.

requirements.title: Schedule and run the month-end close of the GL books
requirements.screens: Planning & Closing > GL Close & Cut-Off (Month-End Close)
acceptance: On 1 October, scheduling the close of August is refused; September is accepted.
A close with unposted journals fails and raises GL_CLOSE_FAILED with the list.

requirements.title: Close the year and verify that the nominal accounts are zero
acceptance: After the close of 2025, the verification shows nominal balance 0.00 and trial-balance difference 0.00.
On 1 April 2026 with 2025 still open, YEAR_END_CLOSE_DUE is raised.

requirements.title: Close the broking books automatically at month end
requirements.screens: Planning & Closing > GL Close & Cut-Off (Broking Books Cut-Off)
acceptance: After 23:00 on 30 September, a remittance posting dated 30 September is refused; a GL adjustment dated 30 September is accepted.
A reopened month accepts broking postings until it is closed again.

requirements.title: Revalue USD balances at the revaluation rate
acceptance: A USD receivable of 1,000.00 booked at 56.00 and revalued at 58.00 gives an unrealised gain of 2,000.00, reversed on the first day of the next month.

requirements.title: Upload bank files and reconcile automatically
requirements.screens: Receivables > Bank Statements; Bank Reconciliation; Setup > Bank Statement Layouts
acceptance: A bank file with check 000123 for 15,000.00 matches the book payment of check 000123 for 15,000.00 though the dates differ.
After finalisation the reconciliation statement shows no unexplained difference.

requirements.title: Report the unmatched transactions
acceptance: A deposit in transit appears on the unmatched book report and on the reconciliation statement.

requirements.title: Compute, approve and pay the service fee
requirements.screens: Accounting Reports > Service Fee Runs; Service Fee Run; Service Fee Rates
acceptance: For a CBG invoice fully paid in August with commission 10,000.00 and insurer WTAX 200.00, the fee is 245.00.
The preparer cannot approve the run.
On approval, one accrual journal and one Disbursement request are created per line.

requirements.title: Record the liquidation report and tag released or liquidated
acceptance: A line paid by Disbursement on 5 September shows Released on 5 September.
Liquidating without the report is refused.

requirements.title: Derive and enforce the cost centre of every entry
requirements.screens: Setup > Cost-Centre Rules; Accounting Engine (event log); Alerts
acceptance: A service-fee accrual without a cost centre takes the cost centre of the matching rule.
A posting that no rule covers is not posted and raises COST_CENTER_MISSING.

requirements.title: Account for early incentives as Other Income
acceptance: The early incentive of a remittance batch posts to the incentive income account and not to commission income.

requirements.title: Generate the FRBS report pack
acceptance: The Report Pack lists the seven Appendix A groups with their reports.
The GARD Schedule of Operating Expenses exports to Excel and PDF.

requirements.title: Run and maintain configurable account schedules
requirements.screens: Accounting Reports > Account Schedules (run, commentary, definitions editor)
acceptance: Every provided definition runs and exports to Excel and PDF.
The aged schedule of premium receivable splits each balance into its buckets and the buckets add up to the balance.

requirements.title: Produce the Mancom, production, GAP, cash-flow and expense reports
requirements.screens: Accounting Reports > Report Pack (groups IV, V, VI)
acceptance: The market performance summary of August shows the premium and commission of each segment with year to date and growth.
The GAP report totals match the open items of the sub-ledger.

requirements.title: Produce the BIR returns, alphalists, SAWT and books of accounts
requirements.screens: Tax & Statutory > BIR Forms & Books; Tax Returns; Certificates Received
acceptance: The SAWT of Q3 lists every insurer certificate recorded for the quarter.
The Cash Disbursements book of August lists the payment journals of the month.

requirements.title: Maintain lists of values with approval
requirements.screens: Administration > Lists of Values; My Approvals
acceptance: A new refund reason is usable only after another user approves it.
A value ended yesterday is no longer offered today.

requirements.title: Manage users and role profiles through approved requests
requirements.screens: Administration > Access Requests; Users; Roles & Permissions; User Access Matrix
acceptance: A request to give glofficer the role FRBS_TL takes effect only after another user approves it.
The User Access Matrix shows the changed role.

requirements.title: Approve, decline or return administration requests
acceptance: A returned request shows RETURNED with the remarks and is resubmitted by its requester.
The requester cannot approve their own request.

requirements.title: Access Disbursement, Payment Requests and ACSL with a user profile
requirements.screens: Login; menu group Finance (Disbursement, Refund & Cash Advance Requests, ACSL)
acceptance: A Disbursement Processor sees the Disbursement Workbench and not the ACSL screens.
A Marketing AO sees Requests Home and New Refund Request only.
The inactivity warning appears after 15 minutes.

requirements.title: Maintain payees with authorisation
requirements.screens: Payees (tabs Active, For Authorisation, Drafts, Inactive, Payee Requests); Payee
acceptance: A payee created by disbtl is usable only after disbappr authorises it.
disbtl cannot authorise the payee he created.
A Processor sees the account number masked.

requirements.title: Classify payees and choose the modes of payment
acceptance: A supplier payee with modes Check and CTA cannot be paid by ATD.

requirements.title: Receive payee maintenance requests
acceptance: A remittance request for an insurer without payee creates a NO_MATCH payee request; authorising the payee resumes the request.

requirements.title: Delete or deactivate payees
acceptance: Deleting a payee paid last month is refused with PAYEE_IN_USE.

requirements.title: View all payees and migrate the existing payees
requirements.screens: Payees; Disbursement Uploads (Payee Migration); Disbursement Reports (Payee report)
acceptance: A migration file of 100 payees with 2 invalid rows creates 98 payees and reports 2 rows with their reasons.
A user without DISB_PAYEE_VIEW_FULL sees masked account numbers.

requirements.title: Receive system-triggered payment requests
acceptance: An approved remittance batch creates a remittance DV directly For Approval.
A refund request for a client without payee waits under No Payee and resumes when the payee is authorised.

requirements.title: Classify requests by disbursement type
acceptance: A request from a government payee is classified Payment to government agencies and appears in DSB-EOD-OTHER.

requirements.title: Match the payee and report requests without payee
acceptance: The no-match report lists the request with its source, payee code and amount.

requirements.title: Encode requests received by e-mail
acceptance: An encoded supplier request of 25,000.00 creates a DV In Process with the supplier's details.

requirements.title: Upload requests and view the fall-out
acceptance: An upload of 20 rows with 3 unknown payees creates 17 requests and lists 3 fall-out rows with the reason.

requirements.title: Work the Disbursement Workbench
requirements.screens: Disbursement Workbench; Disbursement Voucher (tabs Details, Entry, Instrument, OR / AR and CWT, Documents, E-mails)
acceptance: Filtering on the received date lists only the requests of that range.
The DV shows the payee's TIN and ATC for a supplier.

requirements.title: Create the disbursement voucher
acceptance: An encoded request gets DV-2026-n with its terms pre-filled from the payee.
Submitting a DV without paying account is refused with DV_INCOMPLETE.

requirements.title: Create and edit the proforma entry
acceptance: Changing the expense account of a supplier DV marks the line Edited and the Approver sees it.
An unbalanced edited entry cannot be saved.

requirements.title: Allocate expenses by cost centre
acceptance: A 30,000.00 rent DV allocated 20,000.00 to HO and 10,000.00 to Cebu posts two expense lines with those cost centres.

requirements.title: Process the payment by one of the seven modes
acceptance: A check DV prints check 000124 from the paying account's series and becomes Printed.

requirements.title: Process an Authority to Debit
acceptance: An ATD printed, e-mailed and confirmed shows Printed, Emailed and Debited in its history.

requirements.title: Process Manager's Checks, Demand Drafts, Credit Tickets and Telegraphic Transfers
acceptance: A manager's check goes Printed, Received, Released; a credit ticket goes Printed, Debited.

requirements.title: Submit the DV for review
acceptance: A submitted DV appears in the For Review tab.

requirements.title: Maintain the employee and cost-centre master and report the headcount
requirements.screens: Setup > Employees; Report Centre (Headcount per Cost Centre)
acceptance: A second employee with the same number is refused.
The headcount report of 30 September counts the active employees per cost centre.

requirements.title: Review, return and submit DVs for approval
acceptance: A DV returned with "Incomplete supporting documents" is back In Process with the reason visible.

requirements.title: Approve and post one or several DVs
requirements.screens: Disbursement Workbench (For Approval - bulk); Disbursement Voucher (Approve)
acceptance: Approving a refund DV posts Dr refund payable / Cr bank and creates its instrument.
Approving 5 DVs of which one has no rule approves 4 and leaves one For Approval with DV_POSTING_FAILED.

requirements.title: Reject a DV
acceptance: A rejected refund DV sends the refund request back to its preparer in Payment Requests.

requirements.title: Cancel a DV In Process or For review
acceptance: A duplicate supplier DV In Process is cancelled with reason "Duplicate request or DV".

requirements.title: Cancel an approved DV and regularise the accounting
acceptance: Cancelling an approved refund DV posts the reversal and reopens the refund request.
A negotiated check's DV cannot be cancelled.

requirements.title: Regularise the accounting of every DV and list what is not regularised
acceptance: A DV whose approval posting failed appears in DSB-UNREGULARIZED with the error.

requirements.title: Tag instrument statuses
acceptance: A check released on 2 October shows Released with the date and the person who received it.

requirements.title: Edit an instrument status with approval
requirements.screens: Disbursement Voucher (Instrument - Request Status Edit); status edits list
acceptance: A check wrongly tagged Released is set back to Printed after the TL approves the edit.

requirements.title: Tag statuses automatically
acceptance: Printing an ATD sets it Printed; uploading the BOB report sets an online-banking payment Debited.

requirements.title: Upload deposited-checks and credited-accounts files
requirements.screens: Disbursement Uploads (Negotiated Checks, Credited Accounts, BOB Approvals)
acceptance: A deposited-checks file with check 000124 for 15,000.00 tags it Negotiated.
A row whose amount differs is refused with INSTRUMENT_AMOUNT.

requirements.title: Stale checks after 180 days and re-issue them
acceptance: A check printed on 1 April and not negotiated is Stale on 28 September.

requirements.title: Post the entries of negotiated and stale checks
acceptance: Negotiating a 15,000.00 check posts Dr 2241 / Cr bank 15,000.00.

requirements.title: Tag the Official Receipt or Acknowledgement Receipt
acceptance: A supplier's OR 12345 tagged on its DV removes the DV from the unregularised list.

requirements.title: Tag creditable withholding tax received or released
requirements.screens: Disbursement Voucher (OR / AR and CWT); Tax & Statutory > Certificates Received
acceptance: Recording an insurer 2307 of 2,000.00 on commission posts Dr AR-BIR on hand / Cr AR-BIR on commission 2,000.00.

requirements.title: Generate BIR Form 2307 for suppliers
acceptance: The 2307 of a supplier for Q3 shows the income and tax withheld of the quarter.

requirements.title: Run the end of day of Disbursement
requirements.screens: Disbursement End of Day (Run End of Day, Runs, outputs)
acceptance: The end of day of 30 September lists the DCTF, the check batch, the forms and six reports.
A second run of 30 September is refused.

requirements.title: Produce the Direct Credit Transaction File
acceptance: A CTA of 12,500.00 to account 001234567890 appears as one 89-character line with amount 000000012500.00.

requirements.title: Print checks and vouchers
requirements.screens: Disbursement End of Day (check batch, vouchers); Disbursement Voucher (Document)
acceptance: Three check DVs print checks 000125 to 000127 in order.

requirements.title: E-mail the payment confirmations and the remittance schedule
requirements.screens: Disbursement End of Day (Confirm); Disbursement Voucher (E-mails)
acceptance: Confirming the run of 30 September sends one advice per payee paid that day.

requirements.title: Fund the main BDOIR account with a verifier and two approvers
acceptance: disbtl creates, disbtl2 verifies, disbappr and disbappr2 approve; the transfer posts.
disbappr cannot give both approvals.

requirements.title: Maintain the check series
acceptance: A new series 000100-000199 is used from 000100.

requirements.title: Maintain the BDOIR bank accounts and their status
acceptance: An inactive account cannot be chosen as the paying account.

requirements.title: Run Disbursement reports on demand
acceptance: The masterlist of September exports to XLSX and prints landscape.

requirements.title: Generate the end-of-day reports
requirements.screens: Disbursement End of Day (outputs); Disbursement Reports
acceptance: The Remittance EOD report of 30 September lists every remittance DV approved that day.

requirements.title: Run the real-time Disbursement reports
acceptance: The unreleased-checks report puts a check printed 45 days ago in 31-60.

requirements.title: Report payees and upload fall-outs
acceptance: The fall-out report of September lists the 3 refused rows of an upload with their reasons.

requirements.title: Compute CPC2 incentives per remittance
requirements.screens: Remittance batch (CPC2 column and totals, Settlement tab); remittance payment request and schedule
acceptance: A packaged Motor line with a basic premium remitted of 100,000.00 and a CPC2 rate of 2% shows CPC2 2,000.00 plus VAT, and the batch payable is reduced by that amount.
Approving the batch posts OPS_REMIT_CPC2 with the CPC2 income.
A line whose booked transaction lost the CPC2 tag through an endorsement gets no CPC2, although the product still matches the CPC2 criteria.

requirements.title: Issue the service invoice of the early incentive automatically
requirements.screens: Remittance batch (Settlement tab - SI); Service invoices; Service invoice types (trigger ON_INCENTIVE)
acceptance: An early incentive of 5,000.00 produces one service invoice with 100.00 withholding tax, linked to its batch.
Issuing an EARLY_INCENTIVE service invoice by hand is refused with SERVICE_INVOICE_AUTOMATIC_ONLY.
A batch with three qualified transactions produces one service invoice with three lines, each naming its invoice and incentive, whose amount is the incentive of the batch with its taxes.

requirements.title: Report CPC2 incentives
acceptance: The CPC2 report of September lists every CPC2 line of the September batches and its total equals the CPC2 income posted in September.
A remitted transaction without the CPC2 tag is not on the report.

requirements.title: Link related transactions to one invoice number
requirements.screens: Invoice Search; Invoice 360 (Invoice Family tab); booking invoice (Root Invoice chip); ACSL Case; Disbursement Voucher
acceptance: The family of an invoice lists its endorsement and its cancellation with the family totals.

requirements.title: Receive refund and cash-advance requests in Requests Home
requirements.screens: Requests Home (tabs by stage with counts); Request
acceptance: The For Review tab of the reviewer shows the count and the requests waiting for him.
Selecting 3 requests and clicking Endorse shows one result per request.

requirements.title: Access the unapplied payment reports
acceptance: A Marketing processor exports the unapplied-payment report of September to XLSX.

requirements.title: Fill in the Refund Request Form
acceptance: An RRF with lines of two clients is refused with PRQ_ONE_CLIENT.
An RRF of 51 lines is refused.

requirements.title: Fill in the Request for Payment of a cash advance
acceptance: A cash advance without purpose is refused with PRQ_PURPOSE_REQUIRED.

requirements.title: Assign, re-assign and return requests
acceptance: A request re-assigned from mktao to mktao2 appears in mktao2's work.

requirements.title: Validate the refund of a cancelled policy with ACSL and Cashiering
acceptance: A refund of a cancelled policy goes For review only after ACSL confirms and Cashiering gives the new AR number.

requirements.title: Upload and view supporting documents
acceptance: A PDF and an XLSX attached to an RRF appear on the refund DV.

requirements.title: Submit, review and endorse requests
acceptance: mktao cannot endorse the request he submitted.

requirements.title: Approve or decline refunds, cash advances and check cancellations
acceptance: An approved cash advance is For HR approval; after HR approves it is Sent to Disbursement.

requirements.title: Cancel a request before approval
acceptance: A cancelled RRF frees its AR for a new request.

requirements.title: Request the cancellation of a disbursed check
acceptance: A check cancellation of a CTA refund is refused with PRQ_TARGET_NOT_CHECK.

requirements.title: Track the status of requests and extract them
requirements.screens: Requests Home; Request (History, Disbursement); Report Centre
acceptance: The status report of September lists each request with its stage and DV number.

requirements.title: Receive the disbursement confirmation
acceptance: A refund whose check is released shows Disbursed with the DV number.

requirements.title: Prevent duplicate refunds by AR number
acceptance: A second RRF for AR 2026-00123 is refused while the first is live.

requirements.title: Send approved requests to Disbursement and to HR
acceptance: An approved refund appears in the Disbursement workbench with its RRF number.

requirements.title: Record the client's payout account on approval
requirements.screens: Client (Payout accounts); New Refund Request (payout fields)
acceptance: The second refund of the same client to the same account does not add a second payout account.

requirements.title: Liquidate a cash advance
acceptance: Posting a liquidation of 4,500.00 against an advance of 5,000.00 posts the expenses and 500.00 cash returned against the advance of 5,000.00.

requirements.title: Generate the input files and run ACSL reports on demand
acceptance: The booked-accounts list of September for premium receivable exports to XLSX with the file name of the BRD.

requirements.title: Upload insurer statements of account
requirements.screens: Insurer SOA Reconciliation (Upload SOA; uploads list; upload log)
acceptance: An SOA of 1,200 rows with 3 rows without invoice number loads 1,197 rows and the log lists the 3 with their reason.
Uploading the same file again is refused with ACSL_SOA_DUPLICATE.

requirements.title: Reconcile the SOA against the booked transactions by invoice number
requirements.screens: Insurer SOA Reconciliation (upload - Results, Reconcile Again, Report)
acceptance: An SOA line whose invoice was remitted in batch RB-2026-12 shows Remitted with that batch and date.
An SOA line with an unknown invoice is Not found.

requirements.title: Reconcile GL and SL balances by GL code
acceptance: A premium receivable GL of 1,000,000.00 against an SL of 998,500.00 shows a difference of 1,500.00 and raises the alert.

requirements.title: Produce aging and schedule reports per account family
acceptance: The premium receivable aging report of September ages the open items per party, and its SL-GL difference equals that of the GL-SL reconciliation for the same date.

requirements.title: Investigate accounts and receive account analysis requests
requirements.screens: ACSL Cases (tabs by stage); ACSL Case; Invoice Search; Invoice 360 (Invoice Family)
acceptance: Searching by assured name finds the invoice; the case shows its endorsement and cancellation.

requirements.title: Give the result of the investigation to the requester
acceptance: Confirming the analysis request of a cancelled-policy refund marks the ACSL validation of the RRF Confirmed.

requirements.title: Apply AR refunds and request sub-ledger payment reversals
requirements.screens: ACSL Case (Request Payment Reversal); Cashiering (payment reversals)
acceptance: A reversal of 3,000.00 on OR 555 approved by a second cashier puts 3,000.00 back to unapplied and updates the case.

requirements.title: Coordinate short or over payments with the Account Officer
acceptance: The AO of invoice 2026-0456 receives the message about a short payment of 150.00.

requirements.title: Assign and re-assign correction entries
acceptance: A correction re-assigned to acslproc2 appears in her Draft tab.

requirements.title: Prepare a correction entry and route it for review
acceptance: A premium posted to 4110 instead of 4120 is corrected by a proposal that reverses 4110 and re-posts to 4120, both linked to the invoice.

requirements.title: Review and endorse the correction
acceptance: acsltl endorses the correction of acslproc; acslproc cannot endorse his own.

requirements.title: Approve, decline or return the correction with a comment
acceptance: A returned correction is Draft again with the Head's comment.

requirements.title: Post corrections automatically on approval
acceptance: An approved correction shows its journal ACS:COR-2026-5 and the invoice balance changes.

requirements.title: Deduct from the remittance on insurer confirmation
requirements.screens: Remittance Deductions (work list); Remittance Deduction (record, batches, insurer confirmation documents); Remittance batch (Settlement tab)
acceptance: A confirmed deduction of 10,000.00 reduces the next remittance of the insurer by 10,000.00 and posts OPS_REMIT_DEDUCTION.
A deduction of 50,000.00 against a batch payable of 30,000.00 consumes 30,000.00, settles the batch without a payment request and keeps 20,000.00 remaining.
acsl cannot confirm the deduction he recorded.

requirements.title: Track related transactions per invoice and insurer
acceptance: The family of an invoice cancelled and rebooked shows both with their cases.

requirements.title: Log in, session warnings and multiple tabs
requirements.screens: Login; session warning dialog; any Renewal screen in a second tab
acceptance: A user with the Processing TL profile logs in and sees the Renewal section with the Processing screens only.
The idle warning appears after 15 minutes of inactivity.
The user works on the Expiry List in one tab and on a record page in a second tab without losing either.

requirements.title: Restrict each function and each record to authorised users
requirements.screens: All Renewal screens; User Access Matrix
acceptance: A Marketing AO sees My Dispositions and the record pages of his accounts, and does not see the Processing Worklist or Renewal Setup.
A Marketing TL does not see candidates of another sales unit.
A LAMD user can upload a LAMD report and view match results, and cannot generate or send an RA.

requirements.title: Define profiles and assign Renewal functions
requirements.screens: Access Requests; User Access Matrix; Roles
acceptance: The function "Extract accounts for renewal per insurer" (6.002.2.20) is granted to the Processing Officer profile only after another user approves the request.
A user assigned the Marketing AO profile sees the Renewal screens of that profile at the next log-in.

requirements.title: Keep a complete audit trail of renewal actions
requirements.screens: Record page (History tab); Renewal Reports (RNW-DECISIONS, RNW-SANITATION)
acceptance: For a renewed account, the History tab lists extraction, initiation, bucket, disposition, post, insurer response, RA, acceptance and booking with user or source and time.
An extraction and the later initiation of the same candidate appear as two events with different users and times.
No screen or direct request allows history or audit rows to be edited or deleted.

requirements.title: Extract renewal candidates automatically at the lead days
acceptance: A policy expiring 140 days after the business date becomes a candidate that day, with a renewal reference, and does not appear twice after a second run.
A change of the lead days to 150 takes effect at the next run without a release.
An HMO policy is not extracted.
The extraction run records its date, time and trigger, and a policy is never extracted twice in the same cycle (BRRN.030, Walkthrough addendum p.8).

requirements.title: Generate the list of expiring accounts for a date range
acceptance: A TL generates the list for 01-Mar to 31-Mar and sees every candidate of his units expiring in March, and only those.
An end date before the start date cannot be submitted.
A range with no expiring account shows the empty-list message.

requirements.title: Filter the expiring list with multi-select criteria
acceptance: Choosing Risk Code "all except" MC01 lists every expiring account except those with risk code MC01.
Two Unit Heads selected together list the accounts of both.
Clear returns the full list.

requirements.title: Show the expiring list in one scrollable grid with column filters and search
requirements.screens: Expiry List (tabs Unassigned Disposition, For Renewal, For Quotation, For Proposal, Not for Renewal, Lost Business, Exceptions, All)
acceptance: A list of 20,000 candidates scrolls from the first to the last row without a pager, and the row count shows 20,000.
Typing a client name in the search box filters the list and highlights the name in each matching row.
A column moved to the first position stays first after the user logs out and in.

requirements.title: Export and print the expiring list
acceptance: The Excel file of a filtered list has exactly the rows and columns shown on screen.
The print preview shows the same rows as the printed pages.

requirements.title: Initiate renewal processing explicitly
acceptance: An extracted candidate stays EXTRACTED and appears in no worklist until it is initiated.
Bulk initiation of 200 CLG candidates records the user and time on each.
A Non-Mortgage candidate in a bulk selection is refused with the segment message.

requirements.title: Take over the expiries of the go-live window
requirements.screens: Renewal Home (extraction runs); Expiry List (Urgent pill); Processing Worklist (Upload RA already sent)
acceptance: After the go-live run every migrated policy expiring from go-live to 31 May 2028 is a candidate exactly once, and the January expiries show Urgent and come first in the lists.
A candidate whose RA is recorded from the tracker shows the RA as Sent with the legacy date and cannot be sent again.
A rejected tracker row is applied only after a second team member approves the correction.
The first daily extraction after go-live creates no second candidate for a policy expiring on 31 May 2028.

requirements.title: Run the sanitation, matching and eligibility checks
requirements.screens: Record page (Checks & Bucket tab); Renewal Reports (RNW-SANITATION)
acceptance: A candidate with an open endorsement request on the expiring invoice shows ENDORSEMENT_PENDING = FAIL on the Checks & Bucket tab.
When the endorsement is posted, the check turns PASS at the next event without user action.
The RNW-SANITATION report lists the failed checks of a date range with the candidate and detail.
A candidate with a total sum insured of PHP 300M fails TSI_THRESHOLD, is Review and is proposed For Proposal; one of PHP 200M passes the check.
A candidate on a risk code that is not in the check criteria fails RISK_CODE_DEFINED and is Review (manual review).

requirements.title: Use a unique renewal reference as the matching key
requirements.screens: Expiry List; record page; every upload
acceptance: Every candidate has a unique renewal reference.
A dispositioned-file row with an unknown reference is listed as an exception and updates nothing.

requirements.title: Classify candidates into Clean, Review and Exception buckets
requirements.screens: Expiry List (Classification pill, Exceptions tab, Bucket filter); record page (Checks & Bucket tab, Override Bucket)
acceptance: A candidate with an open claim is Review, never Clean.
When the claim closes, the candidate becomes Clean at the next re-evaluation and the bucket history shows both entries.
An override to Clean on a record with a failed check is refused.
The Checks & Bucket tab shows, for each bucket change, the rule-set version and the rule that set it.

requirements.title: Apply the decision matrix and rule-based disposition
requirements.screens: Renewal Setup (Decision Matrix); record page (disposition proposal); Renewal Reports (RNW-DECISIONS)
acceptance: A Clean CBG Motor candidate matching an AUTO rule receives disposition For Renewal with source MATRIX and moves on without user action.
A candidate with an open claim is not disposed automatically and shows the proposal to the AO.
The RNW-DECISIONS report shows, for each system disposition, the matrix version and rule.

The scenarios of the Walkthrough addendum (Annex BRRN.034, p.23) hold - a Clean renewal answered Renew As Is moves forward without user action; a rejected or revised insurer answer stops or reroutes the renewal; a failed rule sends it to manual handling; an unresolved endorsement blocks it.

requirements.title: Tag non-renewable risk codes and send the NFR
requirements.screens: Renewal Setup (Non-renewable Risk Codes); Letters (NFR tab)
acceptance: A candidate on a non-renewable risk code is tagged Not for Renewal, does not appear in Unassigned Disposition, and an NFR is generated.
The Letters tab shows the NFR with its sent status.
A code change takes effect only after the checker authorises it.

requirements.title: Ingest LAMD reports and route paid-off and RMU accounts
acceptance: A paid-off PN matching an expiring candidate tags it Not for Renewal with reason Loan fully paid.
A CBG Motor candidate without a PN is Exception.
A LAMD user cannot see the RA or disposition actions.

requirements.title: Flag accounts due for KYC review
requirements.screens: Expiry List (flag chip KYC due); record page; Renewal Reports
acceptance: A candidate whose client KYC review is due in 20 days shows the KYC due chip, and its bucket is unchanged.
The renewal status report shows the flag and the date it was identified.

requirements.title: Reflect endorsements on the mother policy before approval
requirements.screens: Record page (Checks & Bucket, Account History); TL Review
acceptance: The TL cannot post a candidate while an endorsement request on the expiring invoice is open.
After the endorsement is posted, the renewal account shows the endorsed sum insured.
The record lists the linked endorsement numbers.

requirements.title: Resolve the package of a migrated policy at sanitation
requirements.screens: Record page (Checks & Bucket, Package panel); Expiry List (bucket Exception)
acceptance: A migrated policy whose legacy package maps to one BIBS version passes the check and shows that version.
A migrated policy with an unmapped package is in the Exception bucket until a processor's choice is approved by a second processor.
The same user cannot choose and approve the package.

requirements.title: Assign and re-assign accounts to Marketing AOs
requirements.screens: Expiry List (tab Unassigned Disposition; Assign Disposition, Re-assign Officer)
acceptance: Accounts assigned to an AO leave the Unassigned Disposition tab and appear in the AO's My Dispositions.
A TL cannot assign an account to an officer of another unit.
A CBG account never appears in Unassigned Disposition.

requirements.title: Transfer an account to another Marketing unit
requirements.screens: Expiry List and My Dispositions (Transfer); Transfers (Outgoing)
acceptance: A submitted transfer removes the account from the sender's list and shows it in the receiving TL's Transfers inbox.
A transfer to the same unit is refused.

requirements.title: Receive, accept or decline transferred accounts
acceptance: An accepted account appears in the receiving unit's Unassigned Disposition tab with the Transferred flag.
A declined account returns to the sender with the decline remarks visible.

requirements.title: View all my accounts in one scrollable list
requirements.screens: My Dispositions (quick filters Returned to me, Due in 30 days, NRNS)
acceptance: An AO sees his accounts of the current and previous years without choosing a filter.
Sorting by expiry date ascending and descending works on every column.
A search by the client's name returns the AO's accounts of that client.
An endorsement posted on the mother policy shows in the list without a new extraction.

requirements.title: View a renewal account and download its details
requirements.screens: Renewal record page (tabs Details, Checks & Bucket, Account History, Computations, Insurer, Letters, Documents, Remarks & Follow-ups, History)
acceptance: The Details tab shows every field of the expiring list for the account.
The PDF and Excel downloads contain the same values as the Details tab.

requirements.title: View the full account history before the disposition
acceptance: The history of a renewed account lists the previous year's ARN, its endorsements, payments and claims.
A disposition submitted without opening the history is refused with the message.
Once opened, the disposition is accepted.

requirements.title: Give the disposition of an account
acceptance: An AO disposes an account For Renewal and pushes it; it appears in the TL Review list with status Review in progress.
Not for Renewal without a reason cannot be pushed.
A push with missing mandatory fields names every missing field.

requirements.title: Add remarks to an account
requirements.screens: Record page (Remarks & Follow-ups tab); Disposition panel
acceptance: A saved remark shows the user ID, date and time.
A 201-character remark cannot be saved.

requirements.title: List my dispositioned accounts with status, flags and lock
acceptance: An account with a posted endorsement shows the Endorsed chip and the endorsement's effective date.
A closed account shows the padlock and cannot be edited.

requirements.title: Update returned accounts
requirements.screens: My Dispositions (quick filter Returned to me); record page
acceptance: A returned account shows the red Returned chip and the TL's remarks.
After the AO pushes it, the account is back in the TL Review list without the chip.

requirements.title: Re-open accounts tagged Not for Renewal
acceptance: A Not for Renewal account re-opened ten days before expiry returns to FOR_DISPOSITION.
The earlier disposition and the sent NFR stay in the history.

requirements.title: Route renewals with financial or structural changes to the New Business path
requirements.screens: Record page (Start NB Path); Quotation; Proposal (PRF)
acceptance: A renewal with a 10% premium increase from the insurer is tagged For Proposal / New Business Path with the reason.
The quotation created from the candidate carries the renewal reference, and its booked invoice has business type RENEWAL.
The candidate closes RENEWED when the quotation's account is booked.

requirements.title: Review, return and post dispositioned accounts
requirements.screens: TL Review (Review in progress list; Return, Post)
acceptance: A posted For Renewal account appears in the Processing Worklist, tab For Processing.
A returned account is back in the AO's list with the Returned flag and the TL's remarks.
An account with a failing outstanding-premium check cannot be posted until the TL overrides it.

requirements.title: Override the outstanding-balance flag and other controlled overrides
requirements.screens: TL Review (Override Outstanding Balance); record page (Override)
acceptance: An account with an unpaid premium shows the Outstanding flag; after the TL's override it can be posted.
An override without remarks is refused.
The RNW-DECISIONS report lists the override with the TL and the remarks.

requirements.title: Upload dispositioned files
requirements.screens: Processing Worklist (Upload Dispositioned File); bulk upload wizard RNW_DISPOSITION_UPLOAD
acceptance: A file of 500 rows with 3 unknown references updates 497 accounts and lists the 3 errors.
With "Complete file for March, unit X" ticked, a March account of unit X absent from the file is tagged Not for Renewal (Non-renewable Accounts).
Without the complete-file tick, no account is tagged.

requirements.title: Assign accounts to Processing Officers
requirements.screens: Processing Worklist (Assign PO, Assign to Me)
acceptance: Accounts assigned to an officer appear in his In Processing tab.
Assign to Me makes the TL the assignee.

requirements.title: Work the processing list
requirements.screens: Processing Worklist (tabs For Processing, In Processing, With Insurer, Insurer Responded, Returned)
acceptance: A Processing Officer sees only the accounts assigned to him in In Processing.
Sorting and column filters work on every column.

requirements.title: Update data on the renewal account
requirements.screens: Record page (Renewal Account); Account (BRD-1 draft edit)
acceptance: The renewal account of a Motor policy has the next period and the same vehicle, insurer and PN as the expiring account.
An update that leaves a mandatory field blank cannot be pushed.
After placement the renewal account cannot be edited.

requirements.title: Review computations and the financial impact
acceptance: The Computations tab shows the same premium components as the renewal account's premium breakdown.
A renewal premium different from the expiring premium fails FINANCIAL_IMPACT and shows the difference.

requirements.title: Return accounts to Marketing
requirements.screens: Processing Worklist; record page (Return to Marketing)
acceptance: An account returned to the AO appears in his Returned to me filter with the red flag.
A return without a reason is refused.

requirements.title: Extract For Renewal accounts per insurer and send them
acceptance: A batch for insurer X and March lists every For Renewal account of X expiring in March with the 28 columns.
The insurer receives a password-protected Excel file and, separately, the password.
The accounts of a sent batch move to With Insurer.

requirements.title: Receive and apply insurer responses
requirements.screens: Insurer Batches (Upload Response, Match Review); record page (Insurer tab)
acceptance: A matched Renew As Is moves the account to RA Ready with unchanged premium and terms.
A row whose policy number differs from the candidate's is not applied and the account shows Exception.
A Revise with a higher premium returns the account to In Processing and fails FINANCIAL_IMPACT.

requirements.title: Generate the Renewal Advice
requirements.screens: Letters (tabs RA Ready, RA Generated, RA Sent; Generate, Preview, Download ZIP)
acceptance: A Marketing AO generates First Notice RAs for 50 accounts; each has an RA number and a PDF on the Letters tab.
After generation the AO cannot change the disposition of those accounts.
An RA generated 20 days before expiry requires the user's confirmation.
A user without RNW_RA_GENERATE cannot generate an RA.

requirements.title: Send Renewal Advices in batch, encrypted and password-protected
requirements.screens: Letters (tab RA Generated; Send in Batch, Extract Details)
acceptance: Sending 50 RAs produces 50 protected e-mails and 50 password e-mails, and the accounts show RA Sent / Awaiting Response.
A failed send is listed with the error and can be resent.

requirements.title: Generate and send the closing letters (NAL and NRL)
requirements.screens: Letters (NAL / NFR tab, with the period, segment, unit head and status filters)
acceptance: A NAL is sent to an eligible account and the account shows NAL Sent.
An account with a NAL cannot receive an NRL, and an account with an NRL cannot receive a NAL.
An unrenewed account without RA at its effective expiry date is listed for its Marketing AO for the NRL; one with an RA sent is listed for Operations for the NAL.

requirements.title: NRNS reminders and non-acceptance letters
acceptance: A candidate without disposition 90 days before expiry gets one reminder letter and the NRNS chip.
A candidate already disposed For Renewal and accepted gets no reminder.
At expiry without acceptance the candidate closes EXPIRED_UNRENEWED with a non-acceptance letter.
A candidate with a confirmed 30-day hold cover is not tagged NRNS and gets no closing letter until the hold cover ends.

requirements.title: Record client acceptance and proceed to placement and booking
requirements.screens: Record page (Record Acceptance); bulk upload RNW_ACCEPTANCE
acceptance: After the AO records the acceptance and the payment gate passes, the Processing user places and the booking user books the renewal account without re-keying; nothing is placed without a user action.
The booked invoice shows business type RENEWAL and the candidate is RENEWED.
Acceptance of a renewal with a failed financial-impact check needs evidence.

requirements.title: Contact Center follow-up
acceptance: A Contact Center user records a call outcome and uploads a signed RA; the AO sees both on the record.
A Contact Center user cannot see the premium columns.

requirements.title: Request and confirm a hold cover from the renewal
requirements.screens: Record page (Hold Cover panel of the renewal account, Request Hold Cover, Record Confirmation, Cancel Hold Cover); Expiry List and Letters (HC confirmed chip)
acceptance: A hold cover of 60 days requested from a renewal is e-mailed to the insurer and the request shows its date and requester.
After the confirmation is recorded, the renewal shows HC confirmed and its effective expiry date is the end of the hold cover.
A second request while the first is confirmed is refused; after it is cancelled, a new request is accepted.

requirements.title: Evaluate the incentive eligibility of a renewal after booking and full payment
requirements.screens: Booked Invoice (incentive indicator); Booked Accounts Register; renewal record (Details); Renewal Reports
acceptance: A booked renewal not yet fully paid has no incentive indicator; when it becomes Fully Paid and the acceptance is confirmed, the indicator is set from the matching criteria.
A renewal cancelled after booking shows the indicator invalidated, with the reason in the history.
No user can set the indicator by hand.

requirements.title: Renew submitted policies handed over by Submitted Policies
acceptance: A submitted CBG Motor policy handed over creates one candidate, one renewal account with a hold cover request and one RA.
A second hand-off of the same SBM number creates nothing new.
When the renewal account is booked, the masterlist record shows BOOKED.

requirements.title: Renewal home and officer dashboards
acceptance: A Marketing TL sees, for each AO of his unit, the number of assigned open accounts.
Clicking "Expiring in 30 days" opens the list filtered to 30 days.

requirements.title: Renewal status report with summary
acceptance: RNW-STATUS for March with Risk Code "all except" MC01 lists the March invoices except MC01 and shows the 34 counters.
The Excel and PDF exports have the same rows as the screen.
The Processing variant shows the renewal processor, the assigned AO and the sum insured per cover.

requirements.title: Centralised renewal listings with attention flags
requirements.screens: Renewal Reports (RNW-LISTING); Renewal Home (At risk tile)
acceptance: A listing of IBG for the next month shows each account with its status and days to expiry.
An IBG account not disposed 59 days before expiry shows the ageing flag with its rule in the listing, and no alert is sent to the unit head.

requirements.title: Operational renewal reports
acceptance: RNW-DECISIONS lists each system disposition with the matrix version and rule, and each override with user and remarks.
RNW-RA-DISPATCH lists every RA of a range with recipient and send status.

requirements.title: Maintain the renewal lists of values
acceptance: A new non-renewal reason effective next month is selectable from that date only.
An end-dated reason stays visible on the accounts that used it.

requirements.title: Update the Renewal Advice and letter templates
acceptance: An RA generated after the new version is activated shows the new layout and version.

requirements.title: Maintain renewal rules and parameters
requirements.screens: Renewal Setup (Check Settings, Bucket Rules, Decision Matrix, Non-renewable Risk Codes, Parameters)
acceptance: Changing the lead days from 140 to 120 applies from the next extraction run.
A bucket rule that maps a failed check to Clean cannot be saved.
A user without RNW_SETUP who tries to change a check setting is refused (SC-07).

requirements.title: Log in to BIBS with lockout and session rules
acceptance: A user with valid credentials and a Claims role logs in and sees the Claims Handling menu section.

The fourth attempt after three wrong passwords, with the correct password, is refused with the same message as a wrong password because the account is locked; the lock shows to the System Administrator.
An idle session ends after the configured timeout.

requirements.title: Restrict each Claims action to authorised roles
acceptance: A Claims Officer does not see the Close action; a direct close call is refused with ACCESS_DENIED.
A Team Lead overrides the claimant name; a Claims Officer cannot.
A Marketing AO opens the Claims reports and does not see the Claims worklist.

requirements.title: Keep a complete claim history and audit trail
requirements.screens: Claim record (History tab); Claims Activity Log report
acceptance: For a closed claim, the History tab lists every status change, the settlement and the closure with user and time.
A reserve amendment shows the previous and new amounts and the reason.
No screen or direct request allows history rows to be edited or deleted.

requirements.title: Look up a cover (read-only)
acceptance: A Claims Officer finds a cover by policy number and sees its endorsements and invoice payment status.
The Cover Lookup offers no edit action on the account.
A user without BCL_COVER_VIEW cannot open Cover Lookup.

requirements.title: Record a claim on a cover
acceptance: A claim cannot be saved without cover number, policy year and cover version.
A new claim on a USD cover has currency USD; on a cover without currency it has PHP.
A recorded claim has a BCL number, phase NEW and a next follow-up date.
An insurer-reported claim shows the source "Insurer-reported" and the insurer claim number.

requirements.title: Maintain the reported date
acceptance: A reported date later than today is refused.
A corrected reported date changes the age overall of the claim on the next report run.
A Claims Officer without BCL_STATUS_UPDATE cannot correct the date after recording.

requirements.title: Show the policy number without re-keying
requirements.screens: Record Claim (cover card); Claim record (summary); invoice screens of BRD-1 and BRD-2
acceptance: A claim on an issued cover shows the policy number of the policy year without any entry by the user.
The invoice of the cover shows the same policy number.

requirements.title: Show the Marketing team, AO and branch of the policy
requirements.screens: Record Claim (cover card); Claim record (summary card); Claims reports
acceptance: A new claim shows the Marketing team and AO of the account.
The Outstanding Claims report lists the Marketing Team and Account Officer of each claim.

requirements.title: Validate the claim against the latest cover version and flag a newer version
requirements.screens: Claim record (summary card, flag "Newer cover version")
acceptance: A claim recorded on a cover with two booked endorsements is validated against version 2 and shows the cover number and version used.
An endorsement booked after the loss date is used for the validation and is marked as effective after the loss date.
After an endorsement of the policy year is booked, the claim shows "Newer cover version".
The cover panel of the claim has no edit action.

requirements.title: Check premium payment and control the claims authorization code
requirements.screens: Record Claim (cover card); Claim record (flag "Unpaid premium", action Generate Authorization Code)
acceptance: On a cover with one unpaid endorsement invoice, the claim shows "Unpaid premium" with the invoice and its balance, and the code cannot be generated.
After the invoice is paid in Cashiering, the claim shows PAID and the code can be generated.
A cancelled unpaid invoice does not block the code.
The premium check answers within 5 seconds (NFR 15.05).

requirements.title: Link several insured locations to one claim
requirements.screens: Record Claim (locations picker); Claim record (Locations tab)
acceptance: A claim on a property cover with three locations can link two of them and keeps one claim number.
A location of another account, or one not on the cover, cannot be linked.
Each linked location is viewable on the Locations tab with its address.

requirements.title: Record several insurer claim numbers under one claim
requirements.screens: Claim record (Insurers & Updates tab); Claims worklist (search)
acceptance: A claim with two insurers holds two insurer claim numbers and remains one claim.
Entering the same number twice for the same insurer on the same claim is refused.
A number already recorded for the same insurer on another claim is refused and the other claim is named.
Searching the worklist by an insurer claim number opens the BDOI claim.

requirements.title: Record insurer-reported claims and insurer updates
requirements.screens: Claim record (Insurers & Updates tab, timeline); Bulk Upload (BCL_INSURER_UPDATE)
acceptance: An insurer update with date, source and remarks appears in the claim timeline.
An update cannot be edited after saving.
A file of 50 updates with one unmatched row is refused as a whole and the row is named.

requirements.title: Maintain insurer location references
requirements.screens: Insurer Location References; Cover Lookup; Claim record (Locations tab); Bulk Upload (BCL_LOCATION_REF)
acceptance: A claim location shows the internal address and the reference of each insurer.
Changing a reference keeps the old one with its end date.

requirements.title: Send the loss advice to the insurer
requirements.screens: Claim record (action Send Loss Advice; Documents tab; E-mails)
acceptance: The loss advice of a Non-Motor claim shows the assigned adjuster and the insurer claim numbers.
The sent advice appears on the Documents tab as a claims report and in the client's documents.

requirements.title: Override or input the claimant's name
requirements.screens: Claim record (Details tab, action Override Claimant)
acceptance: A new claim shows the assured as claimant.
A Team Lead overrides the claimant with a reason; the claim shows "Claimant overridden".
A Claims Officer does not see the override action.

requirements.title: Maintain adjusters / appraisers and assign them to claims
requirements.screens: Broking Setup, Lists of values (BCL_ADJUSTER); Claim record (action Assign Adjuster)
acceptance: The adjuster list offers the 25 companies of the BRD.
A Team Lead assigns an adjuster; a Claims Officer cannot.
An adjuster added by the Unit Head is selectable only after another user authorises it.

requirements.title: Record and amend the insurer reserve
requirements.screens: Claim record (Reserve & Settlement tab, action Amend Reserve)
acceptance: A Team Lead amends the reserve; the history shows the previous and new amounts.
A Claims Officer cannot amend the reserve after recording.
A reserve change produces no journal entry.

requirements.title: Maintain catastrophe codes and tag claims
requirements.screens: Broking Setup, Lists of values (BCL_CATASTROPHE); Record Claim; Claim record (Details tab)
acceptance: A claim tagged Typhoon with the event name shows the CAT flag.
The Unit Head adds a new code; it is selectable after authorisation.

requirements.title: Maintain the claim status values
requirements.screens: Broking Setup, Lists of values (BCL_CLAIM_STATUS); Claims Setup (status attributes)
