acceptance: The status list offers the 18 BRD values when BIBS is first set up.
A status added by the Unit Head is selectable only after authorisation and after its phase is set.

requirements.title: Restrict status selection by role and unit
requirements.screens: Claims Setup (Status Access Matrix; Claims Handler Register); Claim record (Change Status)
acceptance: A Claims Officer of Motor HO sees only the statuses the matrix gives the officer role.
A direct direct request setting a status outside the matrix is refused.
A matrix row takes effect only after another user authorises it.

requirements.title: Change the claim status
requirements.screens: Claim record (action Change Status; History tab)
acceptance: A status change resets "age this stage" to zero and keeps the age overall.
The status history shows the days spent in each earlier status.
A status update is saved within 1 minute (NFR 15.06).

requirements.title: Maintain the requested types of settlement
requirements.screens: Broking Setup, Lists of values (BCL_SETTLEMENT_TYPE); Claims Setup (settlement attributes)
acceptance: The settlement type list offers the 10 BRD values with their outcome.
Changing "Settled - LOA Issued - Vehicle Under Repair" to not close the claim takes effect without a change to the system.

requirements.title: Set the requested type of settlement
requirements.screens: Claim record (Reserve & Settlement tab, action Set Settlement)
acceptance: Setting "Settled" without an amount is refused.
A Team Lead sets "Settled - Signed Release Papers Returned" with amount and date; the claim appears in the Settled Claims report.
A Claims Officer does not see the Set Settlement action.
The payment method reported by the insurer (for example fund transfer for a non-motor claim, LOA for a motor claim) is recorded with the settlement.

requirements.title: Close a claim temporarily or permanently and reopen it
requirements.screens: Claim record (Change Status, Set Settlement, Reopen); Claims worklist (tabs Temporarily Closed, Closed)
acceptance: A claim in status 18 appears in the Temporarily Closed tab and in the Outstanding Claims report.
A claim closed with "Closed - Denied" appears in the Closed tab and no longer ages.
A Team Lead cannot reopen a closed claim; a Team Head reopens it with a reason.

requirements.title: Request the claims special remittance for claims awaiting premium remittance
requirements.screens: Claim record (flag "Awaiting premium remittance", link Request Special Remittance); Special Remittance request (BRD-2)
acceptance: A claim set to status 11 appears in the CLAIMS_SPECIAL_REMIT feed with its unremitted invoice.
A claims special remittance for an invoice without such a claim is refused by Operations.
The handler is notified when the invoice is fully remitted.

requirements.title: Compute and override the next follow-up date
requirements.screens: Claim record (summary card; action Override Follow-up Date); Claims worklist (Follow-ups Due)
acceptance: A status with 5 follow-up days set on 1 March gives a next follow-up date of 6 March.
A Team Lead overrides the date with a reason; a Claims Officer cannot.

requirements.title: Encode the next action plan summary
requirements.screens: Claim record (Details tab, Next Action Plan); Claims worklist; Outstanding reports
acceptance: The current action plan appears in the Follow Ups / Remarks column of the Outstanding Claims report.
The history shows the earlier versions of the text.

requirements.title: Keep a diary per claim and per handler
acceptance: A diary entry assigned to another handler appears in that handler's My Diary.
A diary entry can be added to a closed claim.

requirements.title: Compute the age of claims overall and per status
requirements.screens: Claim record (summary card); Claims worklist; ageing reports
acceptance: A claim reported on 1 March and open on 31 March has age overall 30.
A claim closed on 15 March keeps age overall 14 after closure.
A claim that spent 5 days in status 3 and is 2 days in status 8 shows age this stage 2 and history 5 days for status 3.

requirements.title: Track pending actions and remind handlers
requirements.screens: Claims worklist (tab Follow-ups Due); Claims home; Pending Actions report
acceptance: A claim with next follow-up date today appears in Follow-ups Due and the handler is notified at 06:00.
A claim two days past its follow-up date raises one overdue alert.

requirements.title: Claims home and worklist
acceptance: The Claims Home loads within 5 seconds (NFR 15.03).
A search by an insurer claim number returns the BDOI claim.
A Team Lead reassigns ten claims in one action; the new handler is notified.

requirements.title: Claims ageing reports
acceptance: A claim 45 days old appears in bucket 31-60 of BCL-AGEING.
BCL-AGEING-STATUS groups claims by status and shows age this stage.
A report is generated within 5 minutes (NFR 15.09-15.13).

requirements.title: Outstanding, past due, settled and pending actions reports
acceptance: A temporarily closed claim appears in the Outstanding Claims list.
A claim open for 95 days appears in the 90 Days Past Due variant; a claim open for 80 days does not.
A claim closed "Closed - Denied" does not appear in the Settled Claims list.

requirements.title: Loss experience and loss ratio reports
requirements.screens: Reports (category Claims Handling); account page (Claims tab, loss summary)
acceptance: A claim with reserve 100,000 and paid 60,000 shows O/S 40,000 and total 100,000.
A cover with premium 50,000 and losses 25,000 shows a loss ratio of 50.00%.
Renewal shows the same claim count and totals for the account as the Loss Experience report.

requirements.title: Identify claims-prone locations
acceptance: A location with 3 claims in the last 3 years is flagged claims-prone.
Filtering by Flood lists only the claims tagged Flood.
The drill-down lists the claims of the location with their numbers.

requirements.title: Give authorised users the data for their own analysis
requirements.screens: Reports (Claims Data Extract); saved report variants
acceptance: A claim with two insurers and three locations gives six rows in the extract.
A Claims Officer without BCL_DATA_EXTRACT cannot run the extract.

requirements.title: Give Marketing controlled access to loss information
requirements.screens: Reports (Claims Handling); account page (Claims tab, loss summary)
acceptance: A Marketing AO views the Loss Experience report and cannot download it.
A Marketing TL downloads the report in Excel.
A Marketing AO cannot open a claim record.
A Marketing AO views the Claims Aging Report.

requirements.title: Insurer claim number register and claims activity log
acceptance: The Insurer Claim Numbers report lists both numbers of a two-insurer claim under the same BDOI claim number.
The Claims Activity Log lists a location reference change with the old and new reference.

requirements.title: Restrict documents and reports to authorised users
requirements.screens: All EB screens; Reports; Documents tabs
acceptance: A Collection user opens the EB SOA register and does not see the comparative approval action.
A user without EB_REPORT_VIEW cannot run the EB reports.
An authorised Processing user downloads a policy form without error.

requirements.title: Link every document to its transaction and restrict it by department
requirements.screens: Programme page (Documents tab); Member Changes; SOA Register
acceptance: A direct billing document uploaded by the AO on a member change is visible to Processing and Collection.
A utilization report is not listed for a Collection user.
An EB upload without a process tag is refused.

requirements.title: Log key actions and keep the history of proposals and documents
requirements.screens: Programme page (History tab); Proposal and comparative pages (Versions)
acceptance: The History tab of a placed cycle lists the RA, the proposals, the comparative sign-off, the confirmation and the placement trigger with user and time.
A revised proposal shows version 2 and the differences from version 1.
No screen allows an audit or version row to be changed.

requirements.title: Protect documents sent outside BDOI
requirements.screens: Send dialogs of the Programme page (TOR, RA, comparative, franchise, revision)
acceptance: A TOR sent as Word arrives protected, and the password arrives in a separate e-mail.
A CSV master list is refused for outbound sending.

requirements.title: Give insurers and client HR users a separate, secure portal
requirements.screens: Portal sign-in; Portal home; Accept invitation
acceptance: An insurer user signs in and sees only the requests of its own insurer.
A portal user who tries to open a BIBS staff function is refused.
The fourth failed sign-in locks the portal user.

requirements.title: Provision portal users through User Access requests
requirements.screens: User Access Requests (user type External); Portal Users (Setup & Administration)
acceptance: A portal user exists only after another user approves the request.
The invitation e-mail contains a link and no password.
A client HR user created for client A cannot see client B's programmes.

requirements.title: Stage portal uploads and link them automatically
acceptance: An insurer's proposal upload is linked to the request and client without any selection by the insurer.
An executable file is refused with ATTACHMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.
A staged master list does not change the roster until the AO validates it.

requirements.title: Review, validate or reject portal uploads
requirements.screens: Portal Uploads (review queue); EB Home (tile Portal uploads to review)
acceptance: An insurer's policy form appears in the Processing queue, not the AO's.
A rejected upload shows the reason on the insurer's portal task.
A validated proposal counts in the comparative; a staged one does not.

requirements.title: Insurer task inbox and structured proposal form
requirements.screens: Portal home (tasks); Requests for Proposal; Franchise Requests; Member Changes; SOA and Policy Forms
acceptance: A proposal form shows one line per TOR item of the request.
A submission with an unanswered TOR item is refused.
An insurer cannot submit a proposal without an open request.

requirements.title: Client HR portal
requirements.screens: Portal - Programmes; Members; Uploads; Comparative; Renewal Advice and Documents
acceptance: A client HR user sees the roster of its company and no other company.
A master list with a missing birth date on row 12 is refused with the row named.
Each download appears in the portal download log.

requirements.title: Capture and tag new clients as prospect or client
acceptance: A new EB prospect is created and appears in the prospect search.
A second record with the same identifiers is refused with CLIENT_DUPLICATE.

requirements.title: Open an EB programme and its cycles with the business type
acceptance: A programme with HMO and GLI lines is saved with an EBP number.
A renewal cycle creates accounts of business type RENEWAL.
A cycle cannot be saved without its business type.

requirements.title: Send the renewal advice automatically before expiry
requirements.screens: EB Home (tile RA due); Programmes (tab Renewal Due; bulk Send RA); Programme page
acceptance: A programme expiring in 135 days receives the RA and moves to RA_SENT.
A programme without the renewal flag receives no RA.
The RA is listed in the client's documents as a renewal advice.

requirements.title: Collect and record client feedback
requirements.screens: Programme page (Cycle tab, Record Feedback); Portal - Uploads
acceptance: Feedback without text or file is refused.
Feedback recorded on a renewal cycle stops the RA reminders.

requirements.title: Send the incumbent's indicative renewal proposal
acceptance: The indicative proposal of a renewal shows the current policy number, coverage and incumbent rates.
The action is not available on a new-business cycle.

requirements.title: Upload TOR, master list and utilization report
acceptance: Uploading a second master list makes it version 2 and marks version 1 superseded.
The incumbent sees the task "Upload unnamed master list" in the portal.

requirements.title: Upload and validate the signed Broker on Record
acceptance: A franchise request on a new-business cycle without a validated BOR is refused.
A rejected BOR re-uploaded becomes version 2 with status Uploaded.

requirements.title: Request franchise from insurers and record their decision
requirements.screens: Programme page (Franchise tab); Portal - Franchise Requests
acceptance: An insurer approves a franchise in the portal and the AO is notified.
A request without a decision after the TAT becomes EXPIRED and raises an alert.
The TOR cannot be released to an insurer whose franchise is rejected.

requirements.title: Advise the client of the franchise outcome
acceptance: The client receives the franchise outcome and the request shows ADVISED.
An outcome not advised within 2 working days raises an alert.

requirements.title: Submit the required documents to insurers per process
requirements.screens: Programme page (Submissions); Member Changes; EB Setup (Required Documents)
acceptance: A renewal placement submission without the master list is refused.
Processing sees the submission on the programme.

requirements.title: Prepare the TOR and distribute it to insurers
requirements.screens: Programme page (TOR tab; Insurer Requests tab)
acceptance: A TOR sent to three insurers creates three requests with the same TOR version.
An insurer with a rejected franchise cannot be selected.
Each insurer's download of the TOR is logged.

requirements.title: Record and validate insurer proposals
acceptance: A submitted proposal is not in the comparative until validated.
A proposal entered by the AO shows the source AO and the attached document.

requirements.title: Prepare and sign off the comparative analysis
acceptance: A comparative of three validated proposals shows one column per insurer and the lowest premium per plan.
The maker cannot sign off the comparative.
The comparative exports to PDF and Excel with the same content.

requirements.title: Trigger approval when a value threshold is met
requirements.screens: EB Setup (Threshold Rules); My Approvals; Comparative page
acceptance: A comparative with a recommended annual premium above the rule amount waits for Management approval.
Placement cannot be triggered before the threshold approval.
A rule changed by the administrator applies after authorisation without a change to the system.

requirements.title: Present the comparative to the client
requirements.screens: Comparative page (Present to Client); Portal - Comparative
acceptance: The client HR user sees the comparative in the portal and downloads the PDF.
A client comment notifies the AO.

requirements.title: Capture client changes and relay them to insurers
acceptance: A revision relayed to two insurers shows two open targets.
A revision with no items is refused.

requirements.title: Insurers update their proposals against a revision
requirements.screens: Portal - Requests for Proposal (revision); Proposal page (Versions)
acceptance: A revised proposal that skips a requested item is refused.
The proposal page shows version 2 with the changed items highlighted.

requirements.title: Record the client's confirmation and trigger placement
requirements.screens: Programme page (Confirm; Trigger Placement); Portal - Comparative (Confirm)
acceptance: Triggering placement for an HMO and a GLI line creates two accounts with the cycle's business type.
The trigger is refused while the threshold approval is pending.
The cycle becomes PLACED when both accounts are booked.

requirements.title: Assign, reassign and return work with remarks
requirements.screens: My Work queues; workflow panels of the EB and account records
acceptance: A supervisor reassigns a member change; the new processor is notified.
A returned item shows the reason and remarks to the AO.

requirements.title: Track policy issuance after placement
requirements.screens: Account page (BRD-1); Programme page (Cycle tab); Pending Items
acceptance: The EB documents linked at the trigger are on the account's Documents tab.
A validated policy form from the portal becomes the account's e-policy.

requirements.title: Book the account with an insurer billing number duplicate check
acceptance: Booking an HMO account without a billing number is refused.
A second booking with the same insurer and billing number is refused.

requirements.title: Receive, validate and release the SOA and track payment
requirements.screens: SOA Register; Portal - SOA and Policy Forms; Programme page (Billing & SOA)
acceptance: A second SOA with the same number from the same insurer is refused.
A released SOA is visible to the client HR user in the portal.
Paying the invoice in Cashiering notifies the AO and Collection.

requirements.title: Maintain the member roster from the master list
acceptance: A master list with a duplicate employee number is refused with the row named.
An accepted roster version replaces the previous one; the earlier version stays readable.

requirements.title: Capture member changes and relay them to the insurer
requirements.screens: Member Changes; Portal - Member Changes; Bulk Upload (EB_MEMBER_CHANGE)
acceptance: A new hire entered by the HR user is relayed to the insurer as a task.
Deleting an employee who is not on the roster is refused.
A validated financial change raises an endorsement request with reference EBM-yyyy-nnnnnn.

requirements.title: Upload insurer direct billing for member changes
acceptance: A direct billing uploaded on a member change is opened by a Collection user.
The member change shows "Direct billed".

requirements.title: Monitor contracts, HMO cards and billing with automatic follow-ups
requirements.screens: Pending Items; Programme page (Pending Items tab); EB Home
acceptance: Adding a member creates a pending HMO card item.
An item 5 working days past due receives a follow-up e-mail.
The Pending Items list filters by member.

requirements.title: EB reports
acceptance: The Renewal report lists a programme with its RA sent date and the number of proposals received.
The Production report filtered by team BDO shows only that team's programmes.
The weekly Renewal report and the monthly Placement report reach their subscribers on schedule.

requirements.title: New Business report, business type filter and Word export
acceptance: The Production report filtered by business type Renewal excludes new-business accounts.
The New Business report exports to Word with the same rows as the PDF.

requirements.title: TAT monitoring, EB home and alerts
acceptance: A franchise decided in 7 working days appears as a breach in the TAT report.
The tile "Portal uploads to review" opens the review queue.

requirements.title: Log in with user ID and password
acceptance: An agent with valid credentials lands on the Customer Search.
Wrong credentials are refused and no session is created.
A user without a CSF role does not see the CSF menu section.

requirements.title: Restrict CSF actions to authorised roles
acceptance: A CSF Management user does not see the Update Contact action.
An agent's direct call to resend to another address is refused with ACCESS_DENIED.

requirements.title: Search a client by name, client ID, account, PN or application number
acceptance: A search by PN number returns the client of the account with that PN.
A search by application number returns the client of the placement billing item.
A search with no result shows "No client found" with the criteria.
A search returns within 3 seconds (p.30).

requirements.title: View current client information and accounts
requirements.screens: Servicing View (summary card; tabs Accounts, Payments, Renewal Advice, E-policies, Documents, Contact History)
acceptance: The Servicing View of a client with a CBG and a non-CBG account shows both with their details.
Each tab loads within 3 seconds.
A contact change made in BIBS shows at once in the Servicing View.

requirements.title: Show the status of each account
acceptance: An account awaiting payment shows the CSF status Awaiting and the BIBS stage AWAITING_PAYMENT.
A booked account in force shows Open; a cancelled account shows Closed.
Changing the mapping of a stage changes the displayed status without a change to the system.

requirements.title: View the payment history
acceptance: A payment applied to two invoices shows both invoices and the remaining balance of each.
Payments older than 12 months appear only after Show older.

requirements.title: Verify the caller before a change
acceptance: A verification with 2 of 4 matches passes; with 1 match it fails and the update is not offered.
A third failed verification of the same client on one day raises an alert.

requirements.title: View, add or update client contact details
requirements.screens: Update Contact dialog (step 2); Servicing View (Contact History tab)
acceptance: A verified agent changes the client's mobile number; the Contact History shows the old and new number.
A change without a passed verification is refused.
An attempt to change the civil status is refused and names the fulfilment unit.
The update is saved within 3 seconds (p.30).

requirements.title: Queue contact changes for QPS and EBIX while they coexist
requirements.screens: Servicing View (Contact History, sync status); CSF Contact Changes report
acceptance: With sync disabled, a contact change shows the sync status "Not configured".
The CSF Contact Changes report lists the sync status of each change.

requirements.title: View, download and resend the renewal advice
requirements.screens: Servicing View (Renewal Advice tab); Resend dialog
acceptance: An agent resends an EB renewal advice to the registered e-mail; the password arrives separately.
An agent cannot change the recipient; a supervisor can, with a reason.
The Renewal Advice tab lists RAs from both the Renewal and the EB modules.

requirements.title: Resend the e-policy
acceptance: An agent resends a confirmed e-policy; it appears in the e-policy dispatch report.
An account without a confirmed e-policy offers no resend.

requirements.title: Attach or upload documents
acceptance: A HEIF photo uploaded to an account is stored and listed on the Documents tab.
A renamed executable with a .pdf extension is refused.
A document upload completes within 5 seconds (p.30).

requirements.title: View, retrieve or download policy-related documents
acceptance: The Documents tab of a client with a claim lists its claims report.
A quotation PDF opens in preview.
The documents are retrieved within 5 seconds (p.30).

requirements.title: Record changes to client information as an audit trail
acceptance: A contact change shows in the audit trail with the old and new values and the agent.
No screen allows an audit row to be changed.

requirements.title: Print or save the audit trail and the CSF reports
requirements.screens: Administration, Audit Trail (CTL-AUDIT); Reports (category Customer Service)
acceptance: The Contact Changes report for a month exports to Excel and PDF with the same rows.
An agent cannot run the audit trail report.
The report is generated within 5 seconds (p.30).

requirements.title: Log agent activity for leads and heads
acceptance: An agent's search, view and resend appear in the Agent Activity report for that day.

requirements.title: Back up the data every 15 minutes
acceptance: A restore test recovers BIBS data to a point less than 15 minutes before the test.
Online response times during archiving stay within the targets of section 8.

requirements.title: Log a customer transaction as a case
requirements.screens: Servicing View (Log Case; Cases tab); Log Case dialog; Case record
acceptance: A case submitted with all mandatory fields gets a unique Case ID, is linked to the client and the account and shows in the queue of the fulfilment unit with the status Open - With Fulfillment Unit.
A case with a blank mandatory field is refused and the missing fields are named.
A second case for the same client, account and nature of transaction is refused while the first is open, and the open case is named.
The creation is recorded in the case history with the creator, date and time.
The members of the fulfilment unit receive the notification with the Case ID and the policy number.
A case resolved on the call is created with the status Closed by CSR and its resolution.

requirements.title: Categorise a case by case type and turnaround time
requirements.screens: Log Case dialog; Case record (Details tab, Change Category)
acceptance: An Inquiry logged on a Monday without holidays is due on the Thursday (3 working days).
An agent cannot change the category of a submitted case; a supervisor can, with a reason.
Changing an Inquiry to a Complaint moves the due date to 6 working days from the creation and records the old and new type.
The list of case types offers only the active values of the list, each with its turnaround time.

requirements.title: Manage the case lifecycle statuses
requirements.screens: Case record (header and History tab); Cases list
acceptance: A case returned by the fulfilment unit shows Open - Returned to Agent in its header and in the Returned to Me queue of the agent.
An attempt to return a case that is Closed by CSR is refused.
Every status change is listed in the History tab with the time and the user.
The Cases list shows the current status and the status group of every case.

requirements.title: Add notes and updates to a case
acceptance: Two notes added by different users are listed in date order with their author, date and time.
A saved note offers no edit or delete action.
A user of another fulfilment unit cannot open the case or its notes.

requirements.title: Attach supporting documents to a case
acceptance: A PDF uploaded to a case is listed on the case and on the Documents tab of the client with the Case ID.
A file type that is not allowed is refused with its message.
The upload and a later download of the document appear in the case history.

requirements.title: Keep a complete audit trail of case actions
requirements.screens: Case record (History tab); Administration, Audit Trail
acceptance: A reassignment shows in the History tab with the from and to owner, the user and the time.
A priority change shows the old and new priority.
No screen allows an audit record of a case to be changed or deleted.
The Audit Trail report filtered on a Case ID lists every action of the case.

requirements.title: Reassign or escalate a case
requirements.screens: Cases (Team Queue); Case record (Reassign, Escalate, Close)
acceptance: A case reassigned from one agent to another shows in the new agent's My Cases at once and leaves the old agent's queue.
An escalation without a reason is refused.
An escalated case shows the Escalated indicator with the reason in its header, its queue row and the dashboard.
An agent does not see Reassign or Escalate.

requirements.title: Track case ageing and SLA thresholds
requirements.screens: Case record (header SLA indicator); Cases lists; Case Dashboard
acceptance: A case one working day before its due date shows Approaching breach and the four recipients are notified once.
A case past its due date shows Breached on the case, the queue and the dashboard.
A breached Complaint is escalated automatically with the reason Past TAT.
The age of a case is counted from its creation time.

requirements.title: Close a case and create a linked follow-up case
requirements.screens: Case record (Close; Create Follow-up Case; Linked Cases tab)
acceptance: A closed case offers no edit, note, upload or status action.
A follow-up case created from a closed case has a new Case ID and shows the link to the original case, and the original case shows the link to the new case with the reason.
A case cannot be closed without the resolution and the closure reason.

requirements.title: Produce case management reports and dashboards
acceptance: The dashboard and the Case Summary report for the same month and filters show the same case volume and SLA compliance rate.
The Case Register exports to Excel, CSV and PDF with the same rows.
An agent has no Case Dashboard and cannot run the case reports.
The dashboard filters by date, case type, priority and status.

requirements.title: Route, resolve and return a case by the Fulfilment Unit
requirements.screens: Cases (Fulfilment Unit Queue); Case record (Resolve and Close, Return to Agent, Request CSR Action)
acceptance: A Request case for a Consumer 1 Motor account is proposed to the fulfilment unit of the routing table and shows in that unit's queue.
A member of the fulfilment unit resolves and closes the case; the agent is notified and the case shows Closed by Fulfillment Unit.
A returned case shows Open - Returned to Agent in the agent's Returned to Me queue with the reason.
A member of another fulfilment unit cannot see the case.

requirements.title: Maintain the case lists of values and the routing table
requirements.screens: Broking Setup > Lists of Values; Customer Service Facility > Case Routing
acceptance: The Log Case dialog offers the 3 channels, 7 case types, 125 natures of transaction, 51 product types, 33 market segments and 53 fulfilment units of the addendum.
A deactivated nature of transaction is no longer offered and still shows on the cases that used it.
A routing row added for a case type and market segment proposes its fulfilment unit on the next case logged.

requirements.title: Restrict screening functions to authorised roles
requirements.screens: All Sanction Screening and Compliance Setup screens; User Access Matrix
acceptance: An Investigator sees Screening Home, Cases and Matches, and does not see Compliance Setup.
A Compliance Checker can approve a configuration version and cannot edit it.
A direct call to the committee decision by a user without SCR_COMMITTEE is refused and logged.

requirements.title: Maintain versioned screening configuration
requirements.screens: Compliance Setup > Configuration Versions (one tab per type)
acceptance: A submitted matching-criteria draft shows the changed threshold with its before and after values.
An active version cannot be edited; a change needs a new draft.
A case opened before a new assignment matrix keeps its assignee when the new matrix becomes active.

requirements.title: Configure name-matching criteria
acceptance: After the checker approves a fuzzy threshold of 0.92 effective today, the next screening run uses 0.92 and records the version on the run.
A threshold of 1.5 cannot be saved.

requirements.title: Define risk-profile categories and tagging rules
acceptance: With an active rule "match list type = SANCTION and status = TRUE_MATCH gives High-risk", a confirmed sanction match sets the client rating to the category's rating and writes an audit record.
A category with a rating that is not in KYC_RISK_RATING cannot be submitted.

requirements.title: Maintain the approval and escalation matrix
acceptance: With a published matrix, a submitted HIGH_RISK case of the Corbank unit goes to the approver the route names, and the timeline shows the route.
A COMPLIANCE_REVIEW outcome "Escalate to Committee" routes the case to AML_COMMITTEE.

requirements.title: Configure the case assignment matrix
acceptance: A new PEP case of the Retail unit is assigned by the matching scenario when it is created.
After a new matrix becomes active, existing cases keep their assignees and new cases follow the new rules.

requirements.title: Configure the SLA matrix per case stage
acceptance: A case entering INVESTIGATION after a 48-hour SLA becomes active is due 48 hours later (calendar) and is flagged when the time passes.
The SLA change shows its before and after values in the version history.

requirements.title: Maintain review templates
acceptance: A new KYC review template version, once approved, is used by reviews started after its effective date.
A review started on version 1 still shows version 1 after version 2 becomes active.

requirements.title: Maintain STR templates and the extraction layout
requirements.screens: Compliance Setup > Templates (STR); Configuration Versions (tab STR Layout)
acceptance: An STR created after a new STR template version uses the new fields; an STR already submitted keeps its fields.
The extraction file follows the column order of the active layout.

requirements.title: Configure dispositions per case stage
acceptance: In UNIT_HEAD_APPROVAL the disposition list shows only CONCUR and NOT_CONCUR (values provided).
An end-dated disposition is no longer offered and stays on the cases that used it.

requirements.title: Approve or reject a configuration version
acceptance: A draft approved by the checker is ACTIVE from its effective date.
A rejected draft keeps its reason and the active version is unchanged.
The maker of a version cannot approve it, even with SCR_CONFIG_APPROVE.

requirements.title: Receive the sanctions and PEP lists on schedule
requirements.screens: Compliance Setup > List Sources and Runs
acceptance: A scheduled run of a file with 3 new and 1 changed entry logs received 4, added 3, updated 1 and status SUCCESS.
A run that cannot read its file is logged FAILED with the reason and raises SCR_INGEST_FAILED.
Uploading the same file twice adds no duplicate entries.

requirements.title: Report records that failed ingestion
requirements.screens: List Sources and Runs (run detail); Reports (SCR-INGEST-ERRORS)
acceptance: A run with 2 failed lines produces a digest listing both lines with source, run and reason.
The report SCR-INGEST-ERRORS shows the same records for the run date.

requirements.title: Add or change sanctioned-name and PEP records manually
acceptance: A new manual entry is PENDING and is not used by screening until approved.
Saving without a name or remarks is refused and names the missing field.

requirements.title: Approve or reject list changes
acceptance: An approved new entry is ACTIVE and the next delta screening matches clients against it.
A rejected change leaves the entry as it was and shows the checker's remarks.

requirements.title: Trigger client matching
requirements.screens: Screening Home (last runs); client page (Screening tab)
acceptance: Creating a new client starts a run for that client only, with no user action.
The batch run processes all prospects and confirmed clients and no inactive client.
The run log shows trigger, configuration version and counts.

requirements.title: Match client names against the list
requirements.screens: Matches; Case (Matches tab); client page (Screening tab)
acceptance: A client named "Juan Dela Cruz" matches a list entry "Juan de la Cruz" by the phonetic rule and a match is recorded with its score.
A pair below the threshold records no match.
A second run with the same versions records no duplicate match.

requirements.title: Review potential matches
acceptance: A potential match marked as false positive leaves the list and is not raised again for the same entry version.
Opening a case from a match for a client with an open case adds the match to that case.

requirements.title: Tag the client risk profile automatically
requirements.screens: Client page (Screening tab, risk-profile history); client banner
acceptance: A confirmed sanction match under an active High-risk rule sets the client rating and the WATCHLIST_REVIEW tag automatically.
The client's Screening tab shows the rule and match that caused the change.
The KYC review date of the client moves to the date of the higher rating.

requirements.title: Create cases automatically
acceptance: A High-risk tag on a client with a booked account opens a case assigned by the routing rules.
For a client without an active policy, a MONITOR case opens and the UCC and the Investigator are notified.
Submitting an account of a listed client opens an ACCOUNT_APPLICATION case automatically.

requirements.title: Update the risk-profile tag manually with justification
requirements.screens: Case (action Update Risk Tag); Matches (Mark False Positive)
acceptance: The updated tag shows on the client immediately after saving.
The change cannot be saved without evidence.
The same entry version does not raise the client again in the next run.

requirements.title: Control the case lifecycle
acceptance: After the Investigator submits, the case is read-only to the Investigator.
The Timeline tab lists every transition with user and time.

requirements.title: View the list of cases and open a case
acceptance: Filtering by marketing unit and date created shows only the cases of that unit created in the period.
An Investigator does not see cases of another team.

requirements.title: Search cases
acceptance: Searching a case number returns that case only.
Searching a client name fragment with a date range returns the matching cases created in the range.

requirements.title: Re-assign a case or approval
acceptance: The client's own account officer is not offered as the new assignee.
After re-assignment, the previous assignee cannot act on the case.
The timeline shows the reason and both users.

requirements.title: Monitor SLA per stage, remind and escalate
acceptance: A case 2 hours before its due time with a 4-hour lead receives one reminder.
A breached case is flagged, escalated and counted in the breached tile.

requirements.title: Screening home and high-risk client list
acceptance: The breached tile opens the case list filtered to breached cases.
The high-risk list exports to Excel with the same rows as on screen.

requirements.title: Complete the guided review template
acceptance: When the review opens, mandatory fields are marked.
Submission with a blank mandatory field is refused and the field is flagged.

requirements.title: Select a disposition and submit the case
acceptance: A submitted case goes to the approver of the matching route and is read-only to the Investigator.
Only INVESTIGATION dispositions are offered.

requirements.title: Upload KYC and supporting documents
acceptance: An uploaded KYC form received 12-May-2026 for client "ABC Trading" is named KYC_REVIEW_ABC Trading_20260512_<type>_1 and shows on the timeline.
A document without date received cannot be uploaded.

requirements.title: Validate dispositioned cases before approval
acceptance: A case without the required KYC document cannot be submitted and the timeline records VALIDATION_FAILED.
A valid case is logged VALIDATED and routed to the approver.

requirements.title: Approve or disapprove the recommendation (Unit Head)
acceptance: An approved case moves to the next workflow step.
A disapproved case is RETURNED with the rationale visible to the Investigator.

requirements.title: Correct and resubmit a returned case
acceptance: A case returned by Compliance goes back to COMPLIANCE_REVIEW on resubmission.

requirements.title: Review BU escalations (Compliance)
acceptance: An outcome "Escalate to Committee" routes the case to AML_COMMITTEE.
A return sets the case to RETURNED with the remarks and logs the action.

requirements.title: Record the AML Committee decision
acceptance: A member sees the case details, findings, documents and prior comments before deciding.
With rule MAJORITY of 5, the third APPROVE_STR vote moves the case to STR_PREPARATION.
Each vote is recorded with user, date and time.

requirements.title: Prepare the STR from case data
acceptance: Opening the STR of a case prefills the client's details, the narrative and the case documents.
The completeness check highlights each missing mandatory field.

requirements.title: Extract committee-approved STRs in the AMLC format
acceptance: An extraction for a month includes only the committee-approved STRs of that month.
The file is saved and downloadable, and the extraction appears in the audit trail.
An STR not approved by the committee is never in the file.

requirements.title: Record the AMLC filing reference
acceptance: Recording the reference closes the case and shows FILED in the STR register.

requirements.title: Notify users of new and assigned cases
acceptance: The assignee of a new case receives a notification and opens the case from it.
The notification log shows recipient, type and time.

requirements.title: Send SLA and missing-document reminders
acceptance: A case missing its KYC form one day before the SLA ends sends a reminder that names the KYC form.

requirements.title: Notify Compliance of newly added sanctioned names
acceptance: A run that adds 5 entries notifies the Compliance Officers with the count and the link to the run.

requirements.title: Operational and compliance reports
acceptance: The case status report filtered by marketing unit and case status lists only those cases.
Each report exports to CSV, XLSX and PDF with the same rows.
A user without SCR_REPORT_VIEW cannot run the reports.
The Name Matching Fall-out report lists the potential matches below the case threshold with the client, the Account Officer in charge and the Marketing Business Unit.

requirements.title: Keep an immutable audit log
acceptance: No screen or service allows an audit row or timeline event to be edited or deleted.
An attempt to change a timeline entry outside the screens is refused.

requirements.title: Audit log report
acceptance: Filtering by a disposition lists only the events of cases with that disposition.
The report exports to PDF and XLSX with the same rows.

requirements.title: Log in with a persona profile from a BDO-issued device
requirements.screens: Login; home page with the menu of the user's roles
requirements.priority: Must have (4.001.x has no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A user with the Requestor profile logs in and sees the User Access screens of the Requestor only.

The third wrong password locks the account; the fourth attempt, with the correct password, is refused with the same message as a wrong password ("Invalid user name or password"), and Users shows the account as locked to the System Administrator.
A deactivated user is refused with the same message as a wrong password ("Invalid user name or password") and the count of failed attempts does not change.
The audit trail lists the failed and successful attempts.

requirements.title: Warn before the inactivity and system log-out
requirements.priority: Must have (4.001.x has no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: After 15 minutes without activity the warning appears.
After 30 minutes without activity the user is signed out.

requirements.title: Sign in with the BDO account (single sign-on through EIAM)
acceptance: In OIDC mode a user signs in with the BDO account at EIAM and BIBS opens the session with the user's BIBS roles; BIBS stores no password for the user.
An identity that is not linked to an active BIBS user is refused with the message SSO_NOT_LINKED and the attempt is audited.
In OIDC mode a break-glass System Administrator signs in with the local password and the second factor; another user cannot sign in with a local password.
The menu after a single sign-on is that of the user's BIBS roles, whatever groups the identity provider holds.

requirements.title: Log out and keep a session log
requirements.screens: User menu (Log Out); Administration > Users (status Online)
acceptance: After Log Out, the audit log report shows the log-out with user and time.
The Users screen shows a signed-in user as Online.
In single sign-on, after Log Out the user is at the EIAM sign-out page, and opening BIBS again asks for the BDO sign-in.

requirements.title: Enforce the password policy and self-service reset
requirements.screens: My Profile (Change password, Details); Login (Forgot password?); Administration > Users (Reset password)
acceptance: A new password equal to one of the last 8 is refused.
After an administrator reset, the user must change the password at the next log-in.
The reset link works once and not after 30 minutes.

requirements.title: Deactivate dormant users
requirements.screens: Access Requests (the requests of the job); Notifications
acceptance: A user without a sign-in for 91 days is deactivated by the job with a request whose reason is "No sign-in for the dormancy period".
A user whose deactivation date is 7 days away receives the notice and stays active.

requirements.title: Draft, edit, cancel and submit an access request
requirements.screens: User Access > Access Requests; New Request; Edit Request
requirements.priority: Must have (the 'add / save remarks' lines have no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A Requestor saves an enrolment request as a draft, edits it the next day and submits it; it becomes PENDING with the same number.
A cancelled draft stays in My Requests with status CANCELLED and its reason.
Another Requestor cannot open the draft.

requirements.title: Enrol a new user
acceptance: An enrolment for user ID a013000196 with the Marketing Account Officer profile is applied after approval and the user can sign in.
An enrolment for an existing user ID is refused with ACCESS_USER_EXISTS.
An inactive group profile is not offered.

requirements.title: Modify an existing user
requirements.priority: Must have (1.003.1.1.2 has no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A request that moves a user from Marketing Team Lead to Processing Team Lead is applied after approval, and the audit log report shows "Marketing Team Lead" to "Processing Team Lead".
A request that changes the e-mail only leaves the group profiles unchanged.

requirements.title: Deactivate a user
acceptance: After approval the user cannot sign in, and the User Access Report shows the deactivation with the approver.
A deactivation dated the 30th is applied on the 30th (FR-UA-020).

requirements.title: Reactivate a user
acceptance: After approval the reactivated user signs in with the group profiles held before deactivation.

requirements.title: Choose the approver
acceptance: The drop-down does not list the requester or the user the request is about.
Only the chosen approver receives the notification and sees the request under "Assigned to me".

requirements.title: Apply correction on a returned request
acceptance: A returned request shows the approver's remarks; after correction and re-submission it is PENDING again.
The history shows both rounds with their remarks.

requirements.title: Cancel a submitted request
acceptance: A pending request cancelled by its creator disappears from the approver's My Approvals and shows CANCELLED with the reason.
An approved and applied request cannot be cancelled.

requirements.title: View submitted requests and their status
requirements.priority: Must have (1.008.1 has no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A Requestor sees only his or her requests, with the current status.
The History tab lists submission, return, re-submission and approval with remarks.

requirements.title: Submit a bulk request
requirements.priority: Must have (1.009.1 has no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A file of three enrolments creates a draft batch of three lines; after approval the three users exist.
A row with an existing user ID is reported before the batch is created.

requirements.title: Apply changes on an effective date
requirements.screens: New Request (Effective date); Access Requests (status SCHEDULED)
acceptance: A deactivation approved on the 10th with effective date the 15th is applied on the 15th.
A failed scheduled application raises UAM_SCHEDULED_APPLY_FAILED.

requirements.title: Receive, list and open requests for approval
requirements.screens: My Approvals; Access Requests (tab Assigned to Me); request detail
acceptance: The chosen approver receives a notification and finds the request under Assigned to Me.
The detail shows "Marketing Team Lead" as current and "Processing Team Lead" as requested for a role change.

requirements.title: Approve a request and grant the access
acceptance: An approved enrolment creates the user and shows the temporary password once.
The requester cannot approve his or her own request (ACCESS_FOUR_EYES).

requirements.title: Reject a request
requirements.priority: Must have (2.002.6.1-6.2 have no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A rejection without a reason is refused with ACCESS_REJECT_REASON.
The requester sees the reason on the rejected request.

requirements.title: Return a request to the Requestor
acceptance: A returned request is RETURNED with the approver's remarks and appears in the requester's list for correction.

requirements.title: Escalate privileged and out-of-hours changes for a second approval
requirements.screens: My Approvals; Access Requests (tab Second Approval)
acceptance: A request that adds the System Administrator profile to a user needs a second approval.
A request submitted at 21:00 on a weekday is flagged OUTSIDE_HOURS.

requirements.title: Request a new group profile
requirements.screens: User Access > Group Profile Requests (New); permission picker by area and action
requirements.priority: Must have (3.002.1.6-1.7 have no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A request for a new profile "Processing Team Lead" with its permissions reaches FOR_IMPLEMENTATION after its approvers approve.
A code that already exists is refused.

requirements.title: Request a change to a group profile
requirements.screens: Group Profile Requests (Modify); Change role permissions fields
requirements.priority: Must have (3.002.2.2, 2.7, 2.8 have no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A request that adds one permission and removes another is implemented with exactly that difference.
A request that adds and removes the same permission is refused with ACCESS_PERMISSION_CONFLICT.

requirements.title: Request the deactivation of a group profile
requirements.priority: Must have (3.002.3.2, 3.7, 3.8 have no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: After implementation, the members of the deactivated profile lose its screens at their next action.
The deactivated profile is not offered on new requests.

requirements.title: Request the reactivation of a group profile
requirements.priority: Must have (3.002.4.2, 4.7, 4.8 have no flag in the BRD)
acceptance: A reactivated profile grants its permissions again to its members.

requirements.title: Route group-profile requests to approvers in order
acceptance: With two approvers, the second is notified only after the first approves.
A rejection by the first approver ends the request.

requirements.title: Implement an approved group-profile request
requirements.screens: Access Requests (tab For Implementation); Administration > Roles & Permissions (Implement Request)
acceptance: An approved new profile is created only when the System Administrator implements it.
A direct role edit is refused while UAM_DIRECT_ROLE_EDIT is false.

requirements.title: Define the group profiles of the access personas
acceptance: The Requestor, Approver and Business Administrator profiles exist with the permissions of section 3.3.

requirements.title: Assign functions to a group profile
acceptance: A profile without UAM_CANCEL does not show **Cancel Request**, and a direct call is refused with ACCESS_DENIED.
The User Access Matrix shows UAM_ENROLL under area USER_ACCESS, action CREATE.

requirements.title: Maintain user data and the user ID format
requirements.screens: Administration > Users; Lists of Values (UAM_BUSINESS_UNIT, UAM_USER_LEVEL)
acceptance: The Users screen shows the Windows ID, business unit, user level and status of each user.
An unlock is listed in the audit log report with the administrator.

requirements.title: Keep profiles that one user may not hold apart (separation of duties)
requirements.screens: User Access > Separation of Duties; My Approvals
acceptance: A rule on the Requestor and Approver profiles, once authorised, refuses a request that gives one user both, with the names of the two profiles.
The Business Administrator who created the rule cannot authorise it.

requirements.title: Second approval of the security settings
acceptance: A change of LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS by the System Administrator applies only after the Information Security Officer approves it.
Opening the emergency direct edit (UAM_DIRECT_ROLE_EDIT = true) needs the same approval.

requirements.title: User Access Report
requirements.screens: User Access > User Access Reports; Reports (category Control & Audit)
acceptance: The report shows user a024000000 with profile Processing Officer, created by the approver of its request and modified by the approver of the later change.
The report exports to PDF, XLSX and CSV.

requirements.title: User Group Profile Report
acceptance: For the Marketing Account Officer profile, the report lists Client Management tasks with "With Access" or "No Access".

requirements.title: Group Profile Membership list
acceptance: The list shows every member of Marketing Team Lead with the user who added each member and the date.

requirements.title: User Access Audit Log
requirements.screens: User Access Reports; Administration > Audit Trail (CTL-AUDIT, exists)
acceptance: A profile change of User 123 appears as "Modify User Group Profile" from "Marketing Team Lead" to "Processing Team Lead" with the user who did it.
Log-outs appear when the option is selected.

requirements.title: Keep an access-change log that no user can change
requirements.screens: Reports of section 6; request History tab
acceptance: An attempt to change or delete a log entry outside the screens is refused.
Each attribute of a modified user has one row with from and to values and the request number.

requirements.title: Notify requesters, approvers and affected users
acceptance: A returned request notifies the requester with the remarks.
An applied deactivation notifies the affected user by e-mail.

requirements.title: E-mail designated users on failed batch runs
acceptance: A failed UAM_EFFECTIVE_CHANGES run sends an e-mail to the recipients with the error.

requirements.title: Upload submitted policies
acceptance: An LFS insurance report of 300 rows creates 300 CBG Motor records with status RECEIVED.
The same report saved as ODS is accepted; a PDF policy document is attached to its record for manual entry.
Loading the same file a second time is refused.
A row updating an existing policy changes the record and writes the history.

requirements.title: Extract policy details from documents and save them after confirmation (Release 2)
requirements.screens: Extraction Review (proposal side by side with the record)
acceptance: A text PDF of a motor policy produces a proposal; after confirmation the record shows the confirmed values and status VALIDATED.
Before confirmation the masterlist is unchanged.
A scanned document without text leads to manual entry.

requirements.title: Create or update a policy manually and tag its renewal opportunity
requirements.screens: Masterlist (New Policy); Policy record (Edit, Tag Renewable / Non-Renewable)
acceptance: A manually created Non-CBG Corporate policy is saved and appears in the masterlist.
A record tagged Non-Renewable shows the chip and appears in the Non-Renewal filter and report.
A later processing run does not change a manual tag.
A CBG Motor record does not offer the manual renewal tag while only Non-CBG Corporate is defined.

requirements.title: Migrate the existing Excel masterlists
acceptance: A legacy file with 1,000 rows and 12 invalid rows migrates 988 records flagged Migrated and logs 12 errors with reason codes.
A migrated record shows its original date received and legacy reference.
Running the same file again creates no duplicates.

requirements.title: Keep one Submitted Masterlist
requirements.screens: Masterlist (tabs All, For Validation, Classified, For Renewal, Manual Disposition, Non-Renewal, Fallout, Unmatched); Policy record
acceptance: After a record is updated by an upload, the masterlist shows the new values at once.
Filters by segment and expiry month return only the matching records.
Each market segment can be extracted on its own with only its records.

requirements.title: View and extract the masterlist by role
acceptance: A CBG Motor handler does not see CBG Fire records.
An AO sees only his records.
A user without SBM_EXPORT cannot extract the masterlist.

requirements.title: Monitor handler, conversion status and remarks
requirements.screens: Masterlist (Assign Handler; quick filter Changed since); Policy record (History)
acceptance: A handler change shows at once in the masterlist and in the record history.
The quick filter Changed since yesterday lists the records updated today.

requirements.title: Define sanitation, matching, classification and disposition criteria
acceptance: A new exclusion rule for SM Group employee accounts applies to the next run only after the approver approves it.
Each run result shows the rule and version that produced it.

requirements.title: Run processing automatically after intake
requirements.screens: Processing Runs (list, run detail); Masterlist (Run Processing)
acceptance: Uploading an LFS file starts a run; each new record ends with a classification and a bucket or fallout.
A record matched to an active loan of the loan files is moved to the right bucket and the handlers are notified.

requirements.title: Report fallout after processing
requirements.screens: Processing Runs (Fallout tab); Masterlist (Fallout tab); Reports (SBM-PROCESS-FALLOUT)
acceptance: A run with five records without PN produces a fallout report listing the five with their reason code.
A corrected record leaves the fallout after the next run.

requirements.title: Classify policies as Inforced or Submitted
requirements.screens: Policy record (Loan & Matching, Rule Results); Reports (SBM-CLASSIFICATION)
acceptance: A record whose PN matches an active LAMD or LMS loan is Submitted; a record whose PN is in none of the loan reports is Inforced.

requirements.title: Group Submitted policies into qualification buckets
requirements.screens: Masterlist (bucket tabs and filter); Policy record
acceptance: A Submitted CBG Motor policy of an active loan with no exclusion goes to For Renewal.
A policy on the employee list goes to BDO / SM Group Employee Accounts and is not handed to renewal.

requirements.title: Choose the RA template from the active loan of the loan reports
requirements.screens: Upload & Intake (Loan Files); Policy record (Loan & Matching)
acceptance: An FFY account with an active non-amortised loan gets the FFY RA template.

requirements.title: Assign policies to non-renewal buckets
acceptance: A No Touch account is tagged Non-Renewal and listed in the non-renewal report with reason No Touch.
An excluded record is never handed to renewal.

requirements.title: Group Inforced policies and create RAs and proposals
acceptance: An inforced Fully Paid Loan policy marked eligible reaches For Renewal and, after hand-off, has an RA and a proposal.

requirements.title: Receive loan files and match them to the submitted policies automatically
requirements.screens: Upload & Intake (Loan Files); Processing Runs (Loan File Results); Masterlist (Unmatched tab)
acceptance: An LMS file whose rows carry only the loan application number is matched to the submitted policies with that number and the matched accounts are categorised.
A loan record without a matching policy is flagged Unmatched with its reason and listed on the Unmatched tab.
The processing log of a record shows the file source, time stamp, key used, matching outcome and category.
A loan file is processed to the end without any user action after the upload.

requirements.title: Record policy reviews and generate one IAAF per policy
requirements.screens: Policy Reviews / IAAF (review queue, IAAF page); Policy record (Review & IAAF tab)
acceptance: A policy reviewed twice shows two reviews and a review count of 2 on its IAAF.
A second IAAF for the same policy is refused.
An IAAF linked to the previous term's record shows the link.
The IAAF of a record referred by a branch of region NCR is numbered NCR-<year>-<counter>.

requirements.title: Route the IAAF for approval and signature
requirements.screens: My Approvals; IAAF page (approvals); Submitted Policies Setup (Approval Matrix)
acceptance: An IAAF of a Non-CBG Corporate policy goes to level 1 and, after approval, to level 2.
The preparer cannot approve it.
The issued IAAF PDF shows the stamped name, position and time of every approver.

requirements.title: Detect accounts exceeding acceptance or coverage limits
requirements.screens: Policy record (Rule Results, flag Insurer approval); Submitted Policies Setup (Limit Rules)
acceptance: A motor policy whose vehicle is older than the insurer's maximum age is flagged Insurer approval required with the limit and value.

requirements.title: Generate the Terms of Reference
requirements.screens: TOR (list, TOR page); Policy record (TOR tab)
acceptance: A TOR generated for a flagged record lists its breached limits.

requirements.title: Route the TOR for approval per the TSU Approval Matrix
requirements.screens: My Approvals; TOR page; Submitted Policies Setup (Approval Matrix)
acceptance: A TOR reaches the TSU approver of its level and, after the last approval, carries the signed PDF.

requirements.title: Hand the approved TOR over to the Account Officer
acceptance: The assigned AO is notified of the approved TOR and can download it; the TOR then shows Released.

requirements.title: Detect expiring policies and hand them to Renewal
requirements.screens: Renewal Work List (For Renewal, Hand-off Pending); Masterlist (Renew with BDOI)
acceptance: A For Renewal CBG Fire record 150 days before expiry is handed over with an insurer different from the expiring one.
A second scan does not hand the same record over again.
While Renewal is not in use, the hand-off shows as pending and no letter is sent.

requirements.title: List the policies subject for renewal
requirements.screens: Renewal Work List (tabs For Renewal, Hand-off Pending, Hold Cover Pending, Insurer Not Accepted, Converted, Not Renewed); Reports (SBM-CONVERSION, Renewal Status Report)
acceptance: The For Renewal tab for March lists every renewable record expiring in March in the user's scope.
The export has the same rows as the screen.

requirements.title: Send letters and proposals when the criteria are met
requirements.screens: Letters & Print Batches; Policy record (Letters tab)
acceptance: A reviewed policy with a renewal opportunity gets the reminder letter by the rule's channel and date.
A print batch contains one PDF with all letters of the day and a control list.
No RA is produced by this module; the RA of a handed-over policy appears on its Renewal record.

requirements.title: Re-assign the insurer while a hold cover request is open
requirements.screens: Renewal Work List (Insurer Not Accepted; Re-assign Insurer)
acceptance: After re-assignment the old request shows Reassigned and a new request is sent to the new insurer.
The renewal account shows the new insurer.

requirements.title: Process placement of the renewal account
requirements.screens: BRD-1 Placement screens; Renewal Work List (Converted)
acceptance: After the client confirms and pays, the slip is sent to the insurer and the masterlist record shows Placed.

requirements.title: Show the booked status in the masterlist
requirements.screens: BRD-1 Booking; Masterlist; Policy record (Renewal tab)
acceptance: A booked renewal shows BOOKED, the invoice number and the booking date in the masterlist.
The booked invoice has business type RENEWAL.

requirements.title: Create individual or batch proposals with nominated package rates
requirements.screens: Renewal Work List (Create Proposals); Proposal Batch page; Submitted Policies Setup (Nominated Rates)
acceptance: A batch of 20 CBG Motor records creates 20 proposals with the nominated rate of each record's vehicle classification and insurer.
A rate edited for the vehicle classification Private Car of insurer A changes only the proposals of the Private Car records of insurer A.
A record without a nominated rate is listed with its reason and is not generated until a rate is entered.
Generated proposals are For Review and become available to the hand-off after the Team Lead releases them.

requirements.title: Assign proposals to a preferred accredited insurer
requirements.screens: Create Proposals; Proposal Batch page (Assign Insurer)
acceptance: Assigning insurer B to 15 selected proposals of a batch sets insurer B on all 15 and recomputes their nominated rates.
A single proposal can be assigned to an insurer different from the batch.
An insurer that is not accredited for the line is not offered.

requirements.title: Tag handling-fee payments in the Unapplied Payment List
requirements.screens: Handling Fees (records, tagger results, unmatched items); Collections unapplied view
acceptance: A CLPC payment carrying the PN of a billed record is tagged Handling Fee and applied with an OR.
An OTC payment with an unknown location reference stays in the unapplied list for the UPP handler.

requirements.title: Generate Submitted Policies reports
requirements.screens: Reports (category Submitted Policies); Submitted Policies home
acceptance: The Sanitation Report of a month lists one row per invoice with the columns of RL p.25 (EBIX invoice number to expiry date).
The process fallout report of a run lists every fallout record with its reason code and the masterlist columns of RL p.24.
The Conversion report offers its four parts - Renewal Status, Monthly Status, Account Classification, Persistency and Conversion - for a covered period and as of a date.

requirements.title: View, download and print reports in several formats
acceptance: SBM-MASTERLIST exported as Excel and as PDF has the same rows.

requirements.title: Send notifications and alerts for key events
requirements.screens: Notifications (bell); notification preferences; alerts; Submitted Policies Setup (Notification Recipients)
acceptance: The approvers of level 1 are notified when an IAAF is submitted.
A confirmed hold cover whose account is not booked 5 days before it ends raises SBM_HOLD_COVER_UNBOOKED.
A named user added as recipient of SBM_TOR_RELEASED for CBG Fire receives the next TOR hand-over notice of a CBG Fire record.

requirements.title: Report the expiring accounts of a month and the active loans without an active policy
acceptance: The report for March lists every account in scope whose policy expires in March.
An active LMS loan without any policy in force at the end of March appears in Part 2 with its PN number and loan application number.
A loan whose policy runs beyond March does not appear in Part 2.

requirements.title: Maintain the data object register
acceptance: A new object is saved as Proposed with its four criteria and shown in the register.
An object cannot be given a load order before an object it depends on.
An Excluded object stays in the register and cannot be loaded.

requirements.title: Decide the migration class of a data object
acceptance: A decision approved by the business owner sets the object to Decided with the approved class.
The submitter cannot approve their own decision.
An object classed Excluded cannot be selected for a batch.
The report Migration Decisions lists every decision with its approver.

requirements.title: Sign off each object through gates
acceptance: An object reaches G6 only after G1-G5 are signed in order.
The operator of a batch cannot sign its reconciliation.
The Sign-off screen shows, per object and environment, which gates are signed, by whom and when.

requirements.title: Receive a source extract with control totals
acceptance: A file whose rows, amounts and hash total agree with its control file is staged and numbered.
A file with one row fewer than the control count is rejected and nothing is staged.
In a non-production environment the staged client names and TINs are masked; in production they are not.

requirements.title: Maintain and approve versioned code maps
acceptance: An approved version supersedes the previous one and is used by the next validated batch.
A version mapping to a BIBS code that does not exist cannot be approved.
Each batch shows the map versions it used.

requirements.title: Report unmapped and invalid codes before load
acceptance: A staged row whose insurer code is not mapped appears on the Unmapped tab and in the report Unmapped Legacy Codes with its legacy key.
The load of that batch cannot be approved until the code is mapped and the batch validated again.
The report exports to Excel and PDF.

requirements.title: Validate staged data against data-quality rules
acceptance: A legacy invoice whose components do not add up to its gross premium is Invalid with that message.
A waived row shows the waiver reason and the data owner who approved it.
A batch of open invoices with one Invalid row cannot be approved for load unless the row is excluded by the data owner; once it is excluded, the error rate shown is 0.00%.

requirements.title: Load a batch through the BIBS services
acceptance: Loading the same batch twice creates no duplicate; the second run marks the rows Skipped.
A client created by a load is found in client search and has a cross-reference to its legacy key.
The batch page shows staged, loaded, skipped, rejected and excluded counts that add up.
Every record created by a load carries the origin Migrated with its source system, legacy reference and batch, shown by the LEGACY badge and its tooltip (BRID_MIG 1.3).

requirements.title: Rerun and roll back a batch
acceptance: A rerun batch loads only the previously rejected rows and its counts are added to the parent batch reconciliation.

A rerun of rows selected among the rejected rows reprocesses only those rows; each shows whether it was migrated or failed again, a row that fails again keeps its error details, and the run log gives the counts reprocessed, migrated and failed with the times (BRID_MIG 1.4).
A rollback of a client batch without later activity leaves no active migrated client of that batch.
A rollback is refused when a payment was applied to a legacy invoice of the batch.

requirements.title: Reconcile each data object from source to target
acceptance: For a batch of 1,000 open invoices loaded without rejects, L1 shows 1,000 at every stage and L2 shows 0.00 difference per currency.
A field changed in BIBS after the load appears as an L4 break on the next reconciliation.
The reconciliation cannot be signed while a break has no approved explanation.
The reports Reconciliation Summary and Reconciliation Detail export to Excel and PDF.

requirements.title: Reconcile carried-forward balances to the GL
requirements.screens: Reconciliation (GL tab); ACSL GL to Sub-ledger Reconciliation
acceptance: After the loads of open invoices, UPP and the trial balance of a branch, Migration Clearing is 0.00 in PHP and USD.
The ACSL reconciliation of the legacy Premium Receivable account against the legacy invoices shows no difference.

The Premium Receivable, DTIP, Commission Receivable and unapplied-payment balances of the opening equal the legacy trial balance and the legacy sub-ledgers per branch and currency with a difference of 0.00 (BRID_MIG 13.1; tolerance CLR-DM-04).

An invoice paid in full and not remitted, with 5,000.00 open DTIP and 800.00 commission receivable, missing from the load leaves a credit of 4,200.00 on Migration Clearing; an unpaid invoice with 3,000.00 premium receivable and 3,000.00 DTIP missing from the load leaves Migration Clearing at 0.00 and shows a 3,000.00 difference on Premium Receivable - Legacy and on DTIP - Legacy.

requirements.title: Load the provisional GL opening at the year-end boundary
requirements.screens: Batches (object G01); Reconciliation (GL tab); Journal inquiry
acceptance: After the load of a branch, its balance-sheet accounts in BIBS equal the legacy preliminary trial balance and its P&L accounts are 0.00 at 1 January 2028.
A legacy trial balance with a FY2027 net income of 1,250,000.00 in a branch gives a credit of 1,250,000.00 to retained earnings in that branch.
The load cannot be approved while the preliminary trial balance is not signed.
The opening journals show the flag Provisional until the true-ups are closed.

requirements.title: Post the FY2027 true-ups as opening-balance adjustment journals
requirements.screens: True-ups; Extracts; Batches (object G03); Journal inquiry
acceptance: True-up 1 with a FY2027 accrual of 80,000.00 (Dr expense, Cr accrued expenses) posts, after approval, a journal MIG-TU-1 dated 1 January 2028 with Dr retained earnings 80,000.00 and Cr accrued expenses 80,000.00; the FY2028 P&L does not change.

An audit write-off of 3,000.00 of premium receivable on legacy invoice I00300002, sent with its detail line, reduces the open basic premium of the invoice and Premium Receivable - Legacy by 3,000.00 and leaves Migration Clearing at 0.00.
A journal dated 5 January 2028, or a journal not in the register, stops the validation with its message.
The GL lead who prepared a true-up cannot approve it.
With January 2028 closed, the final true-up posts after Comptrollership reopens the period, and the period is closed again the same day.

requirements.title: Reconcile each true-up to the legacy trial balance and close the FY2027 cut-off
acceptance: For true-up 1, the report Opening-Balance Adjustment Reconciliation shows each account's true-up equal to the change of the legacy trial balance, the BIBS opening equal to the legacy post-close trial balance, and Migration Clearing 0.00.
A legacy journal that is in the legacy journal listing but not in the register stops the sign-off with the message.
After the final true-up is signed and the closure recorded, a new true-up cannot be created and the opening journals are no longer marked Provisional.

requirements.title: Load reference data through the code maps
requirements.screens: Code Maps; Batches; the reference-data screens of each master
acceptance: A legacy LOV value marked Create becomes an authorised BIBS value after the master authorisation, and the batch reconciles.
A client batch using a segment that is not yet authorised cannot be approved for load.

requirements.title: Match and deduplicate legacy clients
acceptance: Two legacy clients with the same TIN from EBIX and QPS become one BIBS client with both legacy keys in the cross-reference.
Two legacy clients with similar names and the same birth date but different IDs go to the review queue.
The client batch cannot load while a pair is open in the review queue.

requirements.title: Create migrated clients in the Client Master
acceptance: A migrated client is Active and can be selected on a new quotation without re-encoding.
No screening case is created during the load; after the full run, hits appear in the screening queue.
A client changed in legacy the day before the freeze is updated in BIBS by the delta batch.

requirements.title: Find migrated clients and policies by legacy reference
requirements.screens: Client search; Account search; Customer Servicing search
acceptance: Searching an EBIX client number opens the BIBS client created from it.
The client page shows the source systems and legacy numbers of the cluster.

requirements.title: Load the package code map for the Renewal package remapping
requirements.screens: Code Maps (the package code map); Batches (object R06); Renewal candidates (Exception bucket)
acceptance: An approved package code map version with 120 entries loads into the Renewal package map and reconciles with 120 entries.

At renewal, a candidate on a legacy package with one entry for a sum insured up to 2,000,000.00 and one above gets the first BIBS package for a sum insured of 950,000.00 and the second for 2,500,000.00.
A candidate whose legacy package has a Reject entry is in the Exception bucket.
A version with two entries of the same legacy package whose sum-insured bands overlap cannot be submitted.
A header on a legacy package without an entry loads with no warning and keeps its legacy package.

requirements.title: Load in-force policy headers
requirements.screens: Batches; Account (existing screens, read only for header fields)
acceptance: A migrated in-force policy is found by its policy number and shows status, dates, insurer and line, linked to the correct client.
A migrated header has no quotation or placement and cannot be booked again.
A packaged header shows the legacy package and version as sent, with no warning.
The P01 reconciliation against the legacy in-force list shows every policy expiring from go-live to 31 May 2028.

requirements.title: Search migrated policies for servicing
acceptance: A migrated policy shows status, inception and expiry, insurer and line, and its client.
Its legacy invoices are listed with their open balances.

requirements.title: Carry forward legacy invoices with their open balances
acceptance: A legacy invoice with PR 10,000.00 of which 4,000.00 was paid shows booked 10,000.00, applied 4,000.00 and balance 6,000.00 in Invoice 360, with the LEGACY badge.
A legacy invoice paid in full before cutover and not remitted is offered for remittance (FR-DM-080) and not for collection.
Invoice 360 of a legacy invoice shows the source system, legacy number and original values.

requirements.title: Carry forward legacy UPP
acceptance: A migrated UPP shows amount, balance, legacy AR, reference and status in the workbench.
The UPP legacy control account equals the total of the migrated UPP balances.
With the setting Issue an AR for a migrated unapplied payment false, no AR is issued at load; with true, each migrated UPP gets a BIBS AR that refers to its legacy AR and posts no cash entry.

requirements.title: Automatch rerun of UPP across legacy and new invoices
acceptance: A migrated UPP of 5,000.00 referring to a legacy invoice with 3,000.00 open and a new invoice with 2,000.00 open is applied to both and closes; the legacy sub-ledger is credited 3,000.00 and the new PR 2,000.00.
The journal of each application shows the UPP legacy account on the debit side.
A migrated UPP without a matching invoice stays in the Unapplied tab.

requirements.title: Apply legacy UPP to another invoice
acceptance: A legacy UPP applied to another legacy invoice credits the PR legacy sub-ledger and debits the UPP legacy sub-ledger.
The disposition is refused when the amount is above the balance.

requirements.title: Refund legacy UPP
acceptance: An approved refund of 1,500.00 from a legacy UPP reduces the UPP legacy sub-ledger by 1,500.00 and appears in the Disbursement queue.

requirements.title: Reclassify UPP to other income with top-management approval
acceptance: A batch executes only after the Cashiering TL and top management approve it.
On execution, the UPP legacy sub-ledger decreases and other income increases by the batch total, and the items are closed.
A batch returned by top management does not post.

requirements.title: Apply an OTC payment to a legacy invoice
acceptance: An OTC payment of 6,000.00 on a legacy invoice with 6,000.00 open issues an AR, brings the balance to 0.00 and credits the PR legacy sub-ledger.
The receipt is listed in the Cash Receipts Book report for the day.
The AR shows the legacy invoice number the payment was applied to.

requirements.title: Match autopay payments to legacy invoices
acceptance: A Direct Credit row with an EBIX invoice reference is applied to the legacy invoice and credits the PR legacy sub-ledger.
The AR issued for that row shows the legacy invoice number, and Invoice 360 of the invoice lists the AR.
A file with rows for legacy and new invoices posts each application to the right sub-ledger.
Before the QPS pattern is configured, a row that quotes only a QPS invoice number stays unapplied, and a row that also quotes the ARN is applied to the QPS legacy invoice.

requirements.title: Reverse DP PR legacy invoices in batch
