requirements.screens: DP PR Legacy Reversal; My Approvals
acceptance: An approved batch of 20 DP PR legacy invoices reverses each open premium receivable and reduces the PR and DTIP legacy sub-ledgers by the same total.
A line whose balance changed after the upload fails alone and is reported.

requirements.title: Reverse PR2307 legacy invoices in batch
acceptance: An approved PR2307 batch brings the PR2307 legacy balance of each line to 0.00 and reduces DTIP legacy by the same amount.
The maker of a batch cannot approve it.

requirements.title: Include legacy invoices in remittance extracts
requirements.screens: Extraction workbench; Remittance batch; Remittance reports
acceptance: A legacy invoice fully paid before cutover and not remitted appears in the next extraction for its insurer with its full net due.
A legacy invoice remitted in legacy does not appear.
The approved batch reduces DTIP legacy for legacy lines and DTIP for new lines.

requirements.title: Process a positive endorsement on a legacy invoice
requirements.screens: New Endorsement Request; Request page; Posting batches
acceptance: An additional premium of 2,000.00 on a legacy invoice books an endorsement invoice with the legacy invoice as parent and increases the PR and DTIP legacy sub-ledgers.
The service invoice is issued for the commission increase.
The account shows the increased premium and sum insured.

requirements.title: Process a negative endorsement on a legacy invoice
requirements.screens: New Endorsement Request; Request page; Posting batches
acceptance: A return premium of 1,000.00 on a legacy invoice with 1,000.00 open reduces the PR and DTIP legacy balances by 1,000.00.
After the endorsement the account premium is the net premium used by Renewal.
A return premium of 500.00 on a legacy invoice paid in full and not remitted (zero premium receivable) creates an unapplied payment of 500.00 for the client and reduces DTIP legacy by 500.00.

requirements.title: Process a non-financial endorsement on a legacy policy
acceptance: An approved address change of a migrated policy is shown on the account and in the renewal candidate.
No journal is posted.

requirements.title: Report changes made to legacy invoices
acceptance: After a positive endorsement of 2,000.00 on a legacy invoice with original premium 10,000.00, the report shows original 10,000.00, updated 12,000.00 and delta 2,000.00 with the endorsement number.
The report exports to Excel with the same rows.
A Reporting User without the Production reconciliation permission runs and exports the report.

requirements.title: Include migrated records in the reports
requirements.screens: Reports (Report Centre); report screens of Operations, Cashiering, Collections, Remittance and Accounting
acceptance: The premium receivable ageing at go-live lists the legacy invoices and the BIBS invoices together; their total equals the open legacy invoices plus the open BIBS invoices.
With the Origin filter on Migrated, the same report lists only the legacy invoices and each row shows the origin Migrated.
The export to Excel has the same rows and the Origin column.
A Cash Receipts Book for January 2028 lists the receipts issued in BIBS, including the receipts on legacy invoices, and no receipt issued in legacy.

requirements.title: Search the legacy archive
acceptance: A closed legacy invoice of 2022 is found by its invoice number and opens read only with its documents.
An export above the row limit is refused with the limit message; an export at the limit works.

requirements.title: Log and review access to legacy history
acceptance: A search in Legacy Inquiry creates a log entry with the user, criteria and result count.
No user can edit or delete a log entry.

requirements.title: Plan the cutover and run rehearsals
acceptance: A trial-migration plan records planned and actual times per task and per object load.
The runbook export lists every task with owner and timing.
In a trial-migration plan, the load of P01 cannot start while C01 is not accepted.

requirements.title: Decide go / no-go on measured criteria
acceptance: GO cannot be recorded while Migration Clearing is not 0.00.
GO cannot be recorded while the preliminary trial balance is not signed as the provisional opening.
The decision record shows each criterion value at the time of the decision.

requirements.title: Transition renewals by RMEL cohort and track the run-off
acceptance: A legacy policy expiring 60 days after go-live appears in BIBS Renewal at go-live from the go-live extraction.
A legacy policy expiring 200 days after go-live is extracted by BIBS at 140 days before expiry.
The run-off report shows renewed, not renewed and open counts per expiry month.

requirements.title: Decommission legacy systems on agreed criteria
acceptance: A system cannot be marked decommissioned while its archive reconciliation is open ("Criterion Archive reconciled is not met").
The legacy context cannot be closed while a legacy UPP has a balance ("Criterion No legacy UPP balance is not met").
EBIX cannot be marked decommissioned while the final true-up is not signed ("Criterion Final true-up reconciled is not met").

requirements.title: Renew the January to May 2028 expiries in BIBS from go-live
acceptance: At go-live the header C-2027-004512-01, expiring on 15 January 2028, is a candidate flagged Urgent among the January expiries at the top of the worklist in expiry-date order; its RA sent on 16 November 2027 is recorded and no RA is queued for it.
A header expiring on 31 May 2028 is extracted at go-live; a header expiring on 1 June 2028 is not, and the daily extraction takes it on 13 January 2028.
The header C-2027-004600-01, whose renewal term C-2027-004600-02 was booked in legacy, is not extracted.
For each month January to May 2028 the go-live renewal extraction check balances.

requirements.title: Load the renewal advices already sent before go-live
acceptance: A file with the RA of C-2027-004512-01 sent on 16 November 2027 by e-mail loads, and at go-live the candidate shows the RA as already sent.

A row whose cover C-2027-009999 has no header, a row expiring on 15 June 2028 and a row with an RA date of 30 December 2027 are rejected with their messages and appear in the rejection report with the correction columns.
A resubmission prepared and approved by the same user is refused; approved by the checker, it loads as a rerun batch.
A row still rejected at the deadline is not loaded and is listed for the day-1 queue.

requirements.title: Continue the renewals in progress at the freeze (proposed position)
acceptance: A legacy renewal whose new term starts on 15 December 2027 is booked in legacy before the freeze and its new term is found in BIBS as a migrated account with the origin Migrated.
At go-live the candidate of C-2027-004512-01 (expiry 15 January 2028) is urgent, shows the RA sent on 16 November 2027, and the processor records its disposition in BIBS.
The P03 batch log lists the loaded, rejected and resubmitted rows with their times and messages, and the extraction check balances for each expiry month January-May 2028.

requirements.title: Carry forward open legacy claims (on BDOI confirmation)
requirements.screens: Batches (F07); Claims work list and claim record; Legacy Inquiry
acceptance: An open claim with a reserve of 150,000.00 and 50,000.00 paid in legacy is found by its legacy claim number, shows the origin Migrated, the reserve and the payment, and opens its legacy policy header.
A claim whose policy has no header is rejected with its message.
The claim reconciliation shows counts, reserves and paid amounts per currency with no difference.

requirements.title: Link e-policies to the migrated accounts (on BDOI confirmation)
requirements.screens: Extracts; Batches (e-policy index); account record (Documents); exception and audit reports
acceptance: An e-policy whose insurer and insurer policy number match one migrated account is linked to it and can be viewed and downloaded from the account's documents.
An e-policy that matches no account is not linked and appears on the exception report with its reason.
The audit report lists every linked and failed file with the time and the reason.
